// App.js
import "react-native-gesture-handler";
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { View, ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from "react-native-gesture-handler";
import { SafeAreaProvider } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import * as SplashScreen from "expo-splash-screen";
import {
  useFonts,
  Syne_700Bold,
  Syne_800ExtraBold,
} from "@expo-google-fonts/syne";
import {
  DMSans_400Regular,
  DMSans_500Medium,
  DMSans_600SemiBold,
  DMSans_700Bold,
} from "@expo-google-fonts/dm-sans";

import { ThemeProvider } from "./src/contexts/ThemeContext";
import { CurrencyProvider } from "./src/contexts/CurrencyContext";
import { ToastProvider } from "./src/contexts/ToastContext";
import RootNavigator from "./src/navigation/RootNavigator";
import { initI18n } from "./src/i18n";
import i18n from "./src/i18n"; // same configured singleton

SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync().catch(() => {});

export default function App() {
  const [i18nReady, setI18nReady] = useState(false);
  const [langKey, setLangKey] = useState("en");

  const [fontsLoaded] = useFonts({
    Syne_700Bold,
    Syne_800ExtraBold,
    DMSans_400Regular,
    DMSans_500Medium,
    DMSans_600SemiBold,
    DMSans_700Bold,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    initI18n().then(() => {
      setI18nReady(true);
      setLangKey(i18n.language || "en");

      // Your i18n/index.js exports i18n as default (same singleton that
      // initI18n configures). Listening here guarantees langKey updates
      // every time changeLanguage() is called anywhere in the app.
      i18n.on("languageChanged", (lng) => setLangKey(lng));
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (fontsLoaded && i18nReady) {
      SplashScreen.hideAsync().catch(() => {});
    }
  }, [fontsLoaded, i18nReady]);

  if (!fontsLoaded || !i18nReady) {
    return (
      <View style={styles.loading}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="#f97316" />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={styles.flex}>
      <SafeAreaProvider>
        <ThemeProvider>
          <CurrencyProvider>
            <ToastProvider>
              {/*
               * key={langKey} — when language changes, React unmounts and
               * remounts the entire navigator tree. Every screen calls
               * useTranslation() fresh with the new language.
               * Contexts above this line survive — user stays logged in.
               */}
              <RootNavigator key={langKey} />
            </ToastProvider>
          </CurrencyProvider>
        </ThemeProvider>
      </SafeAreaProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  loading: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    backgroundColor: "#080810",
  },
});

// src/api/bookings.js
// Mirrors the website's BookingList + BookingDetail + CreateBooking API calls.

import client from "./client";

// GET /bookings?page=1&limit=12&status=PENDING
export const getBookings = (params = {}) =>
  client.get("/bookings", { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

// GET /bookings/:id
export const getBooking = (id) =>
  client.get(`/bookings/${id}`).then((r) => r.data.data.booking);

// POST /bookings

  client.post("/bookings", data).then((r) => r.data.data.booking);

// PATCH /bookings/:id/status  — cancel, accept, complete etc.
export const updateBookingStatus = (id, status, extra = {}) =>
  client
    .patch(`/bookings/${id}/status`, { status, ...extra })
    .then((r) => r.data.data.booking);

// GET /workers/:id  — for CreateBooking worker lookup
export const getWorkerProfile = (workerId) =>
  client.get(`/workers/${workerId}`).then((r) => r.data.data.worker);

// src/api/categories.js
import api from "./client";

export const categoriesApi = {
  /**
   * GET /categories
   * Backend returns: { data: { categories: [...] } }
   */
  getAll: async () => {
    const { data } = await api.get("/categories");
    // data.data = { categories: [...] }
    const payload = data?.data ?? data;
    if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload;
    if (Array.isArray(payload?.categories)) return payload.categories;
    if (Array.isArray(payload?.data)) return payload.data;
    return [];
  },

  getBySlug: async (slug) => {
    const { data } = await api.get(`/categories/${slug}`);
    return data?.data?.category ?? data?.data ?? null;
  },

  /**
   * POST /categories/suggest
   * Backend returns: { data: { category: { id, name, slug, ... }, alreadyExists } }
   *
   * Always returns a valid { id, name, slug } — name falls back to the
   * string the caller passed so it is NEVER undefined.
   */
  suggest: async (name) => {
    // Guard: name must be a non-empty string
    const trimmed = (name ?? "").trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      return { id: `local_${Date.now()}`, name: "", slug: "" };
    }

    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/categories/suggest", { name: trimmed });

      // Actual shape: data.data.category
      const raw = data?.data?.category ?? data?.data ?? {};

      return {
        id: raw.id ?? raw._id ?? `custom_${Date.now()}`,
        name: raw.name ?? raw.title ?? trimmed, // always falls back to input
        slug: raw.slug ?? "",
      };
    } catch {
      // Network / server error — return a local entry so the hirer is never blocked
      return {
        id: `local_${Date.now()}`,
        name: trimmed,
        slug: "",
      };
    }
  },
};

// src/api/client.js
import axios from "axios";
import Constants from "expo-constants";
import * as SecureStore from "expo-secure-store";

const API_URL =
  Constants.expoConfig?.extra?.API_URL ||
  "https://skilledpro-backend-production.up.railway.app/api";

const ACCESS_KEY = "skp_access";
const REFRESH_KEY = "skp_refresh";

export const tokenStore = {
  async getAccess() {
    try { return await SecureStore.getItemAsync(ACCESS_KEY); } catch { return null; }
  },
  async getRefresh() {
    try { return await SecureStore.getItemAsync(REFRESH_KEY); } catch { return null; }
  },
  async setTokens(access, refresh) {
    try {
      if (access) await SecureStore.setItemAsync(ACCESS_KEY, access);
      if (refresh) await SecureStore.setItemAsync(REFRESH_KEY, refresh);
    } catch {}
  },
  async clear() {
    try {
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(ACCESS_KEY);
      await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(REFRESH_KEY);
    } catch {}
  },
};

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_URL,
  timeout: 30000,
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
});

// Attach access token
api.interceptors.request.use(async (config) => {
  const token = await tokenStore.getAccess();
  if (token) {
    config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
  }
  return config;
});

// Refresh on 401 once
let isRefreshing = false;
let queued = [];

const flush = (err, token) => {
  queued.forEach(({ resolve, reject }) => {
    if (err) reject(err);
    else resolve(token);
  });
  queued = [];
};

api.interceptors.response.use(
  (res) => res,
  async (error) => {
    const original = error.config;
    if (
      error.response?.status === 401 &&
      !original._retry &&
      !original.url?.includes("/auth/refresh") &&
      !original.url?.includes("/auth/login")
    ) {
      original._retry = true;
      const refresh = await tokenStore.getRefresh();
      if (!refresh) return Promise.reject(error);

      if (isRefreshing) {
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          queued.push({ resolve, reject });
        }).then((token) => {
          original.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
          return api(original);
        });
      }

      isRefreshing = true;
      try {
        const { data } = await axios.post(`${API_URL}/auth/refresh`, {
          refreshToken: refresh,
        });
        const newAccess = data?.data?.accessToken;
        const newRefresh = data?.data?.refreshToken;
        await tokenStore.setTokens(newAccess, newRefresh);
        flush(null, newAccess);
        original.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${newAccess}`;
        return api(original);
      } catch (err) {
        flush(err, null);
        await tokenStore.clear();
        return Promise.reject(err);
      } finally {
        isRefreshing = false;
      }
    }
    return Promise.reject(error);
  },
);

/** Pull a friendly error message off an axios error. */
export function getErrorMessage(err, fallback = "Something went wrong") {
  return (
    err?.response?.data?.message ||
    err?.response?.data?.error ||
    err?.message ||
    fallback
  );
}

export default api;

// src/api/payments.js
// Matches payment.controller.js + payment.routes.js exactly.
// Response shapes taken directly from each controller function's res.json() call.

import client from "./client";

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// CARD — POST /payments/initiate/:bookingId
// Stripe  → data: { clientSecret }
// Paystack→ data: { authorizationUrl, reference }
// Already paid → data: { alreadyPaid: true, bookingId }
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const initiatePayment = (bookingId) =>
  client.post(`/payments/initiate/${bookingId}`).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// MOBILE STRIPE CHECKOUT — POST /payments/initiate-checkout/:bookingId
// Returns { url, sessionId } — Checkout Session URL, safe to open in browser.
// Add this single extra endpoint to payment.routes.js (see mobile_stripe_addition.js)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const initiateStripeCheckout = (bookingId) =>
  client
    .post(`/payments/initiate-checkout/${bookingId}`)
    .then((r) => r.data.data);

export const verifyPaystackPayment = (reference) =>
  client
    .get("/payments/verify/paystack", { params: { reference } })
    .then((r) => r.data);

// BANK TRANSFER — Step 1: GET details (no DB write)
// POST /payments/bank-transfer/:bookingId
// Returns {
//   reference, platformFee, workerPayout, totalToSend,
//   bankDetails: { bankName, accountNumber, accountName, amount, currency, narration }

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const initiateBankTransfer = (bookingId) =>
  client.post(`/payments/bank-transfer/${bookingId}`).then((r) => r.data.data);

// BANK TRANSFER — Step 2: Confirm after manual transfer (creates DB record)
// PATCH /payments/bank-transfer/:bookingId/confirm
// Body: { reference, proofUrl?, senderName?, bankName? }
// Returns { success, message, data: { payment } }
export const confirmBankTransfer = (bookingId, payload) =>
  client

    .then((r) => r.data);

// src/api/posts.js
import client from "./client";

// ── Feed ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// GET /posts/feed?page=1&limit=20&type=GENERAL
export const getFeed = (params = {}) =>
  client.get("/posts/feed", { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ── My posts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getMyPosts = (params = {}) =>
  client.get("/posts/my", { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ── User posts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getUserPosts = (userId, params = {}) =>
  client.get(`/posts/user/${userId}`, { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

// ── Single post ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getPost = (postId) =>
  client.get(`/posts/${postId}`).then((r) => r.data.data.post);

// ── Create post (multipart FormData for image support) ────────────────────────
export const createPost = (payload) => {
  // payload: { content, type?, isPublic?, images?: [{ uri, name, type }] }
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append("content", payload.content);
  form.append("type", payload.type ?? "GENERAL");
  form.append("isPublic", payload.isPublic ?? true);

  (payload.images ?? []).forEach((img, i) => {
    form.append("images", {
      uri: img.uri,
      name: img.name ?? `photo_${i}.jpg`,
      type: img.type ?? "image/jpeg",
    });
  });

  return client
    .post("/posts", form, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    })
    .then((r) => r.data.data.post);
};

// ── Update post ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const updatePost = (postId, payload) =>
  client.put(`/posts/${postId}`, payload).then((r) => r.data.data.post);

// ── Delete post ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const deletePost = (postId) =>
  client.delete(`/posts/${postId}`).then((r) => r.data);

// ── Repost ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const repost = (postId, content = "") =>
  client
    .post(`/posts/${postId}/repost`, { content })
    .then((r) => r.data.data.post);

// ── React ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// type: LIKE | LOVE | INSIGHTFUL | CELEBRATE | SUPPORT
export const reactToPost = (postId, type = "LIKE") =>
  client.post(`/posts/${postId}/react`, { type }).then((r) => r.data);

// ── Comments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const getComments = (postId, params = {}) =>
  client.get(`/posts/${postId}/comments`, { params }).then((r) => r.data.data);

  client
    .post(`/posts/${postId}/comments`, { content, parentId })
    .then((r) => r.data.data.comment);

  client.delete(`/posts/comments/${commentId}`).then((r) => r.data);

// src/api/settings.js
import api from "./client";

export const settingsApi = {
  // ── Profile ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getProfile: () => api.get("/settings/profile").then((r) => r.data.data.user),

  updateProfile: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/profile", payload).then((r) => r.data.data.user),

  updateAvatar: async (uri) => {
    const form = new FormData();
    const filename = uri.split("/").pop();
    const match = /\.(\w+)$/.exec(filename);
    const type = match ? `image/${match[1]}` : "image/jpeg";
    form.append("avatar", { uri, name: filename, type });
    const { data } = await api.post("/settings/avatar", form, {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "multipart/form-data" },
    });
    return data.data.avatar;
  },

  // ── Hirer profile ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  updateHirerProfile: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/hirer-profile", payload).then((r) => r.data),

  // ── Password ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  changePassword: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/password", payload).then((r) => r.data),

  // ── Notifications ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getNotificationPrefs: () =>
    api.get("/settings/notifications").then((r) => r.data.data.prefs),

  updateNotificationPrefs: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/notifications", payload).then((r) => r.data),

  // ── Privacy ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getPrivacySettings: () =>
    api.get("/settings/privacy").then((r) => r.data.data.privacy),

  updatePrivacySettings: (payload) =>
    api.patch("/settings/privacy", payload).then((r) => r.data),

  // ── Security ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getSecurityInfo: () => api.get("/settings/security").then((r) => r.data.data),

  // ── Activity ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  getActivitySummary: () =>
    api.get("/settings/activity").then((r) => r.data.data),

  // ── Account ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  deleteAccount: (payload) =>
    api.delete("/settings/account", { data: payload }).then((r) => r.data),
};

// src/components/AppButton.js
import React from "react";
import {
  Pressable,
  ActivityIndicator,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppButton — primary CTA used everywhere.
 *
 * variant:
 *   - "primary" (default): solid orange, dark text — matches "Sign In", "Continue →"
 *   - "secondary": panel bg with border — matches "← Back"
 *   - "ghost": transparent
 *   - "danger": red
 *
 * size: "md" (default) | "sm" | "lg"
 */
export default function AppButton({
  title,
  onPress,
  variant = "primary",
  size = "md",
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  iconLeft,
  iconRight,
  fullWidth = true,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const palette = getPalette(variant, theme, disabled);
  const dims = SIZE[size];

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.base,
        {
          backgroundColor: palette.bg,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          borderWidth: variant === "secondary" || variant === "ghost" ? 1 : 0,
          paddingVertical: dims.py,
          paddingHorizontal: dims.px,
          borderRadius: dims.radius,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          width: fullWidth ? "100%" : undefined,
          alignSelf: fullWidth ? "stretch" : "flex-start",
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <View style={styles.row}>
        {loading ? (
          <ActivityIndicator color={palette.fg} />
        ) : (
          <>
            {iconLeft ? (
              <Ionicons
                name={iconLeft}
                size={dims.icon}
                color={palette.fg}
                style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
              />
            ) : null}
            <AppText
              variant={dims.textVariant}
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: palette.fg, textAlign: "center" }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {title}
            </AppText>
            {iconRight ? (
              <Ionicons
                name={iconRight}
                size={dims.icon}
                color={palette.fg}
                style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
              />
            ) : null}
          </>
        )}
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const SIZE = {
  sm: { py: 10, px: 16, radius: 10, icon: 16, textVariant: "small" },
  md: { py: 14, px: 20, radius: 12, icon: 18, textVariant: "subtitle" },
  lg: { py: 16, px: 24, radius: 14, icon: 20, textVariant: "subtitle" },
};

function getPalette(variant, theme, disabled) {
  const base = (() => {
    switch (variant) {
      case "secondary":
        return {
          bg: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          fg: theme.colors.text,
          border: theme.colors.border,
        };
      case "ghost":
        return {
          bg: "transparent",
          fg: theme.colors.text,
          border: theme.colors.border,
        };
      case "danger":
        return {
          bg: theme.colors.red,
          fg: "#ffffff",
          border: "transparent",
        };
      case "primary":
      default:
        return {
          // The website uses pure orange button with near-black text on the
          // "Sign In" CTA; we match that contrast.
          bg: theme.colors.orange,
          fg: "#0f0f1a",
          border: "transparent",
        };
    }
  })();

  if (disabled) {
    return { ...base, bg: theme.colors.orangeDim, fg: theme.colors.textDim };
  }
  return base;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
});

# ── end of src/components/AppButton.js ────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/components/AppCurrency.js
import React from "react";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useCurrency } from "../contexts/CurrencyContext";

/**
 * AppCurrency — render a monetary amount.
 *
 *   <AppCurrency amount={1500} />                     // uses global currency
 *   <AppCurrency amount={1500} currencyCode="NGN" />  // overrides for this instance
 *   <AppCurrency amount={1500} variant="title" />     // any AppText variant
 *
 * This is intentionally a thin component so screens never have to know how
 * formatting works for a given user's locale.
 */
export default function AppCurrency({
  amount,
  currencyCode,
  variant = "body",
  weight,
  tone,
  style,
  minimumFractionDigits,
  maximumFractionDigits,
}) {
  const { format } = useCurrency();
  const text = format(amount, {
    currencyCode,
    minimumFractionDigits,
    maximumFractionDigits,
  });

  return (
    <AppText variant={variant} weight={weight} tone={tone} style={style}>
      {text}
    </AppText>
  );
}

// src/components/AppInput.js
import React, { useState, forwardRef } from "react";
import {
  View,
  TextInput,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  I18nManager,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppInput — themed input that matches the website's pill input
 *  (icon left, optional eye toggle for password, label above, error below).
 */
const AppInput = forwardRef(function AppInput(
  {
    label,
    iconLeft,
    placeholder,
    value,
    onChangeText,
    onBlur,
    onFocus,
    secureTextEntry,
    keyboardType = "default",
    autoCapitalize = "none",
    autoCorrect = false,
    autoComplete,
    textContentType,
    error,
    helperText,
    rightAction,
    rightActionLabel,
    onRightActionPress,
    multiline = false,
    numberOfLines,
    maxLength,
    editable = true,
    style,
  },
  ref,
) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const isPassword = !!secureTextEntry;
  const obscured = isPassword && !showPassword;

  const borderColor = error
    ? theme.colors.red
    : focused
    ? theme.colors.borderFocus
    : theme.colors.border;

  return (
    <View style={[styles.wrap, style]}>
      {(label || onRightActionPress) && (
        <View style={styles.labelRow}>
          {label ? (
            <AppText variant="label" tone="dim">
              {label}
            </AppText>
          ) : (
            <View />
          )}
          {onRightActionPress ? (
            <Pressable onPress={onRightActionPress} hitSlop={6}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="brand" weight="semibold">
                {rightActionLabel}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      )}

      <View
        style={[
          styles.field,
          {
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
            borderColor,
            paddingVertical: multiline ? 12 : 0,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {iconLeft ? (
          <Ionicons
            name={iconLeft}
            size={18}
            color={theme.colors.textDim}
            style={styles.iconLeft}
          />
        ) : null}

        <TextInput
          ref={ref}
          value={value}
          onChangeText={onChangeText}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          placeholderTextColor={theme.colors.textMuted}
          onFocus={(e) => {
            setFocused(true);
            onFocus?.(e);
          }}
          onBlur={(e) => {
            setFocused(false);
            onBlur?.(e);
          }}
          secureTextEntry={obscured}
          keyboardType={keyboardType}
          autoCapitalize={autoCapitalize}
          autoCorrect={autoCorrect}
          autoComplete={autoComplete}
          textContentType={textContentType}
          multiline={multiline}
          numberOfLines={numberOfLines}
          maxLength={maxLength}
          editable={editable}
          maxFontSizeMultiplier={1.2}
          style={[
            styles.input,
            {
              color: theme.colors.text,
              textAlign: I18nManager.isRTL ? "right" : "left",
              fontFamily: "DMSans_400Regular",
              minHeight: multiline ? Math.max(48, (numberOfLines || 3) * 22) : 48,
              paddingLeft: iconLeft ? 0 : 14,
              paddingRight: isPassword ? 0 : 14,
            },
          ]}
        />

        {isPassword ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setShowPassword((s) => !s)}
            hitSlop={8}
            style={styles.eye}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={showPassword ? "eye-off-outline" : "eye-outline"}
              size={18}
              color={theme.colors.textDim}
            />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {error ? (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={styles.helper}>
          {error}
        </AppText>
      ) : helperText ? (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="muted" style={styles.helper}>
          {helperText}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
});

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: { gap: 8 },
  labelRow: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
  },
  field: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  iconLeft: {
    paddingLeft: 14,
    paddingRight: 10,
  },
  input: {
    flex: 1,
    fontSize: 15,
    paddingVertical: 0,
  },
  eye: {
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 12,
  },
  helper: {
    marginTop: 2,
  },
});

export default AppInput;

# ── end of src/components/AppInput.js ────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/components/AppScreen.js
import React from "react";
import {
  View,
  StyleSheet,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StatusBar as RNStatusBar,
} from "react-native";
import { SafeAreaView } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { StatusBar } from "expo-status-bar";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppScreen — every screen mounts inside this wrapper. It handles:
 *  - safe areas (notches, gesture bars)
 *  - themed background
 *  - keyboard avoidance
 *  - optional scroll
 *  - status bar style synced with the active theme
 *  - pull-to-refresh (pass a <RefreshControl /> via `refreshControl` prop)
 */
export default function AppScreen({
  children,
  scroll = true,
  keyboard = true,
  padded = true,
  edges = ["left", "right", "bottom"],
  contentContainerStyle,
  refreshControl,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme, effectiveMode } = useTheme();

  const body = scroll ? (
    <ScrollView
      keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      refreshControl={refreshControl}
      contentContainerStyle={[
        styles.scrollContent,
        padded && styles.padded,
        contentContainerStyle,
      ]}
    >
      {children}
    </ScrollView>
  ) : (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.viewContent,
        padded && styles.padded,
        contentContainerStyle,
      ]}
    >
      {children}
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <SafeAreaView
      edges={edges}
      style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.bg }, style]}
    >
      <StatusBar style={effectiveMode === "light" ? "dark" : "light"} />
      {keyboard ? (
        <KeyboardAvoidingView
          behavior={Platform.OS === "ios" ? "padding" : undefined}
          style={styles.flex}
          keyboardVerticalOffset={
            Platform.OS === "ios" ? 0 : RNStatusBar.currentHeight || 0
          }
        >
          {body}
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      ) : (
        body
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1 },
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  scrollContent: { flexGrow: 1 },
  viewContent: { flex: 1 },
  padded: { paddingHorizontal: 20, paddingVertical: 16 },
});

# ── end of src/components/AppScreen.js ────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/components/AppText.js
import React from "react";
import { Text, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * AppText — every piece of text in the app should use this component.
 *
 * Variants map to the website's typographic system:
 *   - "display" / "displaySm" → Syne (the bold "Sign in to SkilledProz" headlines)
 *   - "title"   → DM Sans 600, larger
 *   - "body"    → DM Sans 400 (default)
 *   - "label"   → uppercase tracking, used for form labels and "WELCOME BACK"
 *   - "muted"   → for hints and helper text
 *
 * `tone` overrides color: "default" | "dim" | "muted" | "brand" | "danger" | "success"
 *
 * Because text is sized in `sp` and we don't allow OS-level font scaling beyond a
 * cap, layouts hold up across long languages (German, Russian) without breaking.
 */
export default function AppText({
  children,
  variant = "body",
  tone = "default",
  weight,
  align,
  style,
  numberOfLines,
  selectable,
  ...rest
}) {
  const { theme, fonts } = useTheme();

  const variantStyle = VARIANTS[variant] || VARIANTS.body;
  const fontFamily = weight
    ? FAMILY_BY_WEIGHT[weight] || fonts.body
    : variantStyle.fontFamily(fonts);

  const color = TONE_COLOR(tone, theme);

  return (
    <Text
      maxFontSizeMultiplier={1.3}
      numberOfLines={numberOfLines}
      selectable={selectable}
      style={[
        styles.base,
        { fontFamily, color },
        variantStyle.style,
        align && { textAlign: align },
        style,
      ]}
      {...rest}
    >
      {children}
    </Text>
  );
}

const VARIANTS = {
  display: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.displayBlack,
    style: { fontSize: 36, lineHeight: 42, letterSpacing: -0.5 },
  },
  displaySm: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.display,
    style: { fontSize: 28, lineHeight: 34, letterSpacing: -0.3 },
  },
  title: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.bodySemiBold,
    style: { fontSize: 20, lineHeight: 26 },
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.bodyMedium,
    style: { fontSize: 16, lineHeight: 22 },
  },
  body: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.body,
    style: { fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 21 },
  },
  small: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.body,
    style: { fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 18 },
  },
  label: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.bodySemiBold,
    style: {
      fontSize: 12,
      lineHeight: 16,
      letterSpacing: 1.2,
      textTransform: "uppercase",
    },
  },
  muted: {
    fontFamily: (f) => f.body,
    style: { fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 18 },
  },
};

const FAMILY_BY_WEIGHT = {
  regular: "DMSans_400Regular",
  medium: "DMSans_500Medium",
  semibold: "DMSans_600SemiBold",
  bold: "DMSans_700Bold",
  display: "Syne_700Bold",
  displayBlack: "Syne_800ExtraBold",
};

const TONE_COLOR = (tone, theme) => {
  switch (tone) {
    case "dim":     return theme.colors.textDim;
    case "muted":   return theme.colors.textMuted;
    case "brand":   return theme.colors.orange;
    case "danger":  return theme.colors.red;
    case "success": return theme.colors.green;
    default:        return theme.colors.text;
  }
};

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    // RN's default includeFontPadding on Android adds extra vertical space —
    // disabling gives us pixel-accurate alignment with the web design.
    includeFontPadding: false,
  },
});

// src/components/Avatar.js
import React from "react";
import { View, Image, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * Avatar — circular user photo with initials fallback.
 *
 *   <Avatar uri={user.avatar} firstName={user.firstName} lastName={user.lastName} size={40} />
 *
 * Falls back to a colored circle with the user's initials when no avatar.
 */
export default function Avatar({
  uri,
  firstName = "",
  lastName = "",
  size = 40,
  style,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const initials =
    `${firstName[0] || ""}${lastName[0] || ""}`.toUpperCase() || "?";

  if (uri) {
    return (
      <Image
        source={{ uri }}
        style={[
          styles.img,
          {
            width: size,
            height: size,
            borderRadius: size / 2,
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
          },
          style,
        ]}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.fallback,
        {
          width: size,
          height: size,
          borderRadius: size / 2,
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.orangeDim,
          borderColor: theme.colors.border,
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        weight="bold"
        style={{
          color: theme.colors.orange,
          fontSize: Math.max(11, Math.floor(size * 0.4)),
        }}
      >
        {initials}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  img: {},
  fallback: {
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
});

// src/components/Badge.js
import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * Badge — themed status pill.
 *
 *   <Badge tone="success">Accepted</Badge>
 *   <Badge tone="danger">Disputed</Badge>
 *
 * Tones: "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info" | "neutral"
 * Or pass `status` directly (PENDING / ACCEPTED / COMPLETED / etc.) and it
 * auto-picks the right tone.
 */
export default function Badge({ children, tone, status, size = "sm" }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const effectiveTone = tone || toneFromStatus(status);
  const palette = getPalette(effectiveTone, theme);
  const label = String(children ?? status ?? "").toUpperCase();

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.base,
        size === "sm" ? styles.sm : styles.md,
        { backgroundColor: palette.bg, borderColor: palette.border },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText
        weight="bold"
        style={{
          color: palette.fg,
          fontSize: size === "sm" ? 10 : 11,
          letterSpacing: 0.8,
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

function toneFromStatus(status) {
  switch ((status || "").toUpperCase()) {
    case "ACCEPTED":
    case "COMPLETED":
    case "RELEASED":
    case "VERIFIED":
    case "ACTIVE":
      return "success";
    case "PENDING":
    case "IN_PROGRESS":
    case "HELD":
    case "PROCESSING":
      return "warning";
    case "REJECTED":
    case "CANCELLED":
    case "DISPUTED":
    case "FAILED":
    case "REFUNDED":
      return "danger";
    case "OPEN":
      return "info";
    default:
      return "neutral";
  }
}

function getPalette(tone, theme) {
  switch (tone) {
    case "success":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.green,
        bg: theme.colors.greenDim,
        border: theme.colors.greenDim,
      };
    case "warning":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.orange,
        bg: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "danger":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.red,
        bg: theme.colors.redDim,
        border: theme.colors.redDim,
      };
    case "info":
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.orange,
        bg: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "neutral":
    default:
      return {
        fg: theme.colors.textDim,
        bg: theme.colors.bgCard,
        border: theme.colors.border,
      };
  }
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    alignSelf: "flex-start",
    borderRadius: 6,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  sm: { paddingHorizontal: 8, paddingVertical: 4 },
  md: { paddingHorizontal: 10, paddingVertical: 6 },
});

/**
 * BookingRow — one item in the Recent Bookings list (matches website screenshot).
 *
 *   <BookingRow booking={b} onPress={() => goTo(b.id)} showDivider />
 *
 * The booking payload from /hirer/me/dashboard looks like:
 *   { id, title, worker: { firstName, lastName, avatar }, category: { name },
 *     status, agreedRate, currency }
 */
export default function BookingRow({ booking, onPress, showDivider = true }) {

    ? `${booking.worker.firstName} ${booking.worker.lastName}`

          opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <Avatar
        uri={booking.worker?.avatar}
        firstName={booking.worker?.firstName}
        lastName={booking.worker?.lastName}

        </AppText>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
        >
          {workerName} · {categoryName}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      <Badge status={booking.status} />

  );
}

// src/components/ConfirmModal.js
// Platform-native confirmation modal — replaces Alert.alert() everywhere.
// Matches the app's dark/light theme and orange accent.

import React from "react";
import { Modal, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * Usage:
 *   const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
 *
 *   <ConfirmModal
 *     visible={!!modal}
 *     title={modal?.title}
 *     message={modal?.message}
 *     confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel}
 *     destructive={modal?.destructive}
 *     onConfirm={() => { modal?.onConfirm?.(); setModal(null); }}
 *     onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
 *   />
 *
 *   // To show:
 *   setModal({
 *     title: "Mark job as filled?",
 *     confirmLabel: "Yes, mark filled",
 *     destructive: true,
 *     onConfirm: () => doSomething(),
 *   });
 */
export default function ConfirmModal({
  visible = false,
  title = "",
  message = "",
  confirmLabel = "Yes",
  cancelLabel = "No",
  destructive = false,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType="fade"
      statusBarTranslucent
      onRequestClose={onCancel}
    >
      {/* Backdrop */}
      <Pressable style={styles.backdrop} onPress={onCancel}>
        {/* Stop event bubbling so tapping the card itself doesn't close */}
        <Pressable
          style={[
            styles.card,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.bgPanel,
              borderColor: c.border,
              shadowColor: c.shadow,
            },
          ]}
          onPress={() => {}}
        >
          {/* Title */}
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={[styles.title, { color: c.text }]}
          >
            {title}
          </AppText>

          {/* Optional message */}
          {!!message && (
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={styles.message}>
              {message}
            </AppText>
          )}

          {/* Divider */}
          <View style={[styles.divider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

          {/* Buttons */}
          <View style={styles.btnRow}>
            {/* Cancel */}
            <Pressable
              onPress={onCancel}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.btn,
                styles.cancelBtn,
                { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                pressed && { opacity: 0.7 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" tone="dim">
                {cancelLabel}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>

            {/* Confirm */}
            <Pressable
              onPress={onConfirm}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.btn,
                styles.confirmBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: destructive ? c.red : c.orange,
                },
                pressed && { opacity: 0.85 },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#fff" }}
              >
                {confirmLabel}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  backdrop: {
    flex: 1,
    backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 28,
  },
  card: {
    width: "100%",
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
    padding: 24,
    shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 8 },
    shadowOpacity: 0.35,
    shadowRadius: 24,
    elevation: 12,
  },
  title: { textAlign: "center" },
  message: { textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8 },
  divider: { height: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth, marginVertical: 20 },
  btnRow: { flexDirection: "row", gap: 10 },
  btn: {
    flex: 1,
    paddingVertical: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  cancelBtn: { borderWidth: 1 },
  confirmBtn: {},
});

// src/components/CurrencyPicker.js
import React, { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  View,
  Pressable,
  Modal,
  FlatList,
  TextInput,
  StyleSheet,
  I18nManager,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useCurrency } from "../contexts/CurrencyContext";
import { CURRENCIES } from "../constants/currencies";

/**
 * CurrencyPicker — pill button + modal sheet matching the website's
 * "Viewing in ₦ NGN ▾" control on the dashboard.
 *
 * Tap → modal slides up with a searchable list of all supported currencies.
 * Tap a currency → updates the global currency context and persists.
 */
export default function CurrencyPicker({ label }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { currency, setCurrencyCode } = useCurrency();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!query.trim()) return CURRENCIES;
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return CURRENCIES.filter(
      (c) =>
        c.code.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        c.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        c.symbol.toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [query]);

  const handleSelect = async (code) => {
    await setCurrencyCode(code);
    setOpen(false);
    setQuery("");
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setOpen(true)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.pill,
          {
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
            borderColor: theme.colors.border,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {label ? (
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginRight: 6 }}>
            {label}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
        <AppText weight="bold" style={{ color: theme.colors.orange }}>
          {currency.symbol}
        </AppText>
        <AppText weight="semibold" tone="brand" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
          {currency.code}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons
          name="chevron-down"
          size={14}
          color={theme.colors.textDim}
          style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
        />
      </Pressable>

      <Modal
        visible={open}
        transparent
        animationType="slide"
        onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setOpen(false)}
          style={[styles.backdrop, { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)" }]}
        />
        <View
          style={[
            styles.sheet,
            {
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
              borderTopColor: theme.colors.border,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold">
              {t("common.currency")}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable onPress={() => setOpen(false)} hitSlop={10}>
              <Ionicons name="close" size={22} color={theme.colors.text} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          <View
            style={[
              styles.search,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgInput,
                borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="search"
              size={16}
              color={theme.colors.textDim}
              style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
            />
            <TextInput
              value={query}
              onChangeText={setQuery}
              placeholder={t("common.search")}
              placeholderTextColor={theme.colors.textMuted}
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                color: theme.colors.text,
                fontFamily: "DMSans_400Regular",
                fontSize: 15,
                textAlign: I18nManager.isRTL ? "right" : "left",
              }}
              autoCorrect={false}
              autoCapitalize="characters"
            />
          </View>

          <FlatList
            data={filtered}
            keyExtractor={(item) => item.code}
            keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
            renderItem={({ item }) => {
              const isActive = item.code === currency.code;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => handleSelect(item.code)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [
                    styles.item,
                    {
                      borderBottomColor: theme.colors.border,
                      backgroundColor: pressed
                        ? theme.colors.bgCard
                        : "transparent",
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22, marginRight: 12 }}>
                    {item.flag}
                  </AppText>
                  <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                    <AppText weight="semibold">{item.code}</AppText>
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      {item.name}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <AppText
                    weight="bold"
                    style={{ color: theme.colors.orange, marginRight: 12 }}
                  >
                    {item.symbol}
                  </AppText>
                  {isActive ? (
                    <Ionicons
                      name="checkmark-circle"
                      size={20}
                      color={theme.colors.orange}
                    />
                  ) : null}
                </Pressable>
              );
            }}
            ListEmptyComponent={
              <AppText tone="muted" align="center" style={{ marginTop: 40 }}>
                No currencies match
              </AppText>
            }
          />
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  pill: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 10,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  backdrop: { flex: 1 },
  sheet: {
    position: "absolute",
    bottom: 0,
    left: 0,
    right: 0,
    maxHeight: "75%",
    borderTopLeftRadius: 20,
    borderTopRightRadius: 20,
    borderTopWidth: 1,
    paddingHorizontal: 20,
    paddingTop: 16,
    paddingBottom: 32,
  },
  header: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    marginBottom: 16,
  },
  search: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    height: 44,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
    marginBottom: 8,
  },
  item: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 14,
    paddingHorizontal: 4,
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
  },
});

export default function DrawerContent({ state }) {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user, logout } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;
  const activeRouteName = state?.routes?.[state.index]?.name;

  const goTo = (name) => navigation.navigate(name);

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      await logout();
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel }]}>
      {/* ── STATIC: Logo ─────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <View style={[styles.logoRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
        <SkilledProzWordmark width={120} height={20} />
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.portalLabel}>
          {t("nav.hirerPortal")}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ── STATIC: User card ────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => goTo("Profile")}
        style={[styles.userCard, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
      >
        <View style={[styles.avatarWrap, { borderColor: c.orange }]}>
          {user?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: user.avatar }} style={styles.avatar} />
          ) : (
            <Ionicons name="person" size={28} color={c.textMuted} />
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 12, flex: 1 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
            {user?.firstName} {user?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <View style={[styles.roleBadge, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
            <View style={styles.roleDot} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#fff" }}
            >
              Hirer
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ── SCROLLABLE: Nav groups ────────────────────────────────── */}
      <ScrollView
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}
      >
        {NAV_GROUPS.map((group) => (
          <View key={group.labelKey} style={styles.group}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"

              tone="dim"
              style={styles.groupLabel}
            >
              {t(group.labelKey)}

// src/components/PostCard.js
// Shared between MyPostsScreen and CommunityFeedScreen.
// Mirrors the website's post card exactly.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Share,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import {
  reactToPost,
  repost,
  addComment,
  getComments,
  deleteComment,
} from "../api/posts";

// ── Post type config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const POST_TYPES = {
  GENERAL: {
    label: "General",
    emoji: "💬",
    color: "#6b7280",
    bg: "rgba(107,114,128,0.15)",
  },
  ACHIEVEMENT: {
    label: "Achievement",
    emoji: "🏆",
    color: "#f59e0b",
    bg: "rgba(245,158,11,0.15)",
  },
  PORTFOLIO: {
    label: "Portfolio",
    emoji: "🎨",
    color: "#6366f1",
    bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.15)",
  },
  HIRING: {
    label: "Hiring",
    emoji: "📢",
    color: "#06b6d4",
    bg: "rgba(6,182,212,0.15)",
  },
  JOB_UPDATE: {
    label: "Job Update",
    emoji: "💼",
    color: "#f97316",
    bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
  },
  ANNOUNCEMENT: {
    label: "Announcement",
    emoji: "📣",
    color: "#ec4899",
    bg: "rgba(236,72,153,0.15)",
  },
};

const REACTIONS = [
  { type: "LIKE", emoji: "👍" },
  { type: "LOVE", emoji: "❤️" },
  { type: "INSIGHTFUL", emoji: "💡" },
  { type: "CELEBRATE", emoji: "🎉" },
  { type: "SUPPORT", emoji: "🤝" },
];

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  const now = new Date();
  const date = new Date(d);
  const diff = (now - date) / 1000;
  if (diff < 60) return "just now";
  if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}m`;
  if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}h`;
  return date.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short" });
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

// ── Nested original post (for reposts) ────────────────────────────────────────
function OriginalPostPreview({ original, c }) {
  const a = original?.author;
  if (!original) return null;
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        s.originalCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={s.originalAuthorRow}>
        <View style={[s.miniAvatar, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
          {a?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: a.avatar }} style={s.miniAvatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {initials(a?.firstName, a?.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
            {a?.firstName} {a?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {fmtDate(original.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        numberOfLines={4}
        style={{ marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 22 }}
      >
        {original.content}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Comments sheet (inline expandable) ────────────────────────────────────────
function CommentsSection({
  postId,
  initialComments = [],
  commentCount = 0,
  userId,
  c,
}) {
  const [comments, setComments] = useState(initialComments);
  const [text, setText] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [loadedAll, setLoadedAll] = useState(false);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (loadedAll || loading) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getComments(postId, { page: 1, limit: 20 });
      setComments(data.comments ?? []);
      setLoadedAll(true);
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const comment = await addComment(postId, text.trim());
      setComments((prev) => [comment, ...prev]);
      setText("");
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (commentId) => {
    try {
      await deleteComment(commentId);
      setComments((prev) => prev.filter((c) => c.id !== commentId));
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <View style={[s.commentsSection, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
      {/* Input row */}
      <View style={[s.commentInputRow, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
        <TextInput
          value={text}
          onChangeText={setText}
          placeholder="Write a comment…"
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[
            s.commentInput,
            { color: c.text, backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
          ]}
          multiline
          maxLength={500}
        />
        <Pressable
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          disabled={!text.trim() || submitting}
          style={[
            s.commentSendBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: text.trim() ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
              opacity: text.trim() ? 1 : 0.5,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {submitting ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 16 }}>➤</AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* Load all button */}
      {!loadedAll && commentCount > initialComments.length && (
        <Pressable onPress={loadMore} style={s.loadMoreBtn}>
          {loading ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={c.orange} />
          ) : (
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
              View all {commentCount} comments
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      )}

      {/* Comment list */}
      {comments.map((comment) => {
        const ca = comment.author;
        const isOwn = ca?.id === userId;
        return (
          <View
            key={comment.id}
            style={[s.commentItem, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
          >
            <View style={[s.commentAvatar, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}>
              {ca?.avatar ? (
                <Image source={{ uri: ca.avatar }} style={s.commentAvatarImg} />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700" }}
                >
                  {initials(ca?.firstName, ca?.lastName)}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
              <View style={s.commentAuthorRow}>
                <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
                  {ca?.firstName} {ca?.lastName}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {" "}
                  · {fmtDate(comment.createdAt)}
                </AppText>
                {isOwn && (
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => handleDelete(comment.id)}
                    style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }}
                  >
                    <AppText style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontSize: 12 }}>
                      ✕
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                )}
              </View>
              <AppText variant="body" style={{ lineHeight: 20, marginTop: 2 }}>
                {comment.content}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main PostCard component
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function PostCard({
  post,
  userId, // current user id (to show delete/own-post behaviour)
  c, // theme colors
  onDelete, // () => void
  onPostUpdated, // (updatedPost) => void
  showDelete = true,
}) {
  const [myReaction, setMyReaction] = useState(post.myReaction ?? null);
  const [reactionSum, setReactionSum] = useState(post.reactionSummary ?? {});
  const [showReacts, setShowReacts] = useState(false); // emoji picker
  const [showComments, setShowComments] = useState(false);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [reacting, setReacting] = useState(false);

  const isOwn = post.author?.id === userId;
  const typeMeta = POST_TYPES[post.type] ?? POST_TYPES.GENERAL;
  const author = post.author;
  const totalReactions = Object.values(reactionSum).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  const commentCount = post._count?.comments ?? 0;
  const contentLong = post.content?.length > 180;

  const doReact = async (type) => {
    if (reacting) return;
    setReacting(true);
    setShowReacts(false);
    try {
      await reactToPost(post.id, type);
      if (myReaction === type) {
        // toggle off
        setMyReaction(null);
        setReactionSum((prev) => {
          const n = { ...prev };
          n[type] = Math.max(0, (n[type] ?? 1) - 1);
          if (n[type] === 0) delete n[type];
          return n;
        });
      } else {
        // change or add
        setReactionSum((prev) => {
          const n = { ...prev };
          if (myReaction) {
            n[myReaction] = Math.max(0, (n[myReaction] ?? 1) - 1);
            if (n[myReaction] === 0) delete n[myReaction];
          }
          n[type] = (n[type] ?? 0) + 1;
          return n;
        });
        setMyReaction(type);
      }
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setReacting(false);
    }
  };

  const doRepost = async () => {
    try {
      await repost(post.id);
    } catch {}
  };

  const doShare = async () => {
    try {
      await Share.share({
        message: `${post.content ?? ""}\n\nShared from SkilledPro`,
      });
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <View
      style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* ── Author row ── */}
      <View style={s.authorRow}>
        {/* Avatar */}
        <View
          style={[
            s.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {author?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: author.avatar }} style={s.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {initials(author?.firstName, author?.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Name + meta */}
        <View style={s.authorInfo}>
          <View style={s.nameRow}>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              {author?.firstName} {author?.lastName}
            </AppText>
            {post.type !== "GENERAL" && (
              <View style={[s.typeBadge, { backgroundColor: typeMeta.bg }]}>
                <AppText
                  style={{
                    color: typeMeta.color,
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: "700",
                  }}
                >
                  {typeMeta.label}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {author?.hirerProfile?.companyName ||
              author?.workerProfile?.title ||
              ""}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {[author?.city, author?.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
            {author?.city || author?.country ? " · " : ""}
            {fmtDate(post.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Delete button (own posts) */}
        {isOwn && showDelete && onDelete && (
          <Pressable
            onPress={onDelete}
            style={[
              s.deleteBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontSize: 13 }}>🗑️</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginLeft: 4 }}
            >
              Delete
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* ── Reposted indicator ── */}
      {post.repostOf && (
        <View style={s.repostedRow}>
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>🔄</AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
            Reposted
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Original post (nested) ── */}
      {post.repostOf && <OriginalPostPreview original={post.repostOf} c={c} />}

      {/* ── Content ── */}
      {!!post.content && (
        <View style={s.contentWrap}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ lineHeight: 24 }}
            numberOfLines={expanded || !contentLong ? undefined : 4}
          >
            {post.content}
          </AppText>
          {contentLong && (
            <Pressable onPress={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)}>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 4 }}
              >
                {expanded ? "Show less" : "…see more"}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Images ── */}
      {post.images?.length > 0 && (
        <View style={s.imagesWrap}>
          {post.images.length === 1 ? (
            <Image
              source={{ uri: post.images[0] }}
              style={s.singleImage}
              resizeMode="cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <FlatList
              data={post.images}
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              keyExtractor={(_, i) => String(i)}
              contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 6 }}
              renderItem={({ item }) => (
                <Image
                  source={{ uri: item }}
                  style={s.multiImage}
                  resizeMode="cover"
                />
              )}
            />
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Reaction + comment count row ── */}
      {(totalReactions > 0 || commentCount > 0) && (
        <View style={[s.countRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
          {totalReactions > 0 && (
            <View style={s.reactionCountGroup}>
              {Object.entries(reactionSum)
                .filter(([, v]) => v > 0)
                .slice(0, 3)
                .map(([type]) => (
                  <AppText key={type} style={s.reactionEmoji}>
                    {REACTIONS.find((r) => r.type === type)?.emoji ?? "👍"}
                  </AppText>
                ))}
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
                {totalReactions}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
          {commentCount > 0 && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowComments((v) => !v)}
              style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }}
            >
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {commentCount} comment{commentCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Action bar ── */}
      <View style={[s.actionBar, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        {/* Like — long press shows picker, tap toggles */}
        <Pressable
          style={s.actionBtn}
          onPress={() => doReact("LIKE")}
          onLongPress={() => setShowReacts((v) => !v)}
          delayLongPress={400}
        >
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>
            {myReaction
              ? (REACTIONS.find((r) => r.type === myReaction)?.emoji ?? "👍")
              : "👍"}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{
              color: myReaction ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
              marginLeft: 4,
            }}
          >
            Like
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* Comment */}
        <Pressable
          style={s.actionBtn}
          onPress={() => setShowComments((v) => !v)}
        >
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>💬</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}
          >
            Comment
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* Repost */}
        <Pressable style={s.actionBtn} onPress={doRepost}>
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>🔄</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}
          >
            Repost
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        {/* Send */}
        <Pressable style={s.actionBtn} onPress={doShare}>
          <AppText style={s.actionIcon}>✈️</AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}
          >
            Send
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      </View>

      {/* ── Reaction picker (long-press) ── */}
      {showReacts && (
        <View
          style={[
            s.reactPicker,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {REACTIONS.map((r) => (
            <Pressable
              key={r.type}
              onPress={() => doReact(r.type)}
              style={s.reactPickerItem}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 26 }}>{r.emoji}</AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ── Comments section ── */}
      {showComments && (
        <CommentsSection
          postId={post.id}
          initialComments={post.comments ?? []}
          commentCount={post._count?.comments ?? 0}
          userId={userId}
          c={c}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/components/SectionHeader.js
import React from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { I18nManager } from "react-native";

/**
 * SectionHeader — title + optional "View all →" action.
 *
 *   <SectionHeader title="Recent Bookings" actionLabel="View all" onActionPress={fn} />
 */
export default function SectionHeader({
  title,
  subtitle,
  actionLabel,
  onActionPress,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const arrow = I18nManager.isRTL ? "arrow-back" : "arrow-forward";

  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
        <AppText variant="title" weight="bold">
          {title}
        </AppText>
        {subtitle ? (
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
            {subtitle}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      {onActionPress ? (
        <Pressable onPress={onActionPress} hitSlop={8} style={styles.action}>
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" tone="brand">
            {actionLabel}
          </AppText>
          <Ionicons name={arrow} size={14} color={theme.colors.orange} />
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    marginBottom: 12,
  },
  action: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 },
});

// src/components/SkilledProzWordmark.js
import React from "react";

import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * SkilledProzWordmark — matches the "Skilled" white + "Proz" orange treatment
 * shown at the top of the drawer (and the marketing site). Use this anywhere
 * the brand wordmark needs to appear.
 *
 *   <SkilledProzWordmark size="lg" />
 */
export default function SkilledProzWordmark({ size = "md", style }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();

      <AppText
        weight="displayBlack"
        style={{

          lineHeight: dims.lineHeight,

          letterSpacing: -0.5,
        }}
      >
        Skilled
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        weight="displayBlack"
        style={{
          fontSize: dims.fontSize,
          lineHeight: dims.lineHeight,
          color: theme.colors.orange,
          letterSpacing: -0.5,
        }}
      >
        Proz
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

const SIZES = {
  sm: { fontSize: 18, lineHeight: 22 },
  md: { fontSize: 24, lineHeight: 28 },
  lg: { fontSize: 32, lineHeight: 36 },
};

  row: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "baseline" },
});

// src/components/StatCard.js
import React from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet, Pressable } from "react-native";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

export default function StatCard({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  tone = "neutral",
  onPress,
}) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const palette = getPalette(tone, theme);
  const Wrap = onPress ? Pressable : View;

  return (
    <Wrap
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed } = {}) => [
        styles.card,
        {
          backgroundColor: palette.bg,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          borderWidth: 1.5,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Icon top-left */}
      <AppText style={styles.icon}>{icon}</AppText>

      {/* Spacer */}
      <View style={{ flex: 1 }} />

      {/* Value */}
      {typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" ? (
        <AppText
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={[styles.value, { color: palette.valueColor }]}
          numberOfLines={1}
          adjustsFontSizeToFit
          minimumFontScale={0.5}
        >
          {value}
        </AppText>
      ) : (
        value
      )}

      {/* Label */}
      <AppText
        style={[styles.label, { color: palette.labelColor }]}
        numberOfLines={1}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </Wrap>
  );
}

function getPalette(tone, theme) {
  switch ((tone, theme)) {
    case "warning":
      return {
        bg: "#2c1600", // deep burnt orange-brown
        border: "#b85c00", // vivid orange border
        valueColor: "#f97316", // orange number
        labelColor: "#b87340", // muted orange label
      };
    case "success":
      return {
        bg: "#071a0d", // very dark forest green
        border: "#155a2a", // mid green border
        valueColor: "#22c55e", // bright green number
        labelColor: "#4ade80", // lighter green label
      };
    case "spent":
      return {
        bg: "#12121e", // dark blue-grey — Total Spent tile
        border: "#2e2e4a", // cool blue-grey border
        valueColor: "#ffffff",
        labelColor: "#7878aa",
      };
    case "neutral":
    default:
      return {
        bg: "#1b1b28", // dark charcoal — Total Bookings tile
        border: "#2a2a40", // subtle purple-grey border
        valueColor: "#ffffff",
        labelColor: "#888899",
      };
  }
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    flex: 1,
    height: 160,
    padding: 16,
    borderRadius: 18,
    overflow: "hidden",
    flexDirection: "column",
  },
  icon: {
    fontSize: 26,
    lineHeight: 32,
  },
  value: {
    fontSize: 34,
    lineHeight: 40,
    letterSpacing: -1,
    marginBottom: 2,
  },
  label: {
    fontSize: 13,
    lineHeight: 18,
    marginTop: 2,
  },
});

// src/components/TopBar.js
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet, Platform } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation, useNavigationState } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";

import AppText from "./AppText";
import Avatar from "./Avatar";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../store/authStore";
import { hirerApi } from "../api/hirer";

/**
 * TopBar — sticky app header shown above every Hirer screen.
 *
 *   ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 *   │ ☰   Dashboard                              🔔 9+      [👤]   │
 *   └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
 *
 *  - Hamburger opens the SideDrawer (via navigation.openDrawer())
 *  - Title is derived from the current route
 *  - Bell shows unread notification count badge
 *  - Avatar opens the profile screen
 *
 * Polls notifications every 30s so the badge stays fresh without sockets.
 */
export default function TopBar({ title: titleOverride }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const [unread, setUnread] = useState(0);

  // Derive the title from the current focused route name unless overridden.
  const routeName = useNavigationState(
    (state) => state?.routes?.[state.index]?.name,
  );
  const title = titleOverride || prettyTitle(routeName);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    let timer;
    const fetchUnread = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await hirerApi.getNotifications();
        if (!cancelled) setUnread(data?.unread ?? 0);
      } catch {
        // silent — TopBar must never crash a screen
      }
    };
    fetchUnread();
    timer = setInterval(fetchUnread, 30_000);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  const openMenu = () => {
    // Works with the drawer navigator set up in HirerNavigator.
    if (navigation.openDrawer) {
      navigation.openDrawer();
    } else {
      navigation.getParent()?.openDrawer?.();
    }
  };

  const openNotifications = () => navigation.navigate("Notifications");
  const openProfile = () => navigation.navigate("Profile");

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.wrap,
        {
          paddingTop: insets.top,
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bg,
          borderBottomColor: theme.colors.border,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={styles.row}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={openMenu}
          hitSlop={10}
          style={({ pressed }) => [
            styles.iconBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
              borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons name="menu" size={20} color={theme.colors.text} />
        </Pressable>

        <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={styles.title}>
          {title}
        </AppText>

        <View style={styles.rightCluster}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={openNotifications}
            hitSlop={6}
            style={({ pressed }) => [
              styles.iconBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
                borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="notifications-outline"
              size={20}
              color={theme.colors.text}
            />
            {unread > 0 ? (
              <View
                style={[styles.badge, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.orange }]}
              >
                <AppText
                  weight="bold"
                  style={{
                    color: "#0f0f1a",
                    fontSize: 10,
                    lineHeight: 12,
                  }}
                >
                  {unread > 9 ? "9+" : String(unread)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
          </Pressable>

          <Pressable
            onPress={openProfile}
            hitSlop={6}
            style={({ pressed }) => [{ opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1 }]}
          >
            <Avatar
              uri={user?.avatar}
              firstName={user?.firstName}
              lastName={user?.lastName}
              size={40}
            />
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

function prettyTitle(route) {
  if (!route) return "Dashboard";
  // CamelCase → "Camel Case"
  return route.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").trim();
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrap: {
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    ...Platform.select({
      ios: {},
      android: {},
    }),
  },
  row: {
    height: 56,
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 12,
    gap: 10,
  },
  iconBtn: {
    width: 40,
    height: 40,
    borderRadius: 10,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  title: { flex: 1, marginLeft: 4 },
  rightCluster: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 10,
  },
  badge: {
    position: "absolute",
    top: -4,
    right: -4,
    minWidth: 18,
    height: 18,
    borderRadius: 9,
    paddingHorizontal: 4,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
});
