// src/components/WorkerRow.js
import React from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import AppText from "./AppText";
import Avatar from "./Avatar";
import AppCurrency from "./AppCurrency";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

/**
 * WorkerRow — one item in the Recent Workers list.
 *
 *   <WorkerRow worker={w} onPress={() => goToWorker(w.id)} showDivider />
 *
 * Expects the shape returned from /hirer/me/dashboard.recentWorkers[]:
 *   { id, firstName, lastName, avatar, workerProfile: { title, avgRating } }
 */
export default function WorkerRow({ worker, onPress, showDivider = true }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const name = `${worker.firstName || ""} ${worker.lastName || ""}`.trim();
  const title = worker.workerProfile?.title || "—";
  const rating = worker.workerProfile?.avgRating || 0;
  const rate = worker.workerProfile?.hourlyRate;
  const rateCurrency = worker.workerProfile?.currency;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.row,
        {
          borderBottomColor: theme.colors.border,
          borderBottomWidth: showDivider ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth : 0,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      <Avatar
        uri={worker.avatar}
        firstName={worker.firstName}
        lastName={worker.lastName}
        size={40}
      />

      <View style={styles.middle}>
        <AppText weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
          {name || "Worker"}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
        >
          {title}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.right}>
        {rating > 0 ? (
          <View style={styles.ratingRow}>
            <Ionicons name="star" size={12} color={theme.colors.orange} />
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              {Number(rating).toFixed(1)}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        {rate ? (
          <AppCurrency
            amount={rate}
            currencyCode={rateCurrency}
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
          />
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 14,
    gap: 12,
  },
  middle: { flex: 1, minWidth: 0 },
  right: { alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 2 },
  ratingRow: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 4 },
});

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useMemo } from "react";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import { CURRENCIES, getCurrency } from "../constants/currencies";

const STORAGE_KEY = "@skilledproz:currency";
const CurrencyContext = createContext({
  currency: CURRENCIES[0],
  setCurrencyCode: () => {},
  format: () => "",
});

export function CurrencyProvider({ children, initialCode = "USD" }) {
  const [code, setCode] = useState(initialCode);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) setCode(saved);
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, []);

  const setCurrencyCode = async (next) => {
    setCode(next);
    try { await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next); } catch {}
  };

  const currency = getCurrency(code);

  const format = useMemo(
    () => (amount, opts = {}) => {
      const targetCode = opts.currencyCode || code;
      const target = getCurrency(targetCode);
      const num = Number(amount ?? 0);
      try {
        return new Intl.NumberFormat(opts.locale || undefined, {
          style: "currency",
          currency: targetCode,
          minimumFractionDigits: opts.minimumFractionDigits ?? 0,
          maximumFractionDigits: opts.maximumFractionDigits ?? 2,
        }).format(num);
      } catch {
        const formatted = num.toLocaleString(undefined, {
          minimumFractionDigits: opts.minimumFractionDigits ?? 0,
          maximumFractionDigits: opts.maximumFractionDigits ?? 2,
        });
        return `${target.symbol}${formatted}`;
      }
    },
    [code]
  );

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ currency, currencyCode: code, setCurrencyCode, format, currencies: CURRENCIES }),
    [currency, code, format]
  );

  return <CurrencyContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</CurrencyContext.Provider>;
}

export const useCurrency = () => useContext(CurrencyContext);

╚══════════════════════════════════════╝
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  useMemo,
} from "react";
import { Appearance } from "react-native";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import { THEMES, FONTS, RADII, SPACING } from "../constants/theme";

const STORAGE_KEY = "@skilledproz:theme";
const ThemeContext = createContext({
  theme: THEMES.dark,
  mode: "system",
  setMode: () => {},
});

export function ThemeProvider({ children }) {
  const [mode, setModeState] = useState("system");
  const [systemScheme, setSystemScheme] = useState(
    Appearance.getColorScheme() || "dark",
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const saved = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved === "light" || saved === "dark" || saved === "system")
          setModeState(saved);
      } catch {}
    })();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const sub = Appearance.addChangeListener(({ colorScheme }) => {
      setSystemScheme(colorScheme || "dark");
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, []);

  const setMode = async (next) => {
    setModeState(next);
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, next);
    } catch {}
  };

  const effectiveMode = mode === "system" ? systemScheme : mode;
  const theme = effectiveMode === "light" ? THEMES.light : THEMES.dark;

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      theme,
      mode,
      effectiveMode,
      setMode,
      fonts: FONTS,
      radii: RADII,
      spacing: SPACING,
    }),
    [theme, mode, effectiveMode],
  );

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export const useTheme = () => useContext(ThemeContext);

// src/contexts/ToastContext.js
import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useCallback,
  useRef,
  useEffect,
} from "react";
import {
  View,
  Text,
  StyleSheet,
  Animated,
  TouchableOpacity,
  Platform,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from "react-native-safe-area-context";
import { useTheme } from "./ThemeContext";

/**
 * Toast types: "success" | "error" | "info" | "warning"
 *
 * Usage anywhere in the tree:
 *   const { toast } = useToast();
 *   toast.success("Logged in");
 *   toast.error("Invalid credentials");
 *   toast.info("Heads up");
 *   toast.warning("Are you sure?");
 *
 * Always prefer this over Alert.alert.
 */

const ToastContext = createContext({
  show: () => {},
  toast: { success: () => {}, error: () => {}, info: () => {}, warning: () => {} },
});

const DURATION = 3500;

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id) => {
    setQueue((q) => q.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const show = useCallback(
    (message, type = "info", opts = {}) => {
      const id = ++idRef.current;
      const toast = {
        id,
        message: String(message ?? ""),
        type,
        duration: opts.duration ?? DURATION,
      };
      setQueue((q) => [...q, toast]);
      return id;
    },
    [],
  );

  const toast = {
    success: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "success", opts),
    error: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "error", opts),
    info: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "info", opts),
    warning: (msg, opts) => show(msg, "warning", opts),
  };

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ show, toast, dismiss }}>
      {children}
      <ToastViewport queue={queue} onDismiss={dismiss} />
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

function ToastViewport({ queue, onDismiss }) {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  return (
    <View
      pointerEvents="box-none"
      style={[
        styles.viewport,
        { top: insets.top + 8 },
      ]}
    >
      {queue.map((t) => (
        <ToastItem key={t.id} toast={t} onDismiss={onDismiss} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function ToastItem({ toast, onDismiss }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const opacity = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
  const translateY = useRef(new Animated.Value(-12)).current;

  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 1,
        duration: 220,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 240,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start();

    const timer = setTimeout(handleDismiss, toast.duration);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleDismiss = () => {
    Animated.parallel([
      Animated.timing(opacity, {
        toValue: 0,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
      Animated.timing(translateY, {
        toValue: -8,
        duration: 180,
        useNativeDriver: true,
      }),
    ]).start(() => onDismiss(toast.id));
  };

  const palette = getPalette(toast.type, theme);

  return (
    <Animated.View
      style={[
        styles.toast,
        {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.bgPanel,
          borderColor: palette.border,
          shadowColor: theme.colors.shadow,
          opacity,
          transform: [{ translateY }],
        },
      ]}
    >
      <View
        style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: palette.bgIcon }]}
      >
        <Ionicons name={palette.icon} size={18} color={palette.iconColor} />
      </View>
      <Text
        style={[styles.message, { color: theme.colors.text }]}
        numberOfLines={3}
      >
        {toast.message}
      </Text>
      <TouchableOpacity
        onPress={handleDismiss}
        hitSlop={{ top: 10, bottom: 10, left: 10, right: 10 }}
      >
        <Ionicons name="close" size={18} color={theme.colors.textDim} />
      </TouchableOpacity>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}

function getPalette(type, theme) {
  switch (type) {
    case "success":
      return {
        icon: "checkmark-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.green,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.greenDim,
        border: theme.colors.greenDim,
      };
    case "error":
      return {
        icon: "alert-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.red,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.redDim,
        border: theme.colors.redDim,
      };
    case "warning":
      return {
        icon: "warning",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.orangeDim,
      };
    case "info":
    default:
      return {
        icon: "information-circle",
        iconColor: theme.colors.orange,
        bgIcon: theme.colors.orangeDim,
        border: theme.colors.border,
      };
  }
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  viewport: {
    position: "absolute",
    left: 12,
    right: 12,
    zIndex: 9999,
    elevation: 9999,
    gap: 8,
  },
  toast: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingVertical: 12,
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
    gap: 12,
    ...Platform.select({
      ios: {
        shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
        shadowOpacity: 0.18,
        shadowRadius: 12,
      },
      android: { elevation: 6 },
    }),
  },
  iconWrap: {
    width: 32,
    height: 32,
    borderRadius: 16,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  message: {
    flex: 1,
    fontSize: 14,
    lineHeight: 19,
  },
});

export const useToast = () => useContext(ToastContext);

// src/i18n/index.js
import i18n from "i18next";
import { initReactI18next } from "react-i18next";
import * as Localization from "expo-localization";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";

import en from "./locales/en.json";
import es from "./locales/es.json";
import fr from "./locales/fr.json";
import ar from "./locales/ar.json";
import pt from "./locales/pt.json";
import zh from "./locales/zh.json";
import ha from "./locales/ha.json";
import yo from "./locales/yo.json";
import ig from "./locales/ig.json";

const resources = {
  en: { translation: en },
  es: { translation: es },
  fr: { translation: fr },
  ar: { translation: ar },
  pt: { translation: pt },
  zh: { translation: zh },
  ha: { translation: ha },
  yo: { translation: yo },
  ig: { translation: ig },
};

const LANG_KEY = "@skilledproz:lang";

export async function initI18n() {
  let savedLang = null;
  try {
    savedLang = await AsyncStorage.getItem(LANG_KEY);
  } catch {}

  const deviceLang = Localization.getLocales()[0]?.languageCode || "en";
  // Fall back to "en" if device language has no locale file
  const supported = Object.keys(resources);
  const lng =
    savedLang && supported.includes(savedLang)
      ? savedLang
      : supported.includes(deviceLang)
        ? deviceLang
        : "en";

  await i18n.use(initReactI18next).init({
    resources,
    lng,
    fallbackLng: "en",
    interpolation: { escapeValue: false },
    react: { useSuspense: false },
    compatibilityJSON: "v3",
  });

  return i18n;
}

export async function changeLanguage(code) {
  await i18n.changeLanguage(code);
  try {
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(LANG_KEY, code);
  } catch {}
}

export default i18n;

# ── end of src/i18n/index.js ────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/navigation/AuthNavigator.js
import React from "react";
import { createNativeStackNavigator } from "@react-navigation/native-stack";

import LoginScreen from "../screens/auth/LoginScreen";
import WelcomeScreen from "../screens/auth/WelcomeScreen";
import RegisterScreen from "../screens/auth/RegisterScreen";
import ForgotPasswordScreen from "../screens/auth/ForgotPasswordScreen";

const Stack = createNativeStackNavigator();

export default function AuthNavigator() {
  return (
    <Stack.Navigator
      screenOptions={{
        headerShown: false,
        contentStyle: { backgroundColor: "transparent" },
        animation: "slide_from_right",
      }}
      initialRouteName="Login"
    >
      <Stack.Screen name="Login" component={LoginScreen} />
      <Stack.Screen name="Welcome" component={WelcomeScreen} />
      <Stack.Screen name="Register" component={RegisterScreen} />
      <Stack.Screen name="ForgotPassword" component={ForgotPasswordScreen} />
      {/* VerifyEmail is no longer here — RootNavigator routes the user to
          VerifyGate automatically when they're signed in but unverified. */}
    </Stack.Navigator>
  );
}

// src/navigation/RootNavigator.js
import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import { View, ActivityIndicator, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import {
  NavigationContainer,
  DarkTheme,
  DefaultTheme,
} from "@react-navigation/native";
import { createNativeStackNavigator } from "@react-navigation/native-stack";

import AuthNavigator from "./AuthNavigator";
import HirerNavigator from "./HirerNavigator";
import VerifyEmailScreen from "../screens/auth/VerifyEmailScreen";
import { useAuthStore } from "../store/authStore";
import { useTheme } from "../contexts/ThemeContext";

const VerifyStack = createNativeStackNavigator();

/**
 * VerifyGate — a one-screen stack shown when the user is signed in but their
 * email is not yet verified. Wrapping it in a stack (rather than rendering the
 * screen bare) keeps useNavigation() working inside VerifyEmailScreen.
 */
function VerifyGate() {
  return (
    <VerifyStack.Navigator screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }}>
      <VerifyStack.Screen name="VerifyEmail" component={VerifyEmailScreen} />
    </VerifyStack.Navigator>
  );
}

export default function RootNavigator() {
  const { user, isHydrated, hydrate } = useAuthStore();
  const { theme, effectiveMode } = useTheme();

  useEffect(() => {
    hydrate();
  }, []);

  if (!isHydrated) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.loading, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.bg }]}>
        <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={theme.colors.orange} />
      </View>
    );
  }

  // Build a navigation theme that matches our colors so back gestures and
  // page transitions don't show a white flash.
  const navTheme = {
    ...(effectiveMode === "light" ? DefaultTheme : DarkTheme),
    colors: {
      ...(effectiveMode === "light" ? DefaultTheme.colors : DarkTheme.colors),
      background: theme.colors.bg,
      card: theme.colors.bgPanel,
      text: theme.colors.text,
      border: theme.colors.border,
      primary: theme.colors.orange,
    },
  };

  // Three-way routing — no manual navigation needed. State drives which stack
  // renders. After register, user is set but isEmailVerified is false, so we
  // land on the VerifyGate automatically. Once /auth/me reports verified,
  // we swap into HirerNavigator with no extra navigation code.
  let stack;
  if (!user) {
    stack = <AuthNavigator />;
  } else if (!user.isEmailVerified) {
    stack = <VerifyGate />;
  } else {
    stack = <HirerNavigator />;
  }

  return <NavigationContainer theme={navTheme}>{stack}</NavigationContainer>;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  loading: { flex: 1, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" },
});

// src/screens/auth/ForgotPasswordScreen.js
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppInput from "../../components/AppInput";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { isEmail } from "../../utils/validators";

export default function ForgotPasswordScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { forgotPassword } = useAuthStore();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError("");
    if (!isEmail(email)) {
      setError(t("auth.validEmailRequired"));
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await forgotPassword(email.trim().toLowerCase());
      toast.success(t("auth.resetLinkSent"));
      navigation.navigate("Login");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen>
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Pressable onPress={() => navigation.goBack()} style={styles.backRow} hitSlop={6}>
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={theme.colors.text} />
          <AppText variant="body" weight="medium" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
            {t("common.back")}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        <View style={{ height: 40 }} />

        <AppText variant="display" weight="displayBlack">
          {t("auth.forgotPasswordTitle")}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="subtitle" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 24 }}>
          {t("auth.forgotPasswordBody")}
        </AppText>

        <AppInput
          label={t("auth.emailAddress")}
          iconLeft="mail-outline"
          placeholder={t("auth.emailPlaceholder")}
          value={email}
          onChangeText={setEmail}
          keyboardType="email-address"
          autoComplete="email"
          textContentType="emailAddress"
          error={error}
        />

        <AppButton
          title={t("auth.sendResetLink")}
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          loading={loading}
          style={{ marginTop: 16 }}
        />

        <View style={styles.bottomRow}>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
            {t("auth.rememberPassword")}{" "}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Login")} hitSlop={6}>
            <AppText variant="body" tone="brand" weight="semibold">
              {t("auth.signIn")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { gap: 12 },
  backRow: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", marginTop: 4 },
  bottomRow: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    justifyContent: "center",
    marginTop: 24,
  },
});

// src/screens/auth/LoginScreen.js
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppInput from "../../components/AppInput";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { isEmail, isNonEmpty } from "../../utils/validators";

export default function LoginScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { login, isLoading } = useAuthStore();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const validate = () => {
    const e = {};
    if (!isNonEmpty(email)) e.email = t("auth.emailRequired");
    else if (!isEmail(email)) e.email = t("auth.validEmailRequired");
    if (!isNonEmpty(password)) e.password = t("auth.fillAllFields");
    setErrors(e);
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!validate()) return;
    try {
      const user = await login(email.trim().toLowerCase(), password);
      toast.success(t("auth.loginSuccess"));
      // Navigation is driven by RootNavigator listening to auth state
      // No manual navigation needed.
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message || t("auth.invalidCredentials"));
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen>
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={styles.heroSpacer} />

        <AppText variant="label" tone="brand">
          {t("auth.welcomeBack")}
        </AppText>

        <AppText variant="display" weight="displayBlack" style={styles.title}>
          {t("auth.signInTitle")}
        </AppText>

        <View style={styles.subRow}>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
            {t("auth.noAccountYet")}{" "}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Welcome")} hitSlop={6}>
            <AppText variant="body" tone="brand" weight="semibold">
              {t("auth.createOneFree")} →
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        <View style={styles.form}>
          <AppInput
            label={t("auth.emailAddress")}
            iconLeft="mail-outline"
            placeholder={t("auth.emailPlaceholder")}
            value={email}
            onChangeText={setEmail}
            keyboardType="email-address"
            autoComplete="email"
            textContentType="emailAddress"
            error={errors.email}
          />

          <AppInput
            label={t("auth.password")}
            iconLeft="lock-closed-outline"
            placeholder={t("auth.passwordMinChars")}
            value={password}
            onChangeText={setPassword}
            secureTextEntry
            autoComplete="password"
            textContentType="password"
            rightActionLabel={t("auth.forgot")}
            onRightActionPress={() => navigation.navigate("ForgotPassword")}
            error={errors.password}
          />

          <AppButton
            title={isLoading ? t("auth.signingIn") : t("auth.signIn")}
            onPress={handleSubmit}
            loading={isLoading}
            style={styles.cta}
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { gap: 12, paddingTop: 8 },
  heroSpacer: { height: 60 },
  title: { marginTop: 8, marginBottom: 4 },
  subRow: { flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", marginBottom: 24 },
  form: { gap: 16 },
  cta: { marginTop: 8 },
});

// src/screens/auth/RegisterScreen.js
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { View, Pressable, StyleSheet } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppInput from "../../components/AppInput";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import {
  isEmail,
  isNonEmpty,
  isStrongEnoughPassword,
} from "../../utils/validators";

export default function RegisterScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { register, isLoading } = useAuthStore();

  const role = route.params?.role || "HIRER";

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    firstName: "",
    lastName: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    country: "",
    city: "",
    password: "",
    confirm: "",
  });
  const [agree, setAgree] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const update = (key) => (value) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));

  const validate = () => {
    const e = {};
    if (!isNonEmpty(form.firstName)) e.firstName = t("auth.fillAllFields");
    if (!isNonEmpty(form.lastName)) e.lastName = t("auth.fillAllFields");
    if (!isNonEmpty(form.email)) e.email = t("auth.emailRequired");
    else if (!isEmail(form.email)) e.email = t("auth.validEmailRequired");
    if (!isStrongEnoughPassword(form.password))
      e.password = t("auth.passwordTooShort");
    if (form.password !== form.confirm)
      e.confirm = t("auth.passwordsDontMatch");
    setErrors(e);

    if (!agree) {
      toast.warning(t("auth.mustAgreeTerms"));
      return false;
    }
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!validate()) return;

    try {
      await register({
        firstName: form.firstName.trim(),
        lastName: form.lastName.trim(),
        email: form.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
        phone: form.phone.trim() || undefined,
        country: form.country.trim() || undefined,
        city: form.city.trim() || undefined,
        password: form.password,
        role, // "HIRER"
      });
      toast.success(t("auth.registerSuccess"));
      // No manual navigation — RootNavigator sees the new (unverified) user
      // and swaps to the VerifyGate automatically.
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen>
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          style={styles.backRow}
          hitSlop={6}
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={theme.colors.text} />
          <AppText variant="body" weight="medium" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
            {t("common.back")}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>

        <AppText variant="label" tone="brand" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          {t("auth.hirerAccount")}
        </AppText>

        <AppText variant="display" weight="displayBlack" style={styles.title}>
          {t("auth.findNextProz")}
        </AppText>

        <View style={styles.form}>
          <View style={styles.row2}>
            <View style={styles.col}>
              <AppInput

// src/screens/auth/VerifyEmailScreen.js
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { View, StyleSheet, AppState } from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";

/**
 * Mounted by RootNavigator when user is signed in but isEmailVerified === false.
 *
 *  - "Resend email" calls /auth/resend-verification
 *  - "I've verified" calls /auth/me; once the server flips the flag,
 *    RootNavigator auto-swaps to HirerNavigator (no navigation.navigate needed).
 *  - Also polls every 8s while the screen is focused, and fires fetchMe
 *    whenever the app returns to foreground (typical post-email-tap flow).
 */
export default function VerifyEmailScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user, resendVerification, fetchMe, logout } = useAuthStore();

  const email = user?.email || "";
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const pollRef = useRef(null);

  // Poll every 8s while mounted
  useEffect(() => {
    pollRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      fetchMe().catch(() => {});
    }, 8000);
    return () => clearInterval(pollRef.current);
  }, [fetchMe]);

  // Re-check immediately when the app comes back to foreground
  useEffect(() => {
    const sub = AppState.addEventListener("change", (state) => {
      if (state === "active") fetchMe().catch(() => {});
    });
    return () => sub.remove();
  }, [fetchMe]);

  const handleResend = async () => {
    if (!email) {
      toast.error(t("auth.emailRequired"));
      return;
    }
    setSending(true);
    try {
      await resendVerification(email);
      toast.success(t("auth.verificationResent"));
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err.message);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCheck = async () => {
    setChecking(true);
    try {
      const u = await fetchMe();
      if (!u?.isEmailVerified) {
        toast.info(t("auth.notVerifiedYet"));
      }
      // If verified, RootNavigator unmounts this screen automatically.
    } finally {
      setChecking(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen>
      <View style={styles.container}>
        <View style={{ height: 40 }} />

        <View
          style={[
            styles.iconBubble,
            { backgroundColor: theme.colors.orangeDim },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons
            name="mail-open-outline"
            size={36}
            color={theme.colors.orange}
          />
        </View>

        <AppText
          variant="displaySm"
          weight="displayBlack"
          style={{ marginTop: 24 }}
        >
          {t("auth.verifyEmailTitle")}
        </AppText>

        <AppText variant="subtitle" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          {t("auth.verifyEmailBody", { email: email || "your inbox" })}
        </AppText>

        <View style={styles.actions}>
          <AppButton
            title={checking ? t("auth.checking") : t("auth.iVerified")}
            iconLeft={checking ? undefined : "checkmark-circle-outline"}
            onPress={handleCheck}
            loading={checking}
          />

          <AppButton
            title={sending ? t("auth.resending") : t("auth.resend")}
            variant="secondary"
            iconLeft={sending ? undefined : "refresh"}
            onPress={handleResend}
            loading={sending}
          />

          <AppButton
            title={t("auth.signOut")}
            variant="ghost"
            onPress={async () => {
              await logout();
              toast.info(t("auth.logoutSuccess"));
            }}
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: { gap: 8, alignItems: "flex-start" },
  iconBubble: {
    width: 72,
    height: 72,
    borderRadius: 20,
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
  },
  actions: { width: "100%", gap: 12, marginTop: 32 },
});

const TIMELINE_STEPS = ["Pending", "Accepted", "In Progress", "Completed"];

function formatDuration(booking) {
  if (!booking) return null;
  const unit = booking.estimatedUnit || "hours";
  const value = booking.estimatedValue;
  const hours = booking.estimatedHours;
  if (!value && !hours) return null;
  if (value) {
    if (unit === "custom") return { main: value, sub: null };
    const labels = {
      hours: "hour",
      days: "day",
      weeks: "week",
      months: "month",
    };
    const num = parseFloat(value);
    const label = (labels[unit] || unit) + (num !== 1 ? "s" : "");
    const eqv = unit !== "hours" && hours ? `≈ ${hours}h` : null;
    return { main: `${num} ${label}`, sub: eqv };
  }
  return hours ? { main: `${hours} hours`, sub: null } : null;
}

function calcEstTotal(booking) {
  const rate = booking.agreedRate;
  const unit = booking.estimatedUnit;
  const value = booking.estimatedValue;
  if (!rate || !value || !unit || unit === "custom") return null;
  const num = parseFloat(value);
  const suffix =
    { hours: "/hr", days: "/day", weeks: "/wk", months: "/mo" }[unit] || "";
  return {
    num,
    unit,
    rate,
    total: num * rate,
    currency: booking.currency,
    suffix,
  };
}

// ─── Timeline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Timeline({ step, c }) {
  if (step < 0) return null;
  return (
    <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
      <View style={styles.timeline}>
        {TIMELINE_STEPS.map((label, i) => {
          const done = i < step;
          const current = i === step;
          return (
            <View key={label} style={styles.timelineItem}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.timelineDot,
                  {
                    borderColor: done || current ? "#f97316" : c.border,
                    backgroundColor: done
                      ? "#f97316"
                      : current
                        ? c.bgCard
                        : c.bgCard,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {done ? (
                  <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={12} color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{
                      color: current ? "#f97316" : c.textMuted,
                      fontSize: 11,
                    }}
                  >
                    {i + 1}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{
                  color: done || current ? c.text : c.textMuted,
                  fontSize: 10,
                  marginTop: 4,
                  textAlign: "center",
                }}
              >
                {label}
              </AppText>
              {i < TIMELINE_STEPS.length - 1 && (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.timelineLine,
                    { backgroundColor: i < step ? "#f97316" : c.border },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </Card>
  );
}
