export default function BookingDetailScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const bookingId = route.params?.bookingId;

  const [booking, setBooking] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
  const [showCancel, setShowCancel] = useState(false);
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState("");
  const [cancelError, setCancelError] = useState("");
  const [payMethod, setPayMethod] = useState("card"); // "card"|"bank"|"crypto"
  const [selectedCrypto, setSelectedCrypto] = useState("USDC");
  const [showInsurance, setShowInsurance] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPlan, setSelectedPlan] = useState("standard");
  const [insuranceLoading, setInsuranceLoading] = useState(false);
  const [pendingSession, setPendingSession] = useState(null); // Stripe sessionId after checkout opens
  const [payLoading, setPayLoading] = useState(false);
  const [pendingPayRef, setPendingPayRef] = useState(null); // { gateway, ref }
  // Bank transfer state
  const [bankDetails, setBankDetails] = useState(null); // step 1 response
  const [showBankConfirm, setShowBankConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [bankConfirmForm, setBankConfirmForm] = useState({
    senderName: "",
    bankName: "",
  });
  // Crypto state
  const [cryptoDetails, setCryptoDetails] = useState(null); // step 1 response
  const [showCryptoConfirm, setShowCryptoConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [cryptoConfirmForm, setCryptoConfirmForm] = useState({
    txHash: "",
    cryptoAmount: "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!bookingId) return;
    getBooking(bookingId)
      .then(setBooking)
      .catch(() => toast.error(t("toast.networkError")))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [bookingId]);

  const doStatus = async (status, extra = {}) => {
    setActing(true);
    try {
      const updated = await updateBookingStatus(bookingId, status, extra);
      setBooking(updated);
      toast.success(`Booking ${status.toLowerCase().replace("_", " ")}.`);
      setShowCancel(false);
      setCancelReason("");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setActing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    if (!cancelReason.trim()) {
      setCancelError(t("bookings.cancelReasonRequired"));
      return;
    }
    doStatus("CANCELLED", { cancelReason: cancelReason.trim() });
  };

  if (loading)
    return (
      <AppScreen scrollable={false}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );

  if (!booking)
    return (
      <AppScreen scrollable={false}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={40} color={c.red} />
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            {t("bookings.notFound")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );

  const meta = STATUS_META[booking.status] ?? STATUS_META.PENDING;
  const step = meta.step ?? 0;
  const isHirer = user?.id === booking.hirerId;
  const other = isHirer ? booking.worker : booking.hirer;
  const dur = formatDuration(booking);
  const estTotal = calcEstTotal(booking);
  const scheduled = new Date(booking.scheduledAt);
  const canCancel = ["PENDING", "ACCEPTED"].includes(booking.status);

  return (
    <AppScreen contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
      {/* Back */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
        style={styles.backBtn}
        hitSlop={8}
      >
        <Ionicons
          name="arrow-back"
          size={16}
          color={c.text}
          style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
        />
        <AppText variant="small">{t("bookings.backToBookings")}</AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ── TITLE BLOCK ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <View style={styles.titleRow}>
          <AppText
            variant="display"
            weight="displayBlack"
            style={{ flex: 1, lineHeight: 36 }}
          >
            {booking.title}
          </AppText>
          <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: meta.bg }]}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: meta.color }}
            >
              {booking.status.replace("_", " ")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
        {booking.category && (
          <View style={[styles.catChip, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {booking.category.name}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ── TIMELINE ── */}
      <Timeline step={step} c={c} />

      {/* ── DESCRIPTION ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={styles.sectionLabel}
        >
          {t("bookings.description").toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 22 }}>
          {booking.description}
        </AppText>
        {booking.notes && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.notesBox,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small">📝</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8, lineHeight: 20 }}
            >
              {booking.notes}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ── JOB DETAILS ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={styles.sectionLabel}
        >
          {t("bookings.jobDetails").toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.detailGrid}>
          <DetailCell
            icon="📅"
            label={t("bookings.scheduled")}
            value={`${scheduled.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { weekday: "short", day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" })} at ${scheduled.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}`}
            c={c}
          />
          {booking.address && (
            <DetailCell
              icon="📍"
              label={t("bookings.address")}
              value={booking.address}
              c={c}
            />
          )}
          <DetailCell
            icon="💰"
            label={t("bookings.agreedRate")}
            value={`${booking.currency} ${Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}`}
            accent
            c={c}
          />
          {dur && (
            <DetailCell
              icon="⏱️"
              label={t("bookings.duration")}
              value={dur.sub ? `${dur.main} ${dur.sub}` : dur.main}
              c={c}
            />
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Estimated total */}
        {estTotal && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.totalRow,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Est. Total ({estTotal.num} {estTotal.unit} × {estTotal.currency}{" "}
              {Number(estTotal.rate).toLocaleString()}
              {estTotal.suffix})
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="title"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 4 }}
            >
              {estTotal.currency} {Number(estTotal.total).toLocaleString()}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ── PAYMENT ── */}
      {booking.payment && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            tone="dim"
            style={styles.sectionLabel}
          >
            {t("bookings.payment").toUpperCase()}
          </AppText>
          {[
            {
              label: "Total",
              value: `${booking.payment.currency} ${Number(booking.payment.amount).toLocaleString()}`,
            },
            {
              label: "Platform Fee",
              value: `${booking.payment.currency} ${Number(booking.payment.platformFee).toLocaleString()}`,
              muted: true,
            },
            {
              label: "Worker Payout",
              value: `${booking.payment.currency} ${Number(booking.payment.workerPayout).toLocaleString()}`,
              green: true,
            },
            { label: "Status", value: booking.payment.status },
            { label: "Provider", value: booking.payment.provider },
          ].map((row) => (
            <View
              key={row.label}
              style={[styles.payRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
                {row.label}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: row.green
                    ? "#22c55e"
                    : row.muted
                      ? c.textMuted
                      : c.text,
                }}
              >
                {row.value}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ── Cancellation reason ── */}
      {booking.cancelReason && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.cancelReasonBox,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.08)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small">⚠️</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8 }}
            >
              {booking.cancelReason}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ── WORKER / HIRER CARD ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={[styles.sectionLabel, { textAlign: "center" }]}
        >
          {(isHirer ? t("bookings.worker") : t("bookings.hirer")).toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.partyBody}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.partyAvatar,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            {other?.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: other.avatar }}
                style={styles.partyAvatarImg}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {other?.firstName?.[0]}
                {other?.lastName?.[0]}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            {other?.firstName} {other?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          {other?.phone && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => Linking.openURL(`tel:${other.phone}`)}
              style={styles.phoneRow}
            >
              <AppText variant="small">📱</AppText>
              <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                {other.phone}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("Profile", { userId: other?.id })
            }
            style={[
              styles.viewProfileBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {t("profile.myProfile")} →
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.viewProfileBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                marginTop: 8,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() => toast.info("Messages coming soon")}
          >
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              💬 {t("bookings.sendMessage")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </Card>

      {/* ── PAYMENT BREAKDOWN + OPTIONS (hirer ACCEPTED, no payment yet) ── */}
      {isHirer && booking.status === "ACCEPTED" && !booking.payment && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          {/* Breakdown */}
          <View style={styles.breakdownHeader}>
            <AppText variant="small">💰</AppText>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
              {t("bookings.breakdown")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          {[
            {
              label: t("bookings.agreedRateLabel"),
              value: `${booking.currency} ${Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}${estTotal ? estTotal.suffix : ""}`,
            },
            ...(estTotal
              ? [
                  {
                    label: t("bookings.durationLabel"),
                    value: `${estTotal.num} ${estTotal.unit}`,
                  },
                ]
              : []),
            ...(estTotal
              ? [
                  {
                    label: `Subtotal (${estTotal.num} × ${booking.currency} ${Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()})`,
                    value: `${booking.currency} ${Number(estTotal.total).toLocaleString()}`,
                  },
                ]
              : []),
            {
              label: t("bookings.platformFee"),
              value: `– ${booking.currency} ${Number((estTotal?.total ?? booking.agreedRate) * 0.1).toLocaleString()}`,
              muted: true,
            },
          ].map((row) => (
            <View
              key={row.label}
              style={[styles.payRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" tone={row.muted ? "dim" : "default"}>
                {row.label}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: row.muted ? c.textMuted : c.text }}
              >
                {row.value}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}
          <View style={[styles.youPayRow, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              {t("bookings.youPay")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="display"
              weight="displayBlack"
              style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 28 }}
            >
              {booking.currency}{" "}
              {Number(
                (estTotal?.total ?? booking.agreedRate) * 1.1,
              ).toLocaleString()}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Payment method toggle */}
          <View style={[styles.methodRow, { marginTop: 16 }]}>
            {[
              { id: "card", label: "💳 " + t("bookings.payWithCard") },
              { id: "bank", label: "🏦 " + t("bookings.bankTransfer") },
              { id: "crypto", label: "₿ " + t("bookings.cryptoPay") },
            ].map((m) => (
              <Pressable
                key={m.id}
                onPress={() => setPayMethod(m.id)}
                style={[
                  styles.methodBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: payMethod === m.id ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: payMethod === m.id ? c.orange : c.border,
                    flex: 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: payMethod === m.id ? "#fff" : c.text }}
                >
                  {m.label}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>

          {/* ── CARD ── */}
          {payMethod === "card" &&
            (!pendingPayRef ? (
              <Pressable
                style={[
                  styles.bigBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: payLoading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                    marginTop: 14,
                    opacity: payLoading ? 0.7 : 1,
                  },
                ]}
                disabled={payLoading}
                onPress={async () => {
                  setPayLoading(true);
                  try {
                    const data = await initiatePayment(booking.id);
                    if (data.alreadyPaid) {
                      toast.info("Payment already in escrow.");
                      const updated = await getBooking(bookingId);
                      setBooking(updated);
                      return;
                    }
                    if (data.authorizationUrl) {
                      setPendingPayRef({
                        gateway: "paystack",
                        ref: data.reference,
                      });
                      await Linking.openURL(data.authorizationUrl);
                      return;
                    }
                    if (data.clientSecret) {
                      const checkout = await initiateStripeCheckout(booking.id);
                      setPendingPayRef({
                        gateway: "stripe_checkout",
                        ref: checkout.sessionId,
                      });
                      await Linking.openURL(checkout.url);
                      return;
                    }
                  } catch (err) {
                    toast.error(
                      err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.unknownError"),
                    );
                  } finally {
                    setPayLoading(false);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {payLoading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    💳 {t("bookings.payWithCard")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
            ) : (
              <View style={{ gap: 8, marginTop: 14 }}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.bigBtn,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.08)",
                      borderColor: "#22c55e",
                      borderWidth: 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ textAlign: "center" }}
                  >
                    Complete payment in your browser, then tap Verify.
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <Pressable
                  style={[styles.bigBtn, { backgroundColor: "#22c55e" }]}
                  disabled={payLoading}
                  onPress={async () => {
                    setPayLoading(true);
                    try {
                      if (pendingPayRef.gateway === "paystack") {
                        await verifyPaystackPayment(pendingPayRef.ref);
                      }
                      toast.success(t("bookings.paymentVerified"));
                      setPendingPayRef(null);
                      const updated = await getBooking(bookingId);
                      setBooking(updated);
                    } catch {
                      toast.error(
                        "Not confirmed yet — wait a moment and retry.",
                      );
                    } finally {
                      setPayLoading(false);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  {payLoading ? (
                    <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                  ) : (
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                    >
                      ✓ Verify Payment
                    </AppText>
                  )}
                </Pressable>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => setPendingPayRef(null)}
                  style={{ alignItems: "center" }}
                >
                  <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                    ← Start over
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            ))}

          {/* ── BANK TRANSFER ── */}
          {payMethod === "bank" && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.bankBox,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              {/* Step 0: Get bank details button */}
              {!bankDetails && (
                <>
                  <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                    {t("bookings.bankTransfer")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
                    {t("bookings.bankNote")}
                  </AppText>
                  <Pressable
                    style={[
                      styles.bigBtn,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: payLoading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                        marginTop: 12,
                        opacity: payLoading ? 0.7 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                    disabled={payLoading}
                    onPress={async () => {
                      setPayLoading(true);
                      try {
                        // POST /payments/bank-transfer/:bookingId
                        // → { reference, totalToSend, bankDetails:{ bankName, accountNumber, accountName, currency, narration } }
                        const data = await initiateBankTransfer(booking.id);
                        setBankDetails(data);
                        setShowBankConfirm(false);
                      } catch (err) {
                        toast.error(
                          err?.response?.data?.message ||
                            t("toast.unknownError"),
                        );
                      } finally {
                        setPayLoading(false);
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    {payLoading ? (
                      <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                    ) : (
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                      >
                        🏦 {t("bookings.initiateBankTransfer")}
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                </>
              )}

              {/* Step 1: Show bank details */}
              {bankDetails && !showBankConfirm && (
                <>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
                  >
                    🏦 Bank Details
                  </AppText>
                  {[
                    {
                      label: "Bank Name",
                      value: bankDetails.bankDetails?.bankName,
                    },
                    {
                      label: "Account Name",
                      value: bankDetails.bankDetails?.accountName,
                    },
                    {
                      label: "Account No.",
                      value: bankDetails.bankDetails?.accountNumber,
                    },
                    {
                      label: "Amount to Send",
                      value: `${bankDetails.bankDetails?.currency} ${Number(bankDetails.totalToSend).toLocaleString()}`,
                    },
                    {
                      label: "Narration/Ref",
                      value: bankDetails.bankDetails?.narration,
                    },
                  ].map((row) => (
                    <View
                      key={row.label}
                      style={[styles.payRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
                    >
                      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                        {row.label}
                      </AppText>
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: "right" }}
                        numberOfLines={2}
                      >
                        {row.value}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                  <Pressable
                    style={[
                      styles.bigBtn,
                      { backgroundColor: c.orange, marginTop: 14 },
                    ]}
                    onPress={() => setShowBankConfirm(true)}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                    >
                      ✅ I Have Transferred
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => setBankDetails(null)}
                    style={{ alignItems: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      ← Change method
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </>
              )}

              {/* Step 2: Confirm form */}
              {bankDetails && showBankConfirm && (
                <>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
                  >
                    Confirm Your Transfer
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
                  >
                    Sender Name (optional)
                  </AppText>
                  <TextInput
                    value={bankConfirmForm.senderName}
                    onChangeText={(v) =>
                      setBankConfirmForm((f) => ({ ...f, senderName: v }))
                    }
                    placeholder="Your name on the transfer"
                    placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                    style={[
                      styles.cancelInput,
                      {
                        color: c.text,
                        borderColor: c.border,
                        backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                        marginBottom: 10,
                      },
                    ]}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
                  >
                    Your Bank Name (optional)
                  </AppText>
                  <TextInput
                    value={bankConfirmForm.bankName}
                    onChangeText={(v) =>
                      setBankConfirmForm((f) => ({ ...f, bankName: v }))
                    }
                    placeholder="e.g. GTBank"
                    placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                    style={[
                      styles.cancelInput,
                      {
                        color: c.text,
                        borderColor: c.border,
                        backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                        marginBottom: 10,
                      },
                    ]}
                  />
                  <Pressable
                    style={[
                      styles.bigBtn,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: payLoading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                        opacity: payLoading ? 0.7 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                    disabled={payLoading}
                    onPress={async () => {
                      setPayLoading(true);
                      try {
                        // PATCH /payments/bank-transfer/:bookingId/confirm
                        await confirmBankTransfer(booking.id, {
                          reference: bankDetails.reference,
                          senderName: bankConfirmForm.senderName || undefined,
                          bankName: bankConfirmForm.bankName || undefined,
                        });
                        toast.success(
                          "Transfer confirmed! We'll verify within 1–2 hours.",
                        );
                        setBankDetails(null);
                        setShowBankConfirm(false);
                        setBankConfirmForm({ senderName: "", bankName: "" });
                      } catch (err) {
                        toast.error(
                          err?.response?.data?.message ||
                            t("toast.unknownError"),
                        );
                      } finally {
                        setPayLoading(false);
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    {payLoading ? (
                      <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                    ) : (
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                      >
                        Submit Confirmation
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => setShowBankConfirm(false)}
                    style={{ alignItems: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      ← Back to bank details
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </>
              )}
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Crypto payment */}
          {payMethod === "crypto" && (
            <View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                {t("bookings.cryptoNote")}
              </AppText>
              <View style={styles.cryptoGrid}>
                {CRYPTO_OPTIONS.map((coin) => (
                  <Pressable
                    key={coin.id}
                    onPress={() => setSelectedCrypto(coin.id)}
                    style={[
                      styles.cryptoCard,
                      {
                        borderColor:
                          selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orange : c.border,
                        backgroundColor:
                          selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="title"
                      style={{
                        color:
                          selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                      }}
                    >
                      {coin.icon}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{
                        color: selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orange : c.text,
                        marginTop: 6,
                      }}
                    >
                      {coin.label}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      {coin.sub}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                ))}
              </View>
              {/* Step 0 — Pay button */}
              {!cryptoDetails && (
                <Pressable
                  style={[
                    styles.bigBtn,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: payLoading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                      marginTop: 14,
                      opacity: payLoading ? 0.7 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                  disabled={payLoading}
                  onPress={async () => {
                    setPayLoading(true);
                    try {
                      // POST /payments/crypto/:bookingId { cryptoCurrency }
                      const data = await initiateCrypto(
                        booking.id,
                        selectedCrypto,
                      );
                      setCryptoDetails(data);
                    } catch (err) {
                      toast.error(
                        err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.unknownError"),
                      );
                    } finally {
                      setPayLoading(false);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  {payLoading ? (
                    <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                  ) : (
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                    >
                      ◆ {t("bookings.payWith", { coin: selectedCrypto })}
                    </AppText>
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              )}

              {/* Step 1 — Wallet details */}
              {cryptoDetails && !showCryptoConfirm && (
                <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
                  >
                    Send {cryptoDetails.cryptoDetails?.currency} to this wallet
                  </AppText>
                  {[
                    {
                      label: "Network",
                      value: cryptoDetails.cryptoDetails?.network,
                    },
                    {
                      label: "Wallet",
                      value: cryptoDetails.cryptoDetails?.wallet,
                    },
                    {
                      label: "Amount",
                      value: `${booking.currency} ${Number(cryptoDetails.totalToSend).toLocaleString()}`,
                    },
                    { label: "Reference", value: cryptoDetails.reference },
                    { label: "Note", value: cryptoDetails.cryptoDetails?.note },
                  ]
                    .filter((r) => r.value)
                    .map((row) => (
                      <View
                        key={row.label}
                        style={[styles.payRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
                      >
                        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                          {row.label}
                        </AppText>
                        <AppText
                          variant="body"
                          weight="semibold"
                          style={{
                            flex: 1,
                            textAlign: "right",
                            fontSize: row.label === "Wallet" ? 11 : 14,
                          }}
                          numberOfLines={2}
                        >
                          {row.value}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    ))}
                  <Pressable
                    style={[
                      styles.bigBtn,
                      { backgroundColor: c.orange, marginTop: 14 },
                    ]}
                    onPress={() => setShowCryptoConfirm(true)}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                    >
                      ✅ I Have Sent the Crypto
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => setCryptoDetails(null)}
                    style={{ alignItems: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      ← Change coin
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              )}

              {/* Step 2 — Submit tx hash */}
              {cryptoDetails && showCryptoConfirm && (
                <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
                  >
                    Submit Transaction Hash
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
                  >
                    Transaction Hash *
                  </AppText>
                  <TextInput
                    value={cryptoConfirmForm.txHash}
                    onChangeText={(v) =>
                      setCryptoConfirmForm((f) => ({ ...f, txHash: v }))
                    }
                    placeholder="0x... or your tx ID"
                    placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                    style={[
                      styles.cancelInput,
                      {
                        color: c.text,
                        borderColor: c.border,
                        backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                        marginBottom: 10,
                      },
                    ]}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
                  >
                    Amount Sent (optional)
                  </AppText>
                  <TextInput
                    value={cryptoConfirmForm.cryptoAmount}
                    onChangeText={(v) =>
                      setCryptoConfirmForm((f) => ({ ...f, cryptoAmount: v }))
                    }
                    placeholder="e.g. 5.00"
                    placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                    keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                    style={[
                      styles.cancelInput,
                      {
                        color: c.text,
                        borderColor: c.border,
                        backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                        marginBottom: 10,
                      },
                    ]}
                  />
                  <Pressable
                    style={[
                      styles.bigBtn,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: payLoading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                        opacity: payLoading ? 0.7 : 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                    disabled={payLoading || !cryptoConfirmForm.txHash.trim()}
                    onPress={async () => {
                      setPayLoading(true);
                      try {
                        await confirmCrypto(booking.id, {
                          txHash: cryptoConfirmForm.txHash.trim(),
                          cryptoCurrency: selectedCrypto,
                          reference: cryptoDetails.reference,
                          cryptoAmount:
                            cryptoConfirmForm.cryptoAmount || undefined,
                        });
                        toast.success(
                          "Submitted! We'll verify on-chain within 30 minutes.",
                        );
                        setCryptoDetails(null);
                        setShowCryptoConfirm(false);
                        setCryptoConfirmForm({ txHash: "", cryptoAmount: "" });
                      } catch (err) {
                        toast.error(
                          err?.response?.data?.message ||
                            t("toast.unknownError"),
                        );
                      } finally {
                        setPayLoading(false);
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    {payLoading ? (
                      <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                    ) : (
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                      >
                        Submit Transaction
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => setShowCryptoConfirm(false)}
                    style={{ alignItems: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      ← Back to wallet details
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              )}

              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
              >
                {t("bookings.escrowNote")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Insurance addon */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setShowInsurance((v) => !v)}
            style={[
              styles.insuranceToggle,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View
              style={[styles.insuranceShield, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body">🛡️</AppText>
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                {t("bookings.insurance.title")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t("bookings.insurance.subtitle")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
              {showInsurance ? "▲" : "▼"}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>

          {showInsurance && (
            <View style={[styles.insurancePlans, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
              >
                {t("bookings.insurance.choosePlan")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                {t("bookings.insurance.planNote")}
              </AppText>
              {INSURANCE_PLANS.map((plan) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={plan.id}
                  onPress={() => setSelectedPlan(plan.id)}
                  style={[
                    styles.planCard,
                    {
                      borderColor:
                        selectedPlan === plan.id ? c.orange : c.border,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                      marginBottom: 12,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  {plan.popular && (
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.popularBadge,
                        { backgroundColor: c.orange },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 10 }}
                      >
                        {t("bookings.insurance.mostPopular")}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  )}
                  <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                    {plan.name}
                  </AppText>
                  <View
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "baseline",
                      gap: 4,
                      marginTop: 6,
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      USD
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText
                      variant="display"
                      weight="displayBlack"
                      style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 32 }}
                    >
                      ${plan.price}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
                  >
                    Covers up to {plan.covers}
                  </AppText>
                  {plan.features.map((f) => (
                    <View key={f} style={styles.featureRow}>
                      <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
                        ✓
                      </AppText>
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        tone="dim"
                        style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
                      >
                        {f}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </Pressable>
              ))}
              {/* Pay & Activate Insurance — real Stripe checkout */}
              {!pendingSession ? (
                <Pressable
                  style={[
                    styles.bigBtn,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: insuranceLoading ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                      opacity: insuranceLoading ? 0.7 : 1,
                    },
                  ]}
                  disabled={insuranceLoading}
                  onPress={async () => {
                    setInsuranceLoading(true);
                    try {
                      const { url, sessionId } = await createInsuranceCheckout(
                        selectedPlan,
                        booking.id,
                      );
                      setPendingSession(sessionId);
                      await Linking.openURL(url); // opens Stripe checkout in device browser
                    } catch (err) {
                      toast.error(
                        err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.unknownError"),
                      );
                    } finally {
                      setInsuranceLoading(false);
                    }
                  }}
                >
                  {insuranceLoading ? (
                    <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                  ) : (
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                    >
                      🛡️ {t("bookings.insurance.payActivate")}
                    </AppText>
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              ) : (
                /* After Stripe opens — show Verify button for when user returns */
                <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.bigBtn,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.08)",
                        borderColor: "#22c55e",
                        borderWidth: 1,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      tone="dim"
                      style={{ textAlign: "center" }}
                    >
                      Complete payment in your browser, then tap Verify below.
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <Pressable
                    style={[styles.bigBtn, { backgroundColor: "#22c55e" }]}
                    disabled={insuranceLoading}
                    onPress={async () => {
                      setInsuranceLoading(true);
                      try {
                        const result =
                          await verifyInsuranceCheckout(pendingSession);
                        toast.success(
                          `🛡️ ${result.plan} activated! Ref: ${result.reference}`,
                        );
                        setPendingSession(null);
                        setShowInsurance(false);
                      } catch {
                        toast.error(
                          "Payment not found yet — please wait a moment and try again.",
                        );
                      } finally {
                        setInsuranceLoading(false);
                      }
                    }}
                  >
                    {insuranceLoading ? (
                      <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
                    ) : (
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                      >
                        ✓ Verify Insurance Payment
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => setPendingSession(null)}
                    style={{ alignItems: "center" }}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      ← Start over
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              )}
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
              >
                {t("bookings.insurance.secureNote")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ── ACTIONS CARD ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={styles.sectionLabel}
        >
          {t("bookings.actions").toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>

        {/* Release payment */}
        {isHirer && booking.payment?.status === "HELD" && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)",
                borderColor: "#22c55e",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() =>
              setModal({
                title: t("bookings.releaseConfirm"),
                confirmLabel: t("bookings.release"),
                onConfirm: async () => {
                  try {
                    await releasePayment(booking.id);
                    toast.success("Payment released to worker!");
                    const updated = await getBooking(bookingId);
                    setBooking(updated);
                  } catch (err) {
                    toast.error(
                      err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.unknownError"),
                    );
                  }
                },
              })
            }
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}
            >
              💸 {t("bookings.releasePayment")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {/* Worker accept pending */}
        {!isHirer && booking.status === "PENDING" && (
          <AppButton
            title={t("bookings.accept")}
            onPress={() => doStatus("ACCEPTED")}
            loading={acting}
            style={{ marginTop: 12 }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Cancel — inline */}
        {canCancel && !showCancel && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.08)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() => {
              setShowCancel(true);
              setCancelError("");
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
            >
              {t("bookings.cancelBooking")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {canCancel && showCancel && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.cancelBox,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("bookings.cancelReason")} *
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              multiline
              numberOfLines={3}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              placeholder={t("bookings.cancelReasonPlaceholder")}
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              value={cancelReason}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setCancelReason(v);
                setCancelError("");
              }}
              style={[
                styles.cancelInput,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: cancelError ? "#ef4444" : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />
            {cancelError && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {cancelError}
              </AppText>
            )}
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleCancel}
                disabled={acting}
                style={[
                  styles.cancelConfirmBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: "#ef4444", flex: 1 },
                ]}
              >
                {acting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    {t("bookings.confirmCancel")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => {
                  setShowCancel(false);
                  setCancelReason("");
                  setCancelError("");
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.cancelConfirmBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    flex: 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" tone="dim">
                  {t("bookings.keepBooking")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Video Call */}
        {["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(booking.status) && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "#1e1b4b",
                borderColor: "#6366f1",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() => toast.info("Video call coming soon")}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#a5b4fc" }}
            >
              📹 {t("bookings.videoCall")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#6366f1", marginTop: 2 }}>
              {t("bookings.videoCallSub")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {/* Raise a Dispute */}
        {["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS", "COMPLETED"].includes(booking.status) && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("Disputes", {
                bookingId: booking.id,
                bookingTitle: booking.title,
              })
            }
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
            >
              ⚠️ {t("bookings.raiseDispute")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {!canCancel && booking.status === "COMPLETED" && (
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 12 }}
          >
            {t("bookings.noActions")}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </Card>

      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel ?? t("common.yes")}
        cancelLabel={t("common.no")}
        destructive={modal?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  center: { flex: 1, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" },

// src/screens/main/BookingsScreen.js
// Mirrors the website's BookingList.
// API: GET /bookings?page&limit&status

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import Card from "../../components/Card";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { getBookings } from "../../api/bookings";

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STATUSES = [
  "ALL",
  "PENDING",
  "ACCEPTED",
  "IN_PROGRESS",
  "COMPLETED",
  "CANCELLED",
  "DISPUTED",
];

const STATUS_META = {
  PENDING: { color: "#f97316", bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)" },
  ACCEPTED: { color: "#f97316", bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.25)" },
  IN_PROGRESS: { color: "#6366f1", bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.15)" },
  COMPLETED: { color: "#22c55e", bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)" },
  CANCELLED: { color: "#ef4444", bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)" },
  DISPUTED: { color: "#f43f5e", bg: "rgba(244,63,94,0.12)" },
};

// ─── Booking Card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function BookingCard({ booking, c, t }) {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const meta = STATUS_META[booking.status] ?? STATUS_META.PENDING;
  const other = booking.worker ?? booking.hirer; // counterparty
  const scheduled = new Date(booking.scheduledAt);
  const isPast = scheduled < new Date();

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={() =>
        navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", { bookingId: booking.id })
      }
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.card,
        {
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderColor: c.border,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.92 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Accent bar */}
      <View style={[styles.accentBar, { backgroundColor: meta.color }]} />

      <View style={styles.cardInner}>
        {/* Top: avatar + status */}
        <View style={styles.cardTop}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.avatar,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            {other?.avatar ? (
              <Image source={{ uri: other.avatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {other?.firstName?.[0]}
                {other?.lastName?.[0]}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: meta.bg }]}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: meta.color }}
            >
              {booking.status.replace("_", " ")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Title */}
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ marginTop: 10 }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {booking.title}
        </AppText>

        {/* Counterparty + category */}
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          numberOfLines={1}
          style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
        >
          {other?.firstName} {other?.lastName}
          {booking.category ? (
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
              {" · "}
              {booking.category.name}
            </AppText>
          ) : null}
        </AppText>

        {/* Date + address */}
        <View style={{ marginTop: 10, gap: 4 }}>
          <View style={styles.detailRow}>
            <Ionicons
              name="calendar-outline"
              size={12}
              color={isPast ? c.textMuted : c.orange}
              style={{ marginRight: 5 }}
            />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              style={{ color: isPast ? c.textMuted : c.text }}
            >
              {scheduled.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                day: "numeric",
                month: "short",
                year: "numeric",
              })}
              {" · "}
              {scheduled.toLocaleTimeString([], {
                hour: "2-digit",
                minute: "2-digit",
              })}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          {booking.address && (
            <View style={styles.detailRow}>
              <Ionicons
                name="location-outline"
                size={12}
                color={c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginRight: 5 }}
              />
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
                {booking.address}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Footer: rate + payment status */}
        <View style={[styles.cardFooter, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {booking.currency} {Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}
          </AppText>
          {booking.payment && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.payTag,
                {
                  backgroundColor:
                    booking.payment.status === "RELEASED"
                      ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)"
                      : "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color:
                    booking.payment.status === "RELEASED"
                      ? "#22c55e"
                      : c.orange,
                  fontSize: 10,
                }}
              >
                {booking.payment.status}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function BookingsScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;
  const isHirer = user?.role === "HIRER";

  const [bookings, setBookings] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);

  const load = useCallback(
    async (pg = 1, flt = filter) => {
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: 12 };
        if (flt !== "ALL") params.status = flt;
        const data = await getBookings(params);
        setBookings(data.bookings ?? []);
        setPages(data.pages ?? 1);
        setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
      } catch {
        toast.error(t("toast.networkError"));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [filter, t, toast],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load(page, filter);
  }, [filter, page]);

  const handleFilter = (f) => {
    setFilter(f);
    setPage(1);
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            load(1, filter);
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 0.8 }}
          >
            {t("bookings.myJobs").toUpperCase()}
          </AppText>
          <View
            style={{
              flexDirection: "row",
              alignItems: "center",
              gap: 10,
              marginTop: 4,
            }}
          >
            <AppText variant="display" weight="displayBlack">
              {t("bookings.title")}
            </AppText>
            {total > 0 && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.totalBadge,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
                  {total}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
        {isHirer && (
          <AppButton
            title={t("bookings.newBooking")}
            fullWidth={false}
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate("CreateBooking")}
            style={{ paddingHorizontal: 14 }}
          />
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Filter tabs */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={{ marginTop: 16 }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8, paddingRight: 8 }}
      >
        {STATUSES.map((s) => {
          const active = filter === s;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={s}
              onPress={() => handleFilter(s)}
              style={[
                styles.filterTab,
                {
                  backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
              >
                {s === "ALL"
                  ? t("bookings.all")
                  : s === "IN_PROGRESS"
                    ? t("bookings.inProgress")
                    : t(`bookings.${s.toLowerCase()}`)}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Content */}
      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.loadingWrap}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      ) : bookings.length === 0 ? (
        <Card padded style={styles.emptyCard}>
          <Ionicons name="briefcase-outline" size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            {t("bookings.noBookings")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginTop: 6, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            {filter === "ALL"
              ? isHirer
                ? t("bookings.noBookingsHirer")
                : t("bookings.noBookingsWorker")
              : t("bookings.noBookingsFiltered", {
                  status: filter.toLowerCase().replace("_", " "),
                })}
          </AppText>
          {filter === "ALL" && isHirer && (
            <AppButton
              title={t("bookings.newBooking")}
              iconLeft="add"
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("CreateBooking")}
              style={{ marginTop: 16 }}
            />
          )}
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.grid}>
          {bookings.map((b) => (
            <BookingCard key={b.id} booking={b} c={c} t={t} />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Pagination */}
      {pages > 1 && (
        <View style={[styles.pagination, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          <Pressable
            disabled={page === 1}
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
            style={[
              styles.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === 1 ? 0.4 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={16} color={c.text} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
            >
              Prev
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
            {page} {t("bookings.of")} {pages}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            disabled={page === pages}
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
            style={[
              styles.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === pages ? 0.4 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
            >
              Next
            </AppText>
            <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={16} color={c.text} />
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "flex-start",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    flexWrap: "wrap",
    gap: 10,
  },
  totalBadge: {
    paddingHorizontal: 10,
    paddingVertical: 4,
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  filterTab: {
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 8,
    borderRadius: 20,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  loadingWrap: { paddingVertical: 60, alignItems: "center" },
  emptyCard: { alignItems: "center", paddingVertical: 40, marginTop: 16 },
  grid: { gap: 12, marginTop: 16 },
  card: { borderRadius: 16, borderWidth: 1, overflow: "hidden" },
  accentBar: { height: 3, width: "100%" },
  cardInner: { padding: 16 },
  cardTop: {
    flexDirection: "row",

    justifyContent: "space-between",

    width: 44,

  },

  detailRow: { flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" },
  cardFooter: {
    flexDirection: "row",

    borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
  },
  payTag: { paddingHorizontal: 8, paddingVertical: 4, borderRadius: 20 },
  pagination: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "space-between",
    marginTop: 20,
    paddingTop: 16,
    borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
  },
  pageBtn: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    paddingHorizontal: 14,
    paddingVertical: 10,
    borderRadius: 10,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
});
