// src/screens/main/BrowseWorkersScreen.js
// Endpoints: GET /workers/search · GET /search/trending · GET /search/nearby
// Mirrors website Browse Jobs page exactly.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Linking,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import {
  searchWorkers,
  getTrending,
  getNearbyWorkers,
  getFilterOptions,
} from "../../api/workers";

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtRate(rate, currency) {
  if (!rate) return null;
  return `${currency ?? ""} ${Number(rate).toLocaleString()}`;
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

// ── Worker Card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function WorkerCard({ worker, onPress, c, t, isNew = false }) {
  const u = worker.user ?? {};
  const wp = worker; // workerProfile fields live at root from /workers/search
  // shape differs between /search (workerProfile root) and /search/trending
  const firstName = u.firstName ?? wp.user?.firstName;
  const lastName = u.lastName ?? wp.user?.lastName;
  const avatar = u.avatar ?? wp.user?.avatar;
  const city = u.city ?? wp.user?.city;
  const country = u.country ?? wp.user?.country;
  const title = wp.title;
  const hourlyRate = wp.hourlyRate;
  const currency = wp.currency ?? wp.user?.currency;
  const avgRating = wp.avgRating;
  const totalReviews = wp.totalReviews ?? 0;
  const completedJobs = wp.completedJobs ?? 0;
  const isAvailable = wp.isAvailable;
  const isVerified = wp.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED";
  const categories = wp.categories ?? [];
  const location = [city, country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
  const userId = u.id ?? wp.user?.id ?? wp.userId;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={() => onPress(userId)}
      style={[
        styles.card,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Top badges row */}
      <View style={styles.cardBadgeRow}>
        {isNew && (
          <View style={[styles.newBadge, { backgroundColor: "#1e1b4b" }]}>
            <AppText
              style={{ color: "#818cf8", fontSize: 11, fontWeight: "700" }}
            >
              NEW
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
        {isVerified && (
          <AppText style={[styles.shieldBadge, { marginLeft: "auto" }]}>
            🛡️
          </AppText>
        )}
        {!isNew && !isVerified && <View style={{ flex: 1 }} />}
      </View>

      {/* Avatar row */}
      <View style={styles.avatarRow}>
        <View style={styles.avatarWrap}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.avatar,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            {avatar ? (
              <Image source={{ uri: avatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700", fontSize: 18 }}
              >
                {initials(firstName, lastName)}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          {/* Available green dot */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.availDot,
              { backgroundColor: isAvailable ? "#22c55e" : "#6b7280" },
            ]}
          />
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Name + title */}
      <AppText
        variant="title"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 8 }}
      >
        {firstName} {lastName}
      </AppText>
      {!!title && (
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}>
          {title}
        </AppText>
      )}

      {/* Primary category chip */}
      {categories.length > 0 && (
        <Pressable
          style={[
            styles.catChip,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
          ]}
        >
          {categories[0]?.category?.icon ? (
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, marginRight: 4 }}>
              {categories[0].category.icon}
            </AppText>
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, marginRight: 4 }}>🔧</AppText>
          )}
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange }}
          >
            {categories[0]?.category?.name ?? categories[0]?.name}
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
      )}

      {/* Location */}
      {!!location && (
        <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}>
          📍 {location}
        </AppText>
      )}

      {/* Rating + jobs */}
      <View style={styles.ratingRow}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, color: c.orange }}>★</AppText>
        {avgRating > 0 ? (
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}
          >
            {Number(avgRating).toFixed(1)}
          </AppText>
        ) : (
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}>
            {t("browse.new")}
          </AppText>
        )}
        <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 4 }}>
          ({totalReviews})
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: "auto" }}
        >
          {completedJobs} {t("browse.jobs")}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Divider */}
      <View style={[styles.divider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

      {/* Rate + availability */}
      <View style={styles.rateRow}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16, fontWeight: "700", color: c.text }}>
          {fmtRate(hourlyRate, currency)}
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            /hr
          </AppText>
        </AppText>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.availChip,
            {
              backgroundColor: isAvailable
                ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)"
                : "rgba(107,114,128,0.12)",
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            style={{
              fontSize: 11,
              fontWeight: "700",
              color: isAvailable ? "#22c55e" : "#6b7280",
              letterSpacing: 0.8,
            }}
          >
            {isAvailable ? t("browse.available") : t("browse.unavailable")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

// ── Filter Panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function FilterPanel({ visible, onClose, filters, setFilters, options, c, t }) {
  const [local, setLocal] = useState(filters);

  const apply = () => {
    setFilters(local);
    onClose();
  };
  const reset = () => {
    setLocal({});
    setFilters({});
    onClose();
  };

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="slide" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable style={fp.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            fp.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <View style={[fp.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
          <View style={fp.header}>
            <AppText
              variant="title"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {t("browse.filters")}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable onPress={reset}>
              <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
                {t("browse.reset")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            {/* Min rate */}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{
                color: c.textMuted,
                marginBottom: 8,
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
              }}
            >
              {t("browse.minRate")}
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              value={local.minRate ?? ""}
              onChangeText={(v) => setLocal((f) => ({ ...f, minRate: v }))}
              placeholder="0"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              style={[
                fp.input,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                },
              ]}
            />

            {/* Max rate */}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{
                color: c.textMuted,
                marginBottom: 8,
                marginTop: 12,
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
              }}
            >
              {t("browse.maxRate")}
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              value={local.maxRate ?? ""}
              onChangeText={(v) => setLocal((f) => ({ ...f, maxRate: v }))}
              placeholder="10000"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              style={[
                fp.input,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  borderColor: c.border,
                },
              ]}
            />

            {/* Min rating */}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{
                color: c.textMuted,
                marginBottom: 8,
                marginTop: 12,
                letterSpacing: 0.8,
              }}
            >
              {t("browse.minRating")}
            </AppText>
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8 }}>
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((r) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={r}
                  onPress={() => setLocal((f) => ({ ...f, rating: String(r) }))}
                  style={[
                    fp.ratingBtn,
                    {
                      backgroundColor:
                        local.rating === String(r) ? c.orange : c.bgInput,
                      borderColor:
                        local.rating === String(r) ? c.orange : c.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      color: local.rating === String(r) ? "#fff" : c.text,
                    }}
                  >
                    {r}★
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </View>
          </ScrollView>

          <Pressable
            onPress={apply}
            style={[fp.applyBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
          >
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
              {t("browse.applyFilters")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ── Skeleton ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            styles.skCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main Screen ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const TABS = ["trending", "results", "nearby", "filters"];

export default function BrowseWorkersScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("trending");
  const [workers, setWorkers] = useState([]);
  const [trending, setTrending] = useState({ top: [], newWorkers: [] });
  const [nearby, setNearby] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState({});
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);
  const [filterOptions, setFilterOptions] = useState({});

  // ── Load trending on mount ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const loadTrending = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getTrending();
      // Trending may return { workers } or { topRated, newWorkers }
      const all = data.workers ?? data.topRated ?? [];
      const newW = data.newWorkers ?? [];
      setTrending({ top: all.slice(0, 10), newWorkers: newW.slice(0, 10) });
    } catch {
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const loadNearby = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getNearbyWorkers();
      setNearby(data.workers ?? []);
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTrending();
    getFilterOptions()
      .then(setFilterOptions)
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const handleSearch = async () => {
    if (!query.trim() && Object.keys(filters).length === 0) return;
    setActiveTab("results");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await searchWorkers({
        query: query.trim(),
        ...filters,
        limit: 30,
      });
      setWorkers(data.workers ?? []);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTabChange = (tab) => {
    if (tab === "filters") {
      setShowFilters(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === "nearby") {
      setActiveTab("nearby");
      loadNearby();
      return;
    }
    setActiveTab(tab);
    if (tab === "trending" && trending.top.length === 0) {
      setLoading(true);
      loadTrending();
    }
  };

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    if (activeTab === "trending") loadTrending();
    else if (activeTab === "nearby") {
      loadNearby();
      setRefreshing(false);
    } else {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  };

  const goToProfile = (userId) => {
    navigation.navigate("WorkerProfile", { userId });
  };

  // Build list data for FlatList
  const listData =
    activeTab === "trending"
      ? [] // trending uses ListHeader sections
      : activeTab === "results"
        ? workers
        : nearby;

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={listData}
        keyExtractor={(item, i) => item.user?.id ?? item.userId ?? String(i)}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Search bar */}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.searchBar,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, fontSize: 18, marginRight: 6 }}
              >
                🔍
              </AppText>
              <TextInput
                value={query}
                onChangeText={setQuery}
                onSubmitEditing={handleSearch}
                returnKeyType="search"
                placeholder={t("browse.searchPlaceholder")}
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                style={[styles.searchInput, { color: c.text }]}
              />
              <Pressable
                style={[
                  styles.iconBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText>🎤</AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                style={[
                  styles.iconBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText>📍</AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleSearch}
                style={[styles.searchBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  {t("browse.search")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Filter tabs */}
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={styles.tabsScroll}
              contentContainerStyle={styles.tabsContent}
            >
              {[
                { key: "trending", label: t("browse.trending") },
                { key: "results", label: t("browse.results") },
                { key: "nearby", label: t("browse.nearby") },
                { key: "filters", label: `🔧 ${t("browse.filters")}` },
              ].map(({ key, label }) => {
                const active = activeTab === key && key !== "filters";
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={key}
                    onPress={() => handleTabChange(key)}
                    style={[
                      styles.tab,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            {/* Trending sections */}
            {activeTab === "trending" &&
              (loading ? (
                <Skeleton c={c} />
              ) : (
                <View>
                  {trending.top.length > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <AppText style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                        {t("browse.topRated")}
                      </AppText>
                      {trending.top.map((w, i) => (
                        <View
                          key={w.user?.id ?? i}
                          style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
                        >
                          <WorkerCard
                            worker={w}
                            onPress={goToProfile}
                            c={c}
                            t={t}
                          />
                        </View>
                      ))}
                    </>
                  )}
                  {trending.newWorkers.length > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <AppText
                        style={[
                          styles.sectionTitle,
                          { color: c.text, marginTop: 8 },
                        ]}
                      >
                        {t("browse.newOnPlatform")}
                      </AppText>
                      {trending.newWorkers.map((w, i) => (
                        <View
                          key={w.user?.id ?? `new${i}`}
                          style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
                        >
                          <WorkerCard
                            worker={w}
                            onPress={goToProfile}
                            c={c}
                            t={t}
                            isNew
                          />
                        </View>
                      ))}
                    </>
                  )}
                  {trending.top.length === 0 &&
                    trending.newWorkers.length === 0 && (
                      <EmptyState c={c} t={t} />
                    )}
                </View>
              ))}

            {/* Results/Nearby headings */}
            {activeTab === "results" && !loading && (
              <AppText style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                {t("browse.searchResults")} ({workers.length})
              </AppText>
            )}
            {activeTab === "nearby" && !loading && (
              <AppText style={[styles.sectionTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                {t("browse.nearbyWorkers")}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <View style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
            <WorkerCard worker={item} onPress={goToProfile} c={c} t={t} />
          </View>
        )}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          activeTab !== "trending" ? (
            loading ? (
              <Skeleton c={c} />
            ) : (
              <EmptyState c={c} t={t} />
            )
          ) : null
        }
        ListFooterComponent={<View style={{ height: 40 }} />}
      />

      <FilterPanel
        visible={showFilters}
        onClose={() => setShowFilters(false)}
        filters={filters}
        setFilters={(f) => {
          setFilters(f);
          if (query.trim()) handleSearch();
        }}
        options={filterOptions}
        c={c}
        t={t}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

      >
        {t("browse.noResults")}
      </AppText>
      <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}>
        {t("browse.noResultsSub")}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/CommunityFeedScreen.js
// Mirrors the website's Community Feed page.
// Compact create bar at top + type filter tabs + infinite scroll feed.
// Endpoints: GET /posts/feed?type=X&page=N, POST /posts, DELETE /posts/:id

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import * as ImagePicker from "expo-image-picker";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import ConfirmModal from "../../components/ConfirmModal";
import PostCard, { POST_TYPES } from "../../components/PostCard";
import { getFeed, createPost, deletePost } from "../../api/posts";

// ── Filter tab config ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const FEED_TABS = [
  { key: "ALL", label: "All" },
  { key: "GENERAL", label: "General" },
  { key: "HIRING", label: "Hiring 📢" },
  { key: "ACHIEVEMENT", label: "Achievements 🏆" },
  { key: "PORTFOLIO", label: "Portfolio 🎨" },
  { key: "JOB_UPDATE", label: "Job Update 💼" },
  { key: "ANNOUNCEMENT", label: "Announcements 📣" },
];

const POST_TYPE_LIST = [
  { type: "GENERAL", emoji: "💬" },
  { type: "ACHIEVEMENT", emoji: "🏆" },
  { type: "PORTFOLIO", emoji: "🎨" },
  { type: "HIRING", emoji: "📢" },
  { type: "JOB_UPDATE", emoji: "💼" },
  { type: "ANNOUNCEMENT", emoji: "📣" },
];

const LIMIT = 20;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Full Create Post Sheet (opens from compact bar)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CreatePostSheet({ user, visible, onClose, onPosted, c }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [content, setContent] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState("GENERAL");
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(true);
  const [images, setImages] = useState([]);
  const [posting, setPosting] = useState(false);

  const reset = () => {
    setContent("");
    setType("GENERAL");
    setImages([]);
  };
  const handleClose = () => {
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  const pickImages = async () => {
    const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) {
      toast.error("Permission required.");
      return;
    }
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      allowsMultipleSelection: true,
      quality: 0.8,
    });
    if (!result.canceled) {
      setImages(
        result.assets.map((a) => ({
          uri: a.uri,
          name: a.fileName ?? `photo_${Date.now()}.jpg`,
          type: a.type ?? "image/jpeg",
        })),
      );
    }
  };

  const handlePost = async () => {
    if (!content.trim()) {
      toast.error("Write something first.");
      return;
    }
    setPosting(true);
    try {
      const post = await createPost({ content, type, isPublic, images });
      reset();
      onPosted?.(post);
      onClose();
      toast.success("Post published!");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to post.");
    } finally {
      setPosting(false);
    }
  };

  if (!visible) return null;

  const name = user?.firstName
    ? `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName ?? ""}`.trim()
    : (user?.hirerProfile?.companyName ?? "You");

  return (
    <Modal
      visible
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
    >
      <Pressable style={sh.backdrop} onPress={handleClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            sh.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <View style={[sh.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

          {/* Header */}
          <View style={sh.sheetHeader}>
            <View
              style={[
                sh.avatar,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              {user?.avatar ? (
                <Image source={{ uri: user.avatar }} style={sh.avatarImg} />
              ) : (
                <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
                  {(user?.firstName?.[0] ?? "") + (user?.lastName?.[0] ?? "")}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
            <View style={{ marginLeft: 12, flex: 1 }}>
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                {name}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => setIsPublic((v) => !v)}
                style={[sh.publicBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
              >
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
                  {isPublic ? "🌍" : "🔒"}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ marginLeft: 5 }}
                >
                  {isPublic ? "Public" : "Private"}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handleClose}
              style={[
                sh.closeBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText tone="dim">✕</AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          {/* Text input */}
          <TextInput
            value={content}
            onChangeText={setContent}
            placeholder="What's on your mind? Share a job update, achievement, or anything work-related..."
            placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
            multiline
            autoFocus
            style={[sh.textInput, { color: c.text }]}
            maxLength={2000}
          />

          {/* Image previews */}
          {images.length > 0 && (
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, marginBottom: 10 }}
            >
              {images.map((img, i) => (
                <View key={i} style={sh.previewWrap}>
                  <Image source={{ uri: img.uri }} style={sh.previewImg} />
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() =>
                      setImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, j) => j !== i))
                    }
                    style={sh.removeImg}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700" }}
                    >
                      ✕
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                </View>
              ))}
            </ScrollView>
          )}

          {/* Type pills */}
          <ScrollView
            horizontal
            showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
            style={sh.typeScroll}
            contentContainerStyle={sh.typeContent}
          >
            {POST_TYPE_LIST.map(({ type: t, emoji }) => {
              const active = type === t;
              const meta = POST_TYPES[t];
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={t}
                  onPress={() => setType(t)}
                  style={[
                    sh.typePill,
                    {
                      borderColor: active ? meta.color : c.border,
                      backgroundColor: active ? meta.bg : c.bgInput,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{emoji}</AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{
                      color: active ? meta.color : c.textMuted,
                      marginLeft: 5,
                    }}
                  >
                    {meta.label}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </ScrollView>

          {/* Bottom row */}
          <View style={[sh.bottomRow, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={pickImages}
              style={[sh.iconBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>📷</AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => {
                /* announce — sets type */ setType("ANNOUNCEMENT");
              }}
              style={[sh.iconBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>📢</AppText>
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={handlePost}
              disabled={posting || !content.trim()}
              style={[
                sh.postBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: content.trim() ? c.orange : c.bgInput,
                  opacity: content.trim() ? 1 : 0.5,
                  marginLeft: "auto",
                },
              ]}
            >
              {posting ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  Post
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function CommunityFeedScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("ALL");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [sheetVisible, setSheetVisible] = useState(false);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);

  const fetchFeed = useCallback(
    async (pg = 1, tab = activeTab, replace = true) => {
      if (replace) setLoading(true);
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: LIMIT };
        if (tab !== "ALL") params.type = tab;
        const data = await getFeed(params);
        setPosts(replace ? data.posts : (prev) => [...prev, ...data.posts]);
        setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
        setTotalPages(data.pages ?? 1);
      } catch {
        toast.error("Failed to load feed.");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [activeTab],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(1);
    fetchFeed(1, activeTab, true);
  }, [activeTab]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setPage(1);
    fetchFeed(1, activeTab, true);
  };

  const handlePosted = (newPost) => {
    setPosts((prev) => [newPost, ...prev]);
    setTotal((t) => t + 1);
  };

  const handleDelete = (postId) => {
    setModal({
      title: "Delete Post",
      message: "Delete this post permanently?",
      confirmLabel: "Delete",
      destructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await deletePost(postId);
          setPosts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== postId));
          setTotal((t) => t - 1);
          toast.success("Post deleted.");
        } catch {
          toast.error("Failed to delete post.");
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages && !loading) {
      const next = page + 1;
      setPage(next);
      fetchFeed(next, activeTab, false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={posts}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Compact create bar */}
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setSheetVisible(true)}
              style={[
                styles.createBar,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.barAvatar,
                  { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                {user?.avatar ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: user.avatar }}
                    style={styles.barAvatarImg}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700", fontSize: 12 }}
                  >
                    {(user?.firstName?.[0] ?? "") + (user?.lastName?.[0] ?? "")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.barInput,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
                  Start a post, share an update…
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => {
                  setSheetVisible(true);
                }}
                style={styles.barIcon}
              >
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>📷</AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => {
                  setSheetVisible(true);
                }}
                style={styles.barIcon}
              >
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>📢</AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </Pressable>

            {/* Filter tabs */}
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={styles.tabsScroll}
              contentContainerStyle={styles.tabsContent}
            >
              {FEED_TABS.map(({ key, label }) => {
                const active = activeTab === key;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={key}
                    onPress={() => setActiveTab(key)}
                    style={[
                      styles.tab,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>

            {/* Post count */}
            {!loading && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.postCount}>
                {total} post{total !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <PostCard
            post={item}
            userId={user?.id}
            c={c}
            showDelete={item.author?.id === user?.id}
            onDelete={
              item.author?.id === user?.id
                ? () => handleDelete(item.id)
                : undefined
            }
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40, textAlign: "center" }}>
                🌐
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                No posts yet
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                Be the first to share something with the community!
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />

      {/* Create post sheet */}
      <CreatePostSheet
        user={user}
        visible={sheetVisible}
        onClose={() => setSheetVisible(false)}
        onPosted={handlePosted}
        c={c}
      />

      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title}
        message={modal?.message}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel}
        destructive={modal?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            {
              height: 160,
              borderRadius: 16,
              borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
              backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
              borderColor: c.border,
              opacity: 0.5,
            },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/CreateBookingScreen.js
// Mirrors the website's CreateBooking.
// API: GET /workers/:id  +  POST /bookings

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import DateTimePicker from "@react-native-community/datetimepicker";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppInput from "../../components/AppInput";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import Card from "../../components/Card";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { getWorkerProfile, createBooking } from "../../api/bookings";

// ─── Duration options ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const DURATION_OPTIONS = [
  {
    unit: "hours",
    label: "Hourly",
    rateKey: "hourlyRate",
    suffix: "/hr",
    inputLabel: "Hours",
  },
  {
    unit: "days",
    label: "Daily",
    rateKey: "dailyRate",
    suffix: "/day",
    inputLabel: "Days",
  },
  {
    unit: "weeks",
    label: "Weekly",
    rateKey: "weeklyRate",
    suffix: "/wk",
    inputLabel: "Weeks",
  },
  {
    unit: "months",
    label: "Monthly",
    rateKey: "monthlyRate",
    suffix: "/mo",
    inputLabel: "Months",
  },
  {
    unit: "custom",
    label: "Custom",
    rateKey: "customRate",
    suffix: "",
    inputLabel: "Describe",
  },
];

// ─── Estimate total helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function estHours(unit, val) {
  const n = parseFloat(val) || 0;
  const map = { hours: n, days: n * 8, weeks: n * 40, months: n * 160 };
  return map[unit] ?? null;
}

// ─── Worker profile card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function WorkerCard({ worker, c }) {
  const u = worker.user ?? worker;
  return (
    <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
      <View style={styles.workerTop}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.workerAvatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.orange },
          ]}
        >
          {u.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: u.avatar }} style={styles.workerAvatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {u.firstName?.[0]}
              {u.lastName?.[0]}
            </AppText>
          )}
          {worker.isAvailable && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.onlineDot,
                { backgroundColor: "#22c55e", borderColor: c.bgCard },
              ]}
            />
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
            {u.firstName} {u.lastName}
            {worker.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED" && (
              <AppText style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}> ✓</AppText>
            )}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {worker.title}
          </AppText>
          {worker.avgRating > 0 && (
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              ⭐ {Number(worker.avgRating).toFixed(1)} ({worker.totalReviews}{" "}
              reviews)
            </AppText>
          )}
          {(u.city || u.country) && (
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              📍 {[u.city, u.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.lockedTag,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
            🔒 Locked
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
      {worker.categories?.length > 0 && (
        <View style={styles.catRow}>
          {worker.categories.slice(0, 3).map((wc) => (
            <View
              key={wc.id}
              style={[
                styles.catPill,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {wc.category?.icon} {wc.category?.name}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

// ─── Fieldset wrapper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Fieldset({ legend, children, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={[styles.fieldset, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 0.8, marginBottom: 14 }}
      >
        {legend.toUpperCase()}
      </AppText>
      {children}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function CreateBookingScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;

  // workerId can come from route params (e.g. WorkerDetail → "Book")
  const initWorkerId = route.params?.workerId ?? "";

  const [workerId, setWorkerId] = useState(initWorkerId);
  const [worker, setWorker] = useState(null);
  const [workerLoading, setWorkerLoading] = useState(false);
  const [workerError, setWorkerError] = useState("");
  const [selectedUnit, setSelectedUnit] = useState("hours");

  // Form
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState("");
  const [estValue, setEstValue] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState("");

  // Date/time
  const [scheduledAt, setScheduledAt] = useState(null);
  const [scheduledObj, setScheduledObj] = useState(
    new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
  );
  const [showDatePicker, setShowDatePicker] = useState(false);

  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  // ── Fetch worker when ID changes ──────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = workerId.trim();
    if (!id) {
      setWorker(null);
      return;
    }
    setWorkerLoading(true);
    setWorkerError("");
    getWorkerProfile(id)
      .then((w) => {
        setWorker(w);
        // Auto-select first available unit
        const avail = DURATION_OPTIONS.filter((o) => {
          if (o.rateKey === "customRate") return w.customRate > 0;
          return w[o.rateKey] > 0;
        });
        setSelectedUnit(avail[0]?.unit ?? "hours");
        // Auto-select primary category
        const primary =
          w.categories?.find((c) => c.isPrimary) ?? w.categories?.[0];
        if (primary) setCategoryId(primary.category?.id ?? "");
      })
      .catch(() => setWorkerError(t("bookings.workerNotFound")))
      .finally(() => setWorkerLoading(false));
  }, [workerId]);

  const currentOpt = DURATION_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.unit === selectedUnit);
  const lockedRate = worker ? (worker[currentOpt?.rateKey] ?? 0) : 0;
  const lockedCurr = worker?.currency ?? "USD";
  const availUnits = worker
    ? DURATION_OPTIONS.filter((o) =>
        o.rateKey === "customRate"
          ? worker.customRate > 0
          : worker[o.rateKey] > 0,
      )
    : [];
  const displayUnits =
    availUnits.length > 0 ? availUnits : [DURATION_OPTIONS[0]];

  const estNumeric = parseFloat(estValue) || 0;
  const estTotalVal =
    currentOpt?.unit !== "custom" && lockedRate > 0 && estNumeric > 0
      ? estNumeric * lockedRate
      : null;

  // ── Date picker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const onDateChange = (event, date) => {
    if (Platform.OS === "android") setShowDatePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "dismissed") return;
    if (date) {
      setScheduledObj(date);
      setScheduledAt(date.toISOString());
      setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, scheduledAt: null }));
    }
  };

  const formattedDate = scheduledAt
    ? new Date(scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
        weekday: "short",
        day: "numeric",
        month: "short",
        year: "numeric",
      }) +
      " · " +
      new Date(scheduledAt).toLocaleTimeString([], {
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
      })
    : null;

  // ── Submit ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    const e = {};
    if (!worker) e.workerId = t("bookings.workerRequired");
    if (!title.trim()) e.title = t("bookings.titleRequired");
    if (!description.trim()) e.description = t("bookings.descriptionRequired");
    if (!address.trim()) e.address = t("bookings.addressRequired");
    if (!scheduledAt) e.scheduledAt = t("bookings.dateRequired");
    if (!categoryId) e.categoryId = t("bookings.categoryRequired");

    if (Object.keys(e).length) {
      setErrors(e);
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const ehrs =
        currentOpt?.unit !== "custom"
          ? estHours(currentOpt?.unit, estValue)
          : null;
      const booking = await createBooking({
        workerId: workerId.trim(),
        categoryId,
        title: title.trim(),
        description: description.trim(),
        address: address.trim(),
        scheduledAt,
        estimatedHours: ehrs || undefined,
        estimatedUnit: currentOpt?.unit || "hours",
        estimatedValue: estValue ? estValue.toString() : undefined,
        agreedRate: lockedRate,
        currency: lockedCurr,
        notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success(t("bookings.created"));
      navigation.replace("BookingDetail", { bookingId: booking.id });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AppScreen contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 60 }}>
      {/* Back */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Bookings")}
        style={styles.backBtn}
        hitSlop={8}
      >
        <Ionicons
          name="arrow-back"
          size={16}
          color={c.text}
          style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
        />
        <AppText variant="small">{t("bookings.backToBookings")}</AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* Header */}
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        weight="semibold"
        style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 0.8 }}
      >
        {t("bookings.newJob").toUpperCase()}
      </AppText>
      <AppText variant="display" weight="displayBlack" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
        {t("bookings.createBooking")}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        tone="dim"
        style={{ marginTop: 6, marginBottom: 20 }}
      >
        {t("bookings.createSubtitle")}
      </AppText>

      {/* ── WORKER ── */}
      {!initWorkerId && (
        <Fieldset legend={t("bookings.worker")} c={c}>
          <AppInput
            label={`${t("bookings.workerId")} *`}
            placeholder={t("bookings.workerIdPlaceholder")}
            value={workerId}
            onChangeText={(v) => {
              setWorkerId(v);
              setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, workerId: null }));
            }}
            error={errors.workerId}
            iconLeft="person-outline"
          />
          {workerError && (
            <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
              {workerError}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Fieldset>
      )}

      {workerLoading && (
        <View style={styles.workerLoading}>
          <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 10 }}>
            {t("bookings.loadingWorker")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {worker && !workerLoading && <WorkerCard worker={worker} c={c} />}

      {/* ── PRICING ── */}
      {worker && (
        <Fieldset legend={t("bookings.pricingDuration")} c={c}>
          {/* Duration type selector */}
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
          >
            {t("bookings.engagementType")} *
          </AppText>
          <View style={styles.unitGrid}>
            {displayUnits.map((opt) => {
              const rate = worker[opt.rateKey] ?? 0;
              const hasRate = rate > 0;
              const active = selectedUnit === opt.unit;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={opt.unit}
                  onPress={() => hasRate && setSelectedUnit(opt.unit)}
                  style={[
                    styles.unitCard,
                    {
                      borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      backgroundColor: active ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      opacity: hasRate ? 1 : 0.4,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: active ? c.orange : c.text }}
                  >
                    {opt.label}
                  </AppText>
                  {hasRate ? (
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 4 }}
                    >
                      {lockedCurr} {Number(rate).toLocaleString()}
                      {opt.suffix}
                    </AppText>
                  ) : (
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      tone="dim"
                      style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
                    >
                      Not offered
                    </AppText>
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </View>

          {/* Locked rate */}
          <View
            style={[
              styles.lockedRow,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t("bookings.agreedRate")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {lockedCurr} {Number(lockedRate).toLocaleString()}
                {currentOpt?.suffix}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
                🔒 {t("bookings.lockedFromWorker")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <View>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t("bookings.currency")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold">
                {lockedCurr}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Duration value */}
          {currentOpt?.unit === "custom" ? (
            <AppInput
              label={t("bookings.describeEngagement")}
              placeholder="e.g. Full build, until project complete"
              value={estValue}
              onChangeText={setEstValue}
              iconLeft="create-outline"
              style={{ marginTop: 12 }}
            />
          ) : (
            <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
              <AppInput
                label={`${t("bookings.numberOf")} ${currentOpt?.inputLabel ?? "units"}`}
                placeholder="e.g. 4"
                value={estValue}
                onChangeText={(v) => setEstValue(v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""))}
                keyboardType="decimal-pad"
                iconLeft="hourglass-outline"
              />
              {estTotalVal > 0 && (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.totalEstimate,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                    {t("bookings.estimatedTotal")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="title"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}
                  >
                    {lockedCurr} {Number(estTotalVal).toLocaleString()}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
          )}
        </Fieldset>
      )}

      {/* ── CATEGORY ── */}
      {worker && worker.categories?.length > 1 && (
        <Fieldset legend={t("bookings.category")} c={c}>
          {worker.categories.map((wc) => (
            <Pressable
              key={wc.id}
              onPress={() => setCategoryId(wc.category?.id ?? "")}
              style={[
                styles.catOption,
                {
                  borderColor:
                    categoryId === wc.category?.id ? c.orange : c.border,
                  backgroundColor:
                    categoryId === wc.category?.id ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{
                  color: categoryId === wc.category?.id ? c.orange : c.text,
                }}
              >
                {wc.category?.icon} {wc.category?.name}
              </AppText>
              {wc.isPrimary && (
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {" "}
                  (Primary)
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          ))}
          {errors.categoryId && (
            <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
              {errors.categoryId}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Fieldset>
      )}

      {/* ── JOB INFO ── */}
      <Fieldset legend={t("bookings.jobInformation")} c={c}>
        <AppInput
          label={`${t("bookings.jobTitle")} *`}
          placeholder="e.g. Fix leaking kitchen pipe"
          value={title}
          onChangeText={(v) => {
            setTitle(v);
            setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, title: null }));
          }}
          error={errors.title}
          iconLeft="create-outline"
        />

        <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
          >
            {t("bookings.description")} *
          </AppText>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.textarea,
              {
                borderColor: errors.description ? c.red : c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <TextInput
              multiline
              numberOfLines={4}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              placeholder="Describe exactly what needs to be done…"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              value={description}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setDescription(v);
                setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, description: null }));
              }}
              style={{ color: c.text, fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 22 }}
            />
          </View>
          {errors.description && (
            <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
              {errors.description}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
          >
            {t("bookings.additionalNotes")}
          </AppText>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.textarea,
              {
                borderColor: c.border,
                backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                minHeight: 70,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <TextInput
              multiline
              numberOfLines={2}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              placeholder="Access instructions, parking, tools to bring…"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              value={notes}
              onChangeText={setNotes}
              style={{ color: c.text, fontSize: 15, lineHeight: 22 }}
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </Fieldset>

      {/* ── LOCATION ── */}
      <Fieldset legend={t("bookings.location")} c={c}>
        <AppInput
          label={`${t("bookings.serviceAddress")} *`}
          placeholder="Full address where the job will take place"
          value={address}
          onChangeText={(v) => {
            setAddress(v);
            setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, address: null }));
          }}
          error={errors.address}
          iconLeft="location-outline"
        />
      </Fieldset>

      {/* ── SCHEDULE ── */}
      <Fieldset legend={t("bookings.schedule")} c={c}>
        <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
          {t("bookings.dateTime")} *
        </AppText>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(true)}
          style={[
            styles.dateBtn,
            {
              borderColor: errors.scheduledAt ? c.red : c.border,
              backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={18} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              marginLeft: 10,
              color: formattedDate ? c.text : c.textMuted,
            }}
          >
            {formattedDate || "Select date & time"}
          </AppText>
          <Ionicons name="chevron-down" size={16} color={c.textMuted} />
        </Pressable>
        {errors.scheduledAt && (
          <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
            {errors.scheduledAt}
          </AppText>
        )}
        {showDatePicker && Platform.OS === "android" && (
          <DateTimePicker
            value={scheduledObj}
            mode="datetime"
            display="default"
            minimumDate={new Date(Date.now() + 3600000)}
            onChange={onDateChange}
          />
        )}
        {Platform.OS === "ios" && (
          <Modal
            visible={showDatePicker}
            transparent
            animationType="slide"
            onRequestClose={() => setShowDatePicker(false)}
          >
            <Pressable
              style={styles.dateBackdrop}
              onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(false)}
            />
            <View
              style={[
                styles.dateSheet,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderTopColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.dateSheetHeader,
                  { borderBottomColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                  Select Date & Time
                </AppText>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(false)}
                  hitSlop={10}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.orange }}
                  >
                    Done
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
              <DateTimePicker
                value={scheduledObj}
                mode="datetime"
                display="spinner"
                minimumDate={new Date(Date.now() + 3600000)}
                onChange={onDateChange}
                style={{ height: 220, width: "100%" }}
                themeVariant="dark"
              />
            </View>
          </Modal>
        )}
      </Fieldset>

      {/* ── Summary ── */}
      {worker && title && address && scheduledAt && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ letterSpacing: 0.8, marginBottom: 12 }}
          >
            📋 BOOKING SUMMARY
          </AppText>
          {[
            {
              label: t("bookings.worker"),
              value: `${(worker.user ?? worker).firstName} ${(worker.user ?? worker).lastName}`,
            },
            {
              label: t("bookings.agreedRate"),
              value: `${lockedCurr} ${Number(lockedRate).toLocaleString()}${currentOpt?.suffix}`,
              accent: true,
            },
            {
              label: t("bookings.duration"),
              value: estValue
                ? `${estValue} ${currentOpt?.inputLabel?.toLowerCase()}`
                : "—",
            },
            ...(estTotalVal
              ? [
                  {
                    label: t("bookings.estimatedTotal"),
                    value: `${lockedCurr} ${Number(estTotalVal).toLocaleString()}`,
                    green: true,
                  },
                ]
              : []),
          ].map((row) => (
            <View
              key={row.label}
              style={[styles.summaryRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {row.label}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: row.green ? "#22c55e" : row.accent ? c.orange : c.text,
                }}
              >
                {row.value}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginTop: 10, fontStyle: "italic" }}
          >
            ⚠️ {t("bookings.summaryNote")}
          </AppText>
        </Card>
      )}

      <AppButton
        title={t("bookings.createBookingBtn")}
        iconLeft="add-circle-outline"
        onPress={handleSubmit}
        loading={submitting}
        disabled={!worker}
      />

      <AppText
        variant="small"
        tone="dim"
        style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 12 }}
      >
        {t("bookings.disclaimer")}
      </AppText>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/DashboardScreen.js
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  View,
  StyleSheet,
  RefreshControl,
  ActivityIndicator,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import AppCurrency from "../../components/AppCurrency";
import StatCard from "../../components/StatCard";
import SectionHeader from "../../components/SectionHeader";
import Card from "../../components/Card";
import BookingRow from "../../components/BookingRow";
import WorkerRow from "../../components/WorkerRow";
import CurrencyPicker from "../../components/CurrencyPicker";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { hirerApi } from "../../api/hirer";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";

// DashboardScreen — Hirer-facing landing screen.
//
// Mirrors the website dashboard one-to-one:
//   - "OVERVIEW" eyebrow + "Your Dashboard" display heading
//   - Currency picker + "Post a Job" CTA
//   - 4 stat cards: Total Bookings / Active Jobs / Completed / Total Spent
//   - Recent Bookings list (5 items + View all)
//   - Recent Workers list (5 items + View all)
//
// Backend: GET /api/hirer/me/dashboard
export default function DashboardScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  // Stable load function — empty dep array means same identity across renders,
  // which keeps the mount-effect below from re-firing in a loop. `t` and
  // `toast` are looked up via closure at call time, which is fine here
  // because we don't want to refetch on language or theme change anyway.
  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const result = await hirerApi.getDashboard();
      setData(result);
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.networkError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [load]);

  const onRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load();
  }, [load]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <View style={styles.loadingWrap}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={theme.colors.orange} />
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  const stats = data?.stats || {};
  const recentBookings = data?.recentBookings || [];
  const recentWorkers = data?.recentWorkers || [];

  const goPostJob = () => navigation.navigate("PostJob");
  const goAllBookings = () => navigation.navigate("Bookings");
  const goAllWorkers = () => navigation.navigate("SavedWorkers");

  return (
    <AppScreen
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={onRefresh}
          tintColor={theme.colors.orange}
          colors={[theme.colors.orange]}
        />
      }
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <AppText variant="label" tone="brand">
        {t("dashboard.overview")}
      </AppText>
      <AppText variant="display" weight="displayBlack" style={styles.title}>
        {t("dashboard.title")}
      </AppText>

      {/* Controls row */}
      <View style={styles.controlsRow}>
        <CurrencyPicker label={t("dashboard.viewingIn")} />
        <AppButton
          title={t("dashboard.postAJob")}
          iconLeft="add"
          fullWidth={false}
          onPress={goPostJob}
          style={styles.postBtn}
        />
      </View>

      {/* 4 stat cards */}
      <View style={styles.statsGrid}>
        <View style={styles.statsRow}>
          <View style={styles.statCol}>
            <StatCard
              icon="📋"
              label={t("dashboard.totalBookings")}
              value={String(stats.totalBookings ?? 0)}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.statCol}>
            <StatCard
              icon="⚡"
              label={t("dashboard.activeJobs")}
              value={String(stats.activeBookings ?? 0)}
              tone="warning"
            />
          </View>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.statsRow}>
          <View style={styles.statCol}>
            <StatCard
              icon="✅"
              theme="success"
              label={t("dashboard.completed")}
              value={String(stats.completedBookings ?? 0)}
              // tone="success"
            />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.statCol}>
            <StatCard
              icon="💳"
              label={t("dashboard.totalSpent")}
              value={
                <AppCurrency
                  amount={stats.totalSpent ?? 0}
                  variant="display"
                  weight="displayBlack"
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 32,
                    lineHeight: 36,
                    letterSpacing: -0.5,
                  }}
                />
              }
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Recent Bookings */}
      <View style={{ marginTop: 24 }}>
        <Card padded>
          <SectionHeader
            title={t("dashboard.recentBookings")}
            actionLabel={t("dashboard.viewAll")}
            onActionPress={
              recentBookings.length > 0 ? goAllBookings : undefined
            }
          />
          {recentBookings.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon="briefcase-outline"
              text={t("dashboard.noBookingsYet")}
            />
          ) : (
            recentBookings.map((booking, idx) => (
              <BookingRow
                key={booking.id}
                booking={booking}
                showDivider={idx < recentBookings.length - 1}
                onPress={() =>
                  navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", { id: booking.id })
                }
              />
            ))
          )}
        </Card>
      </View>

      {/* Recent Workers */}
      <View style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
        <Card padded>
          <SectionHeader
            title={t("dashboard.recentWorkers")}
            actionLabel={t("dashboard.viewAll")}
            onActionPress={recentWorkers.length > 0 ? goAllWorkers : undefined}
          />
          {recentWorkers.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon="people-outline"
              text={t("dashboard.noWorkersYet")}
            />
          ) : (
            recentWorkers.map((worker, idx) => (
              <WorkerRow
                key={worker.id}
                worker={worker}
                showDivider={idx < recentWorkers.length - 1}
                onPress={() =>
                  navigation.navigate("WorkerDetail", { id: worker.id })
                }
              />
            ))
          )}
        </Card>
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

function EmptyState({ icon, text }) {
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <View style={styles.empty}>
      <Ionicons name={icon} size={32} color={theme.colors.textMuted} />
      <AppText variant="small" tone="muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
        {text}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  loadingWrap: { flex: 1, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" },
  title: { marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 42 },
  subtitle: { marginTop: 6 },
  controlsRow: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    alignItems: "center",
    gap: 10,
    marginTop: 20,
    flexWrap: "wrap",
  },
  postBtn: { flex: 1, minWidth: 140 },
  statsGrid: { marginTop: 20 },
  statsRow: {
    flexDirection: "row",
    marginBottom: 12,
    marginHorizontal: -6, // counteract child col margin to avoid edge gaps
  },
  statCol: {
    flex: 1,
    paddingHorizontal: 6, // creates the 12px gutter between cards
  },

  empty: {
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    paddingVertical: 32,
  },
});
