// src/screens/main/DisputesScreen.js
// Mirrors the website's My Disputes page exactly.
// Endpoints:
//   GET  /disputes/my                — list disputes
//   POST /disputes                   — raise a dispute (via RaiseDisputeSheet)
//   PATCH /disputes/:bookingId/cancel — cancel a dispute

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Modal,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import TopBar from "../../components/TopBar";
import ConfirmModal from "../../components/ConfirmModal";
import { getMyDisputes, raiseDispute, cancelDispute } from "../../api/disputes";

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "—";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

// ── Status config — disputes currently use booking status DISPUTED ─────────
const DISPUTE_STATUS = {
  DISPUTED: { label: "DISPUTED", color: "#f97316" },
  COMPLETED: { label: "RESOLVED", color: "#22c55e" },
  CANCELLED: { label: "CANCELLED", color: "#ef4444" },
  ACCEPTED: { label: "UNDER REVIEW", color: "#6366f1" },
};

// Filter tabs shown on the website
const FILTER_TABS = ["All", "Open", "Under Review", "Resolved", "Cancelled"];

// Map each tab to a set of booking statuses
const TAB_STATUSES = {
  All: null, // show all
  Open: ["DISPUTED"],
  "Under Review": ["ACCEPTED", "DISPUTED"],
  Resolved: ["COMPLETED"],
  Cancelled: ["CANCELLED"],
};

// ── Dispute reason presets (matches common dispute reasons) ───────────────────
const REASONS = [
  "Worker didn't show up",
  "Work quality was poor",
  "Work not completed",
  "Overcharged for service",
  "Damaged property",
  "Safety concern",
  "Other",
];

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Raise Dispute Sheet (bottom modal)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function RaiseDisputeSheet({
  bookingId,
  bookingTitle,
  visible,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  c,
}) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);
  const [reasonError, setReasonError] = useState("");
  const [descError, setDescError] = useState("");

  const reset = () => {
    setReason("");
    setDescription("");
    setReasonError("");
    setDescError("");
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    reset();
    onClose();
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    let valid = true;
    if (!reason) {
      setReasonError("Please select a reason.");
      valid = false;
    }
    if (description.trim().length < 10) {
      setDescError("Please provide at least 10 characters of detail.");
      valid = false;
    }
    if (!valid) return;

    setActing(true);
    try {
      await raiseDispute({
        bookingId,
        reason,
        description: description.trim(),
      });
      toast.success("Dispute raised. Our team will review within 24–48 hours.");
      reset();
      onSuccess?.();
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to raise dispute.");
    } finally {
      setActing(false);
    }
  };

  if (!visible) return null;

  return (
    <Modal
      visible
      transparent
      animationType="slide"
      onRequestClose={handleClose}
    >
      <Pressable style={styles.backdrop} onPress={handleClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            styles.sheet,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderTopColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <ScrollView showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
            {/* Handle */}
            <View style={[styles.handle, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

            {/* Header */}
            <View style={styles.sheetHeader}>
              <View>
                <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold">
                  ⚠️ Raise a Dispute
                </AppText>
                {bookingTitle && (
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {bookingTitle}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleClose}
                style={[
                  styles.closeBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText tone="dim">✕</AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Reason */}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={[styles.fieldLabel, { color: c.textMuted }]}
            >
              REASON *
            </AppText>
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
              contentContainerStyle={styles.reasonPills}
            >
              {REASONS.map((r) => {
                const active = reason === r;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={r}
                    style={[
                      styles.reasonPill,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgInput,
                        borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                      },
                    ]}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setReason(r);
                      setReasonError("");
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
                    >
                      {r}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
            {reasonError && (
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="danger"
                style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
              >
                {reasonError}
              </AppText>
            )}

            {/* Description */}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={[styles.fieldLabel, { color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 12 }]}
            >
              DESCRIPTION *
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              multiline
              numberOfLines={5}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              placeholder="Describe the issue in detail — what happened, when, and what outcome you expect…"
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              value={description}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setDescription(v);
                setDescError("");
              }}
              style={[
                styles.textarea,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: descError ? "#ef4444" : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />
            {descError && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {descError}
              </AppText>
            )}

            {/* Info note */}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.infoNote,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.08)",
                  borderColor: "rgba(249,115,22,0.25)",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ lineHeight: 18 }}>
                ⚠️ Raising a dispute will freeze the booking payment. Our team
                will review within 24–48 hours and contact both parties.
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {/* Submit */}
            <Pressable
              style={[
                styles.submitBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: acting ? c.bgCard : c.orange,
                  opacity: acting ? 0.7 : 1,
                },
              ]}
              disabled={acting}
              onPress={handleSubmit}
            >
              {acting ? (
                <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  Submit Dispute
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>

            <Pressable onPress={handleClose} style={styles.cancelLink}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                Cancel — go back
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </ScrollView>
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Dispute Card (expandable)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DisputeCard({ item, expanded, onToggle, onViewBooking, onCancel, c }) {
  const statusMeta = DISPUTE_STATUS[item.status] ?? {
    label: item.status,
    color: "#888",
  };

  // Description: booking notes or description (dispute reason not stored separately in this schema)
  const description = item.notes || item.description || "—";

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.disputeCard,
        {
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderColor: expanded ? c.orange : c.border,
          borderWidth: expanded ? 1 : StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Card header — always visible */}
      <Pressable onPress={onToggle} style={styles.cardHeader}>
        {/* Warning icon */}
        <View style={[styles.warnIcon, { borderColor: c.orange }]}>
          <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
            ⚠
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Title + date */}
        <View style={styles.cardTitleBlock}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
            Booking dispute
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            · {fmtDate(item.updatedAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {/* Status badge + toggle */}
        <View style={styles.cardRight}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.statusBadge,
              {
                backgroundColor: `${statusMeta.color}22`,
                borderColor: `${statusMeta.color}55`,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: statusMeta.color, fontSize: 10 }}
            >
              {statusMeta.label}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
            {expanded ? "▲" : "▼"}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </Pressable>

      {/* Expanded content */}
      {expanded && (
        <View style={[styles.cardBody, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          {/* Category if available */}
          {item.category?.name && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.catChip,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {item.category.name}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Booking title */}
          {item.title && (
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
            >
              {item.title}
            </AppText>
          )}

          {/* Description label */}
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: "#888", letterSpacing: 0.8, marginBottom: 6 }}
          >
            DESCRIPTION
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="body" style={{ marginBottom: 14, lineHeight: 22 }}>
            {description}
          </AppText>

          {/* Parties */}
          {(item.hirer || item.worker) && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.partiesRow,
                { borderTopColor: c.border, borderBottomColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              {item.hirer && (
                <View style={styles.partyItem}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 2 }}
                  >
                    Hirer
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                    {item.hirer.firstName} {item.hirer.lastName}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
              {item.worker && (
                <View style={styles.partyItem}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 2 }}
                  >
                    Worker
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                    {item.worker.firstName} {item.worker.lastName}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Payment info */}
          {item.payment && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.paymentRow,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                Payment
              </AppText>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.statusBadge,
                  {
                    backgroundColor:
                      item.payment.status === "HELD"
                        ? "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)"
                        : "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)",
                    borderColor:
                      item.payment.status === "HELD" ? "#f97316" : "#22c55e",
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{
                    color:
                      item.payment.status === "HELD" ? "#f97316" : "#22c55e",
                    fontSize: 10,
                  }}
                >
                  {item.payment.status}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Actions */}
          <View style={styles.cardActions}>
            {/* View Booking */}
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => onViewBooking(item.id)}
              style={styles.viewBookingBtn}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#f97316" }}
              >
                View Booking →
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>

            {/* Cancel dispute (only if still DISPUTED) */}
            {item.status === "DISPUTED" && (
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => onCancel(item.id)}
                style={[styles.cancelDisputeBtn, { borderColor: "#ef4444" }]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
                >
                  Cancel Dispute
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Admin review note */}
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.reviewNote}>
            Our team reviews disputes within 24–48 hours. Keep an eye on your
            notifications.
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Skeleton
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12, paddingHorizontal: 16, paddingTop: 8 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            styles.skCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function DisputesScreen({ navigation, route }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  // Route params: bookingId + bookingTitle for pre-opening the raise sheet
  const fromBookingId = route?.params?.bookingId ?? null;
  const fromBookingTitle = route?.params?.bookingTitle ?? null;

  const [disputes, setDisputes] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("All");
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(null); // bookingId of expanded card
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);

  // Raise dispute sheet
  const [sheetBookingId, setSheetBookingId] = useState(fromBookingId);
  const [sheetBookingTitle, setSheetBookingTitle] = useState(fromBookingTitle);
  const [sheetVisible, setSheetVisible] = useState(!!fromBookingId);

  // ── Fetch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchDisputes = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getMyDisputes();
      setDisputes(data.disputes ?? []);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to load disputes.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDisputes();
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    fetchDisputes();
  };

  // ── Cancel dispute ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleCancel = (bookingId) => {
    setModal({
      title: "Cancel Dispute",
      message: "Cancel this dispute? The booking will be marked as Completed.",
      confirmLabel: "Yes, Cancel Dispute",
      destructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await cancelDispute(bookingId);
          toast.success("Dispute cancelled. Booking marked as completed.");
          setExpanded(null);
          fetchDisputes();
        } catch (err) {
          toast.error(
            err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to cancel dispute.",
          );
        }
      },
    });
  };

  // ── Derived stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const total = disputes.length;
  const active = disputes.filter((d) => d.status === "DISPUTED").length;
  const resolved = disputes.filter((d) =>
    ["COMPLETED", "CANCELLED"].includes(d.status),
  ).length;

  // ── Filtered list ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const allowed = TAB_STATUSES[activeTab];
  const visible = allowed
    ? disputes.filter((d) => allowed.includes(d.status))
    : disputes;

  // ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={visible}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* ── Page header ── */}
            <View style={styles.pageHeader}>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 1.2, marginBottom: 6 }}
              >
                SUPPORT
              </AppText>
              <AppText style={[styles.heroTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                My Disputes
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ marginTop: 4, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                Track and manage disputes raised on your bookings
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {/* ── Stats row ── */}
            <View style={styles.statsRow}>
              <View style={styles.statItem}>
                <AppText style={[styles.statNum, { color: c.text }]}>
                  {total}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  Total
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.statItem}>
                <AppText style={[styles.statNum, { color: c.orange }]}>
                  {active}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  Active
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.statItem}>
                <AppText style={[styles.statNum, { color: "#22c55e" }]}>
                  {resolved}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  Resolved
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>

            {/* ── Filter tabs ── */}
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              style={styles.tabsScroll}
              contentContainerStyle={styles.tabsContent}
            >
              {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
                const active = activeTab === tab;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={tab}
                    onPress={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                    style={[
                      styles.tab,
                      { borderBottomColor: active ? c.orange : "transparent" },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight={active ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                      style={{ color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted }}
                    >
                      {tab}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
            {/* Tab underline bar */}
            <View style={[styles.tabBar, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <DisputeCard
            item={item}
            expanded={expanded === item.id}
            onToggle={() =>
              setExpanded((prev) => (prev === item.id ? null : item.id))
            }
            onViewBooking={(id) =>
              navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", { bookingId: id })
            }
            onCancel={handleCancel}
            c={c}
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40, textAlign: "center" }}>
                ⚖️
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                No disputes
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 20 }}
              >
                {activeTab === "All"
                  ? "You have no disputes. We hope it stays that way!"
                  : `No ${activeTab.toLowerCase()} disputes found.`}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={<View style={{ height: 40 }} />}
      />

      {/* Raise dispute sheet */}
      <RaiseDisputeSheet
        bookingId={sheetBookingId}
        bookingTitle={sheetBookingTitle}
        visible={sheetVisible}
        onClose={() => setSheetVisible(false)}
        onSuccess={fetchDisputes}
        c={c}
      />

      {/* Confirm modal */}
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title}
        message={modal?.message}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel}
        destructive={modal?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

const APP_STATUS = {
  PENDING: { label: "Pending", color: "#f97316", bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.12)" },
  ACCEPTED: { label: "Accepted", color: "#22c55e", bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)" },
  REJECTED: { label: "Rejected", color: "#ef4444", bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)" },

// ─── Stars ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Stars({ rating, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row" }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
        <Ionicons
          key={s}
          name={s <= Math.round(rating) ? "star" : "star-outline"}
          size={12}
          color={s <= Math.round(rating) ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Application card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function AppCard({ app, onAccept, onReject, updating, c, t }) {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { worker } = app;
  const wp = worker?.workerProfile;
  const sm = APP_STATUS[app.status] ?? APP_STATUS.PENDING;
  const isPending = app.status === "PENDING";

  return (
    <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
      {/* Worker top row */}
      <View style={styles.workerTop}>
        {/* Avatar */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.workerAvatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {worker?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: worker.avatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {worker?.firstName?.[0]}
              {worker?.lastName?.[0]}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        {/* Info */}
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginHorizontal: 12 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
            {worker?.firstName} {worker?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
            {wp?.title ?? "Worker"}
          </AppText>
          {(worker?.city || worker?.country) && (
            <View style={styles.locRow}>
              <Ionicons
                name="location-outline"
                size={11}
                color={c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginRight: 3 }}
              />
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
                {[worker.city, worker.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
        {/* Status badge */}
        <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: sm.bg }]}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: sm.color }}
          >
            {sm.label}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Worker stats */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.statsRow,
          { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
      >
        {wp?.avgRating > 0 && (
          <View style={styles.statItem}>
            <Stars rating={wp.avgRating} c={c} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}
            >
              {Number(wp.avgRating).toFixed(1)}
            </AppText>
            {wp.totalReviews > 0 && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 3 }}>
                ({wp.totalReviews})
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
        )}
        {wp?.completedJobs > 0 && (
          <View style={styles.statItem}>
            <AppText variant="small">✅</AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
              {wp.completedJobs} {t("jobs.apply.jobsDone")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
        {wp?.hourlyRate > 0 && (
          <View style={styles.statItem}>
            <AppText variant="small">💰</AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
              {wp.currency} {Number(wp.hourlyRate).toLocaleString()}/hr
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
        {wp?.yearsExperience > 0 && (
          <View style={styles.statItem}>
            <AppText variant="small">🏆</AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
              {wp.yearsExperience} {t("jobs.apply.yrsExp")}
            </AppText>

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function JobApplicationsScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;

  const jobId = route.params?.jobId;

  const [job, setJob] = useState(null);
  const [applications, setApplications] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!jobId) return;
    Promise.all([getJobPost(jobId), getJobApplications(jobId)])
      .then(([jobData, appsData]) => {
        setJob(jobData.jobPost);
        setApplications(appsData.applications ?? []);
      })
      .catch(() => setError(t("jobs.notFound")))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [jobId]);

  const handleDecision = (appId, status) => {
    setModal({
      title:
        status === "ACCEPTED"
          ? t("jobs.apply.acceptConfirm")
          : t("jobs.apply.declineConfirm"),
      confirmLabel:
        status === "ACCEPTED"
          ? t("jobs.apply.accept")
          : t("jobs.apply.decline"),
      destructive: status === "REJECTED",
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setUpdating(appId);
        try {
          await updateApplicationStatus(jobId, appId, status);
          setApplications((prev) =>
            prev.map((a) => (a.id === appId ? { ...a, status } : a)),
          );
          if (status === "ACCEPTED") {
            setJob((j) => (j ? { ...j, status: "FILLED" } : j));
            toast.success(t("jobs.apply.acceptSuccess"));
          } else {
            toast.success(t("jobs.apply.declineSuccess"));
          }
        } catch {
          toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
        } finally {
          setUpdating(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const pending = applications.filter((a) => a.status === "PENDING");
  const reviewed = applications.filter((a) => a.status !== "PENDING");
  const accepted = applications.filter((a) => a.status === "ACCEPTED").length;

  if (loading)
    return (
      <AppScreen scrollable={false}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );

  return (
    <AppScreen contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
      {/* Back */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => navigation.navigate("JobsManagement")}
        style={styles.backBtn}
        hitSlop={8}
      >
        <Ionicons
          name="arrow-back"
          size={16}
          color={c.text}
          style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
        />
        <AppText variant="small">{t("common.back")}</AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ── JOB SUMMARY ── */}
      {job && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <View style={styles.jobSummary}>
            <View style={[styles.jobIcon, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}>
              <AppText variant="body">{job.category?.icon ?? "📋"}</AppText>
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={2}>
                {job.title}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
                {job.category?.name} · {job.address} ·{" "}
                {new Date(job.scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                  day: "numeric",
                  month: "short",
                  year: "numeric",
                })}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Stats row */}
          <View style={[styles.summaryStats, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            {[
              {
                label: t("jobs.apply.totalApps"),
                value: applications.length,
                color: c.text,
              },
              {
                label: t("jobs.apply.pending"),
                value: pending.length,
                color: c.orange,
              },
              {
                label: t("jobs.apply.accepted"),
                value: accepted,
                color: "#22c55e",
              },
            ].map((s) => (
              <View key={s.label} style={styles.summaryStatItem}>
                <AppText
                  variant="title"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: s.color }}
                >
                  {s.value}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {s.label}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Empty state */}
      {applications.length === 0 && (
        <Card padded style={styles.emptyCard}>
          <Ionicons name="mail-open-outline" size={36} color={c.textMuted} />
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            {t("jobs.apply.noApps")}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginTop: 6, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            {t("jobs.apply.noAppsText")}
          </AppText>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Pending section */}
      {pending.length > 0 && (
        <View style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
          <SectionHead
            label={t("jobs.apply.pendingReview")}
            count={pending.length}
            c={c}
          />
          {pending.map((app) => (
            <AppCard
              key={app.id}
              app={app}
              updating={updating === app.id}
              onAccept={() => handleDecision(app.id, "ACCEPTED")}
              onReject={() => handleDecision(app.id, "REJECTED")}
              c={c}
              t={t}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Reviewed section */}
      {reviewed.length > 0 && (
        <View>
          <SectionHead
            label={t("jobs.apply.reviewed")}
            count={reviewed.length}
            c={c}
          />
          {reviewed.map((app) => (
            <AppCard
              key={app.id}
              app={app}
              updating={updating === app.id}
              c={c}
              t={t}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel ?? t("common.yes")}
        cancelLabel={t("common.no")}
        destructive={modal?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import Card from "../../components/Card";
import ConfirmModal from "../../components/ConfirmModal";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STATUS_META = {
  PENDING: {
    label: "Pending",
    color: "#f97316",
    bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.15)",
    step: 0,
  },
  ACCEPTED: {
    label: "Accepted",
    color: "#f97316",
    bg: "rgba(249,115,22,0.25)",
    step: 1,
  },
  IN_PROGRESS: {
    label: "In Progress",
    color: "#6366f1",
    bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.15)",
    step: 2,
  },
  COMPLETED: {
    label: "Completed",
    color: "#22c55e",
    bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)",
    step: 3,
  },
  CANCELLED: {
    label: "Cancelled",
    color: "#ef4444",
    bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)",
    step: -1,
  },
  DISPUTED: {
    label: "Disputed",
    color: "#f43f5e",
    bg: "rgba(244,63,94,0.12)",
    step: -1,
  },
};

const TIMELINE_STEPS = ["Pending", "Accepted", "In Progress", "Completed"];

function formatDuration(booking) {
  if (!booking) return null;
  const unit = booking.estimatedUnit || "hours";
  const value = booking.estimatedValue;
  const hours = booking.estimatedHours;
  if (!value && !hours) return null;
  if (value) {
    if (unit === "custom") return { main: value, sub: null };
    const labels = {
      hours: "hour",
      days: "day",
      weeks: "week",
      months: "month",
    };
    const num = parseFloat(value);
    const label = (labels[unit] || unit) + (num !== 1 ? "s" : "");
    const eqv = unit !== "hours" && hours ? `≈ ${hours}h` : null;
    return { main: `${num} ${label}`, sub: eqv };
  }
  return hours ? { main: `${hours} hours`, sub: null } : null;
}

function calcEstTotal(booking) {
  const rate = booking.agreedRate;
  const unit = booking.estimatedUnit;
  const value = booking.estimatedValue;
  if (!rate || !value || !unit || unit === "custom") return null;
  const num = parseFloat(value);
  const suffix =
    { hours: "/hr", days: "/day", weeks: "/wk", months: "/mo" }[unit] || "";
  return {
    num,
    unit,
    rate,
    total: num * rate,
    currency: booking.currency,
    suffix,
  };
}

        {label.toUpperCase()}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        weight="semibold"
        style={accent ? { color: "#f97316" } : {}}
      >
        {value || "—"}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Timeline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Timeline({ step, c }) {
  if (step < 0) return null;
  return (
    <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
      <View style={styles.timeline}>
        {TIMELINE_STEPS.map((label, i) => {
          const done = i < step;
          const current = i === step;
          return (
            <View key={label} style={styles.timelineItem}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.timelineDot,
                  {
                    borderColor: done || current ? "#f97316" : c.border,
                    backgroundColor: done
                      ? "#f97316"
                      : current
                        ? c.bgCard
                        : c.bgCard,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                {done ? (
                  <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={12} color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{
                      color: current ? "#f97316" : c.textMuted,
                      fontSize: 11,
                    }}
                  >
                    {i + 1}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{
                  color: done || current ? c.text : c.textMuted,
                  fontSize: 10,
                  marginTop: 4,
                  textAlign: "center",
                }}
              >
                {label}
              </AppText>
              {i < TIMELINE_STEPS.length - 1 && (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.timelineLine,
                    { backgroundColor: i < step ? "#f97316" : c.border },
                  ]}
                />
              )}
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function BookingDetailScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const bookingId = route.params?.bookingId;

  const [booking, setBooking] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
  const [showCancel, setShowCancel] = useState(false);
  const [cancelReason, setCancelReason] = useState("");
  const [cancelError, setCancelError] = useState("");
  const [payMethod, setPayMethod] = useState("card"); // "card"|"bank"|"crypto"
  const [selectedCrypto, setSelectedCrypto] = useState("USDC");
  const [showInsurance, setShowInsurance] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPlan, setSelectedPlan] = useState("standard");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!bookingId) return;
    getBooking(bookingId)
      .then(setBooking)
      .catch(() => toast.error(t("toast.networkError")))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [bookingId]);

  const doStatus = async (status, extra = {}) => {
    setActing(true);
    try {
      const updated = await updateBookingStatus(bookingId, status, extra);
      setBooking(updated);
      toast.success(`Booking ${status.toLowerCase().replace("_", " ")}.`);
      setShowCancel(false);
      setCancelReason("");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setActing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    if (!cancelReason.trim()) {
      setCancelError(t("bookings.cancelReasonRequired"));
      return;
    }
    doStatus("CANCELLED", { cancelReason: cancelReason.trim() });
  };

  if (loading)
    return (
      <AppScreen scrollable={false}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );

  if (!booking)
    return (
      <AppScreen scrollable={false}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={40} color={c.red} />
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            {t("bookings.notFound")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );

  const meta = STATUS_META[booking.status] ?? STATUS_META.PENDING;
  const step = meta.step ?? 0;
  const isHirer = user?.id === booking.hirerId;
  const other = isHirer ? booking.worker : booking.hirer;
  const dur = formatDuration(booking);
  const estTotal = calcEstTotal(booking);
  const scheduled = new Date(booking.scheduledAt);
  const canCancel = ["PENDING", "ACCEPTED"].includes(booking.status);

  return (
    <AppScreen contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}>
      {/* Back */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
        style={styles.backBtn}
        hitSlop={8}
      >
        <Ionicons
          name="arrow-back"
          size={16}
          color={c.text}
          style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
        />
        <AppText variant="small">{t("bookings.backToBookings")}</AppText>
      </Pressable>

      {/* ── TITLE BLOCK ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <View style={styles.titleRow}>
          <AppText
            variant="display"
            weight="displayBlack"
            style={{ flex: 1, lineHeight: 36 }}
          >
            {booking.title}
          </AppText>
          <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: meta.bg }]}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: meta.color }}
            >
              {booking.status.replace("_", " ")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
        {booking.category && (
          <View style={[styles.catChip, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {booking.category.name}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ── TIMELINE ── */}
      <Timeline step={step} c={c} />

      {/* ── DESCRIPTION ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={styles.sectionLabel}
        >
          {t("bookings.description").toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 22 }}>
          {booking.description}
        </AppText>
        {booking.notes && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.notesBox,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small">📝</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8, lineHeight: 20 }}
            >
              {booking.notes}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ── JOB DETAILS ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={styles.sectionLabel}
        >
          {t("bookings.jobDetails").toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.detailGrid}>
          <DetailCell
            icon="📅"
            label={t("bookings.scheduled")}
            value={`${scheduled.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { weekday: "short", day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" })} at ${scheduled.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" })}`}
            c={c}
          />
          {booking.address && (
            <DetailCell
              icon="📍"
              label={t("bookings.address")}
              value={booking.address}
              c={c}
            />
          )}
          <DetailCell
            icon="💰"
            label={t("bookings.agreedRate")}
            value={`${booking.currency} ${Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}`}
            accent
            c={c}
          />
          {dur && (
            <DetailCell
              icon="⏱️"
              label={t("bookings.duration")}
              value={dur.sub ? `${dur.main} ${dur.sub}` : dur.main}
              c={c}
            />
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Estimated total */}
        {estTotal && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.totalRow,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Est. Total ({estTotal.num} {estTotal.unit} × {estTotal.currency}{" "}
              {Number(estTotal.rate).toLocaleString()}
              {estTotal.suffix})
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="title"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 4 }}
            >
              {estTotal.currency} {Number(estTotal.total).toLocaleString()}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </Card>

      {/* ── PAYMENT ── */}
      {booking.payment && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            tone="dim"
            style={styles.sectionLabel}
          >
            {t("bookings.payment").toUpperCase()}
          </AppText>
          {[
            {
              label: "Total",
              value: `${booking.payment.currency} ${Number(booking.payment.amount).toLocaleString()}`,
            },
            {
              label: "Platform Fee",
              value: `${booking.payment.currency} ${Number(booking.payment.platformFee).toLocaleString()}`,
              muted: true,
            },
            {
              label: "Worker Payout",
              value: `${booking.payment.currency} ${Number(booking.payment.workerPayout).toLocaleString()}`,
              green: true,
            },
            { label: "Status", value: booking.payment.status },
            { label: "Provider", value: booking.payment.provider },
          ].map((row) => (
            <View
              key={row.label}
              style={[styles.payRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
                {row.label}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: row.green
                    ? "#22c55e"
                    : row.muted
                      ? c.textMuted
                      : c.text,
                }}
              >
                {row.value}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ── Cancellation reason ── */}
      {booking.cancelReason && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.cancelReasonBox,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.08)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small">⚠️</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              tone="dim"
              style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 8 }}
            >
              {booking.cancelReason}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ── WORKER / HIRER CARD ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={[styles.sectionLabel, { textAlign: "center" }]}
        >
          {(isHirer ? t("bookings.worker") : t("bookings.hirer")).toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.partyBody}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.partyAvatar,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            {other?.avatar ? (
              <Image
                source={{ uri: other.avatar }}
                style={styles.partyAvatarImg}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {other?.firstName?.[0]}
                {other?.lastName?.[0]}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            {other?.firstName} {other?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          {other?.phone && (
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => Linking.openURL(`tel:${other.phone}`)}
              style={styles.phoneRow}
            >
              <AppText variant="small">📱</AppText>
              <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
                {other.phone}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("Profile", { userId: other?.id })
            }
            style={[
              styles.viewProfileBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {t("profile.myProfile")} →
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.viewProfileBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                marginTop: 8,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() => toast.info("Messages coming soon")}
          >
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              💬 {t("bookings.sendMessage")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </Card>

      {/* ── PAYMENT BREAKDOWN + OPTIONS (hirer ACCEPTED, no payment yet) ── */}
      {isHirer && booking.status === "ACCEPTED" && !booking.payment && (
        <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
          {/* Breakdown */}
          <View style={styles.breakdownHeader}>
            <AppText variant="small">💰</AppText>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}>
              {t("bookings.breakdown")}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          {[
            {
              label: t("bookings.agreedRateLabel"),
              value: `${booking.currency} ${Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()}${estTotal ? estTotal.suffix : ""}`,
            },
            ...(estTotal
              ? [
                  {
                    label: t("bookings.durationLabel"),
                    value: `${estTotal.num} ${estTotal.unit}`,
                  },
                ]
              : []),
            ...(estTotal
              ? [
                  {
                    label: `Subtotal (${estTotal.num} × ${booking.currency} ${Number(booking.agreedRate).toLocaleString()})`,
                    value: `${booking.currency} ${Number(estTotal.total).toLocaleString()}`,
                  },
                ]
              : []),
            {
              label: t("bookings.platformFee"),
              value: `– ${booking.currency} ${Number((estTotal?.total ?? booking.agreedRate) * 0.1).toLocaleString()}`,
              muted: true,
            },
          ].map((row) => (
            <View
              key={row.label}
              style={[styles.payRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" tone={row.muted ? "dim" : "default"}>
                {row.label}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: row.muted ? c.textMuted : c.text }}
              >
                {row.value}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ))}
          <View style={[styles.youPayRow, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              {t("bookings.youPay")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="display"
              weight="displayBlack"
              style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 28 }}
            >
              {booking.currency}{" "}
              {Number(
                (estTotal?.total ?? booking.agreedRate) * 1.1,
              ).toLocaleString()}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Payment method toggle */}
          <View style={[styles.methodRow, { marginTop: 16 }]}>
            {[
              { id: "card", label: "💳 " + t("bookings.payWithCard") },
              { id: "bank", label: "🏦 " + t("bookings.bankTransfer") },
              { id: "crypto", label: "₿ " + t("bookings.cryptoPay") },
            ].map((m) => (
              <Pressable
                key={m.id}
                onPress={() => setPayMethod(m.id)}
                style={[
                  styles.methodBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: payMethod === m.id ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: payMethod === m.id ? c.orange : c.border,
                    flex: 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: payMethod === m.id ? "#fff" : c.text }}
                >
                  {m.label}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>

          {/* Card payment */}
          {payMethod === "card" && (
            <Pressable
              style={[
                styles.bigBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.orange, marginTop: 14 },
              ]}
              onPress={() => toast.info("Stripe card payment coming soon")}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#fff" }}
              >
                💳 {t("bookings.payWithCard")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          )}

          {/* Bank transfer */}
          {payMethod === "bank" && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.bankBox,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                {t("bookings.bankTransfer")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
                {t("bookings.bankNote")}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                style={[
                  styles.bigBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.orange, marginTop: 12 },
                ]}
                onPress={() => toast.info("Bank transfer details coming soon")}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  🏦 {t("bookings.initiateBankTransfer")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Crypto payment */}
          {payMethod === "crypto" && (
            <View style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                {t("bookings.cryptoNote")}
              </AppText>
              <View style={styles.cryptoGrid}>
                {CRYPTO_OPTIONS.map((coin) => (
                  <Pressable
                    key={coin.id}
                    onPress={() => setSelectedCrypto(coin.id)}
                    style={[
                      styles.cryptoCard,
                      {
                        borderColor:
                          selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orange : c.border,
                        backgroundColor:
                          selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="title"
                      style={{
                        color:
                          selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orange : c.textMuted,
                      }}
                    >
                      {coin.icon}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{
                        color: selectedCrypto === coin.id ? c.orange : c.text,
                        marginTop: 6,
                      }}
                    >
                      {coin.label}
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      {coin.sub}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                ))}
              </View>
              <Pressable
                style={[
                  styles.bigBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.orange, marginTop: 14 },
                ]}
                onPress={() =>
                  toast.info(`${selectedCrypto} payment coming soon`)
                }
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  ◆ {t("bookings.payWith", { coin: selectedCrypto })}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
              >
                {t("bookings.escrowNote")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}

          {/* Insurance addon */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setShowInsurance((v) => !v)}
            style={[
              styles.insuranceToggle,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View
              style={[styles.insuranceShield, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
            >
              <AppText variant="body">🛡️</AppText>
            </View>
            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                {t("bookings.insurance.title")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t("bookings.insurance.subtitle")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
              {showInsurance ? "▲" : "▼"}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>

          {showInsurance && (
            <View style={[styles.insurancePlans, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}
              >
                {t("bookings.insurance.choosePlan")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
                {t("bookings.insurance.planNote")}
              </AppText>
              {INSURANCE_PLANS.map((plan) => (
                <Pressable
                  key={plan.id}
                  onPress={() => setSelectedPlan(plan.id)}
                  style={[
                    styles.planCard,
                    {
                      borderColor:
                        selectedPlan === plan.id ? c.orange : c.border,
                      backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                      marginBottom: 12,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  {plan.popular && (
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.popularBadge,
                        { backgroundColor: c.orange },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 10 }}
                      >
                        {t("bookings.insurance.mostPopular")}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  )}
                  <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                    {plan.name}
                  </AppText>
                  <View
                    style={{
                      flexDirection: "row",
                      alignItems: "baseline",
                      gap: 4,
                      marginTop: 6,
                    }}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                      USD
                    </AppText>
                    <AppText
                      variant="display"
                      weight="displayBlack"
                      style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 32 }}
                    >
                      ${plan.price}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
                  >
                    Covers up to {plan.covers}
                  </AppText>
                  {plan.features.map((f) => (
                    <View key={f} style={styles.featureRow}>
                      <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
                        ✓
                      </AppText>
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        tone="dim"
                        style={{ marginLeft: 8 }}
                      >
                        {f}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </Pressable>
              ))}
              <Pressable
                style={[styles.bigBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                onPress={() =>
                  toast.info("Insurance payment via Stripe coming soon")
                }
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                >
                  🛡️ {t("bookings.insurance.payActivate")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 8 }}
              >
                {t("bookings.insurance.secureNote")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* ── ACTIONS CARD ── */}
      <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          weight="semibold"
          tone="dim"
          style={styles.sectionLabel}
        >
          {t("bookings.actions").toUpperCase()}
        </AppText>

        {/* Release payment */}
        {isHirer && booking.payment?.status === "HELD" && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)",
                borderColor: "#22c55e",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() =>
              setModal({
                title: t("bookings.releaseConfirm"),
                confirmLabel: t("bookings.release"),
                onConfirm: () => toast.info("Release payment coming soon"),
              })
            }
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}
            >
              💸 {t("bookings.releasePayment")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {/* Worker accept pending */}
        {!isHirer && booking.status === "PENDING" && (
          <AppButton
            title={t("bookings.accept")}
            onPress={() => doStatus("ACCEPTED")}
            loading={acting}
            style={{ marginTop: 12 }}
          />
        )}

        {/* Cancel — inline */}
        {canCancel && !showCancel && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.08)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() => {
              setShowCancel(true);
              setCancelError("");
            }}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
            >
              {t("bookings.cancelBooking")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {canCancel && showCancel && (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.cancelBox,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("bookings.cancelReason")} *
            </AppText>
            <TextInput
              multiline
              numberOfLines={3}
              textAlignVertical="top"
              placeholder={t("bookings.cancelReasonPlaceholder")}
              placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
              value={cancelReason}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setCancelReason(v);
                setCancelError("");
              }}
              style={[
                styles.cancelInput,
                {
                  color: c.text,
                  borderColor: cancelError ? "#ef4444" : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            />
            {cancelError && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {cancelError}
              </AppText>
            )}
            <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleCancel}
                disabled={acting}
                style={[
                  styles.cancelConfirmBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: "#ef4444", flex: 1 },
                ]}
              >
                {acting ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: "#fff" }}
                  >
                    {t("bookings.confirmCancel")}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => {
                  setShowCancel(false);
                  setCancelReason("");
                  setCancelError("");
                }}
                style={[
                  styles.cancelConfirmBtn,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                    borderColor: c.border,
                    borderWidth: 1,
                    flex: 1,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" tone="dim">
                  {t("bookings.keepBooking")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Video Call */}
        {["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS"].includes(booking.status) && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "#1e1b4b",
                borderColor: "#6366f1",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() => toast.info("Video call coming soon")}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#a5b4fc" }}
            >
              📹 {t("bookings.videoCall")}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: "#6366f1", marginTop: 2 }}>
              {t("bookings.videoCallSub")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {/* Raise a Dispute */}
        {["ACCEPTED", "IN_PROGRESS", "COMPLETED"].includes(booking.status) && (
          <Pressable
            style={[
              styles.bigBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.06)",
                borderColor: "#ef4444",
                borderWidth: 1,
                marginTop: 12,
              },
            ]}
            onPress={() => toast.info("Dispute system coming soon")}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
            >
              ⚠️ {t("bookings.raiseDispute")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}

        {!canCancel && booking.status === "COMPLETED" && (
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 12 }}
          >
            {t("bookings.noActions")}
          </AppText>
        )}
      </Card>

      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel ?? t("common.yes")}
        cancelLabel={t("common.no")}
        destructive={modal?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/JobsManagementScreen.js
// Mirrors the website's HirerJobBoardManagement — job cards, filter tabs,
// status actions, pagination. API: GET /jobs/hirer/me

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation } from "@react-navigation/native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import Card from "../../components/Card";
