// ─── Duration label ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function durationLabel(job) {
  if (!job.durationType || !job.durationValue) return null;
  const v = job.durationValue;
  switch (job.durationType) {
    case "HOURS":
      return `${v} hrs`;
    case "DAYS":
      return `${v} days`;
    case "WEEKS":
      return `${v} weeks`;
    case "MONTHS":
      return `${v} months`;
    case "CUSTOM":
      return v;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ─── Status meta ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STATUS_META = {
  OPEN: { color: "#22c55e", bg: "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)" },
  FILLED: { color: "#6366f1", bg: "rgba(99,102,241,0.12)" },
  CANCELLED: { color: "#ef4444", bg: "rgba(239,68,68,0.12)" },
};

// ─── Location icon helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function locTypeIcon(type) {
  if (type === "ON_SITE") return "location-outline";
  if (type === "HYBRID") return "git-merge-outline";
  return "globe-outline";
}

// ─── Job Card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function JobCard({ job, onStatusChange, acting, c, t }) {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);
  const meta = STATUS_META[job.status] ?? STATUS_META.OPEN;
  const isOpen = job.status === "OPEN";
  const dur = durationLabel(job);
  const appCount = job._count?.applications ?? 0;
  const previews = job.applications?.slice(0, 3) ?? [];

  const confirmStatus = (newStatus) => {
    setModal({
      title:
        newStatus === "FILLED"
          ? t("jobs.markFilledConfirm")
          : newStatus === "CANCELLED"
            ? t("jobs.cancelConfirm")
            : t("jobs.reopenConfirm"),
      confirmLabel: t("common.yes"),
      destructive: newStatus === "CANCELLED",
      onConfirm: () => onStatusChange(job.id, newStatus),
    });
  };

  return (
    <Card style={styles.jobCard}>
      {/* Accent bar */}
      <View style={[styles.accentBar, { backgroundColor: meta.color }]} />

      <View style={styles.cardInner}>
        {/* Top row: category chip + status badge */}
        <View style={styles.cardTop}>
          <View style={[styles.catChip, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}>
            {job.category?.icon ? (
              <AppText variant="small">{job.category.icon}</AppText>
            ) : null}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}
              numberOfLines={1}
            >
              {job.category?.name ?? "General"}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View style={[styles.statusBadge, { backgroundColor: meta.bg }]}>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: meta.color }}
            >
              {job.status}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        {/* Job meta tags: type · location · payment type */}
        <View style={styles.tagsRow}>
          {job.jobType && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.tagPill,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t(`postJob.jobType.${job.jobType}`)}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
          {job.locationType && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.tagPill,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={locTypeIcon(job.locationType)}
                size={11}
                color={c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginRight: 3 }}
              />
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {t(`postJob.locationType.${job.locationType}`)}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
          {job.budgetType && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.tagPill,
                { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange }}
              >
                {t(`postJob.paymentType.${job.budgetType}`)}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Title & description */}
        <AppText
          variant="title"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ marginTop: 8 }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {job.title}
        </AppText>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          tone="dim"
          numberOfLines={2}
          style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
        >
          {job.description}
        </AppText>

        {/* Meta row: date · location · duration */}
        <View style={styles.metaRow}>
          <View style={styles.metaItem}>
            <Ionicons
              name="calendar-outline"
              size={12}
              color={c.textMuted}
              style={{ marginRight: 4 }}
            />
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              {new Date(job.scheduledAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                day: "numeric",
                month: "short",
                year: "numeric",
              })}
            </AppText>
          </View>
          {job.address && (
            <View style={styles.metaItem}>
              <Ionicons
                name="location-outline"
                size={12}
                color={c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginRight: 4 }}
              />
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
                {job.address}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
          {dur && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.durBadge,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name="time-outline"
                size={11}
                color={c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginRight: 3 }}
              />
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {dur}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )}
        </View>

        {/* Budget + applicant count */}
        <View style={styles.budgetRow}>
          <AppText
            variant="title"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange }}
          >
            {job.currency} {Number(job.budget).toLocaleString()}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("JobApplications", { jobId: job.id })
            }
            style={[
              styles.appCountChip,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="people-outline"
              size={13}
              color={c.textMuted}
              style={{ marginRight: 4 }}
            />
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              {appCount}{" "}
              {appCount === 1 ? t("jobs.applicant") : t("jobs.applicants")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {/* Skills preview */}
        {job.skills?.length > 0 && (
          <View style={styles.skillsPreview}>
            {job.skills.slice(0, 4).map((sk) => (
              <View
                key={sk}
                style={[
                  styles.skillPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
                  {sk}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ))}
            {job.skills.length > 4 && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.skillPill,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  +{job.skills.length - 4}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Applicant avatar previews */}
        {previews.length > 0 && (
          <View style={styles.previews}>
            {previews.map((app) => (
              <View
                key={app.id}
                style={[
                  styles.previewAvatar,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.bgPanel },
                ]}
              >
                {app.worker?.avatar ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: app.worker.avatar }}
                    style={styles.previewImg}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 10 }}
                  >
                    {app.worker?.firstName?.[0]}
                    {app.worker?.lastName?.[0]}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
            ))}
            {appCount > 3 && (
              <View
                style={[styles.previewMore, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 10 }}
                >
                  +{appCount - 3}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Action buttons */}
        <View style={styles.actions}>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate("JobDetail", { jobId: job.id })}
            style={[styles.viewBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              {t("jobs.viewDetails")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("JobApplications", { jobId: job.id })
            }
            style={[
              styles.appsBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {t("jobs.applications")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>

        {/* Status change actions */}
        {isOpen && (
          <View style={[styles.statusActions, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => confirmStatus("FILLED")}
              disabled={acting}
              style={[
                styles.fillBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(99,102,241,0.12)",
                  borderColor: "#6366f1",
                },
              ]}
            >
              {acting ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#6366f1" />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#6366f1" }}
                >
                  {t("jobs.markFilled")}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => confirmStatus("CANCELLED")}
              disabled={acting}
              style={[
                styles.cancelStatusBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.10)",
                  borderColor: "#ef4444",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
              >
                {t("jobs.cancelJob")}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}

        {!isOpen && job.status === "CANCELLED" && (
          <View style={[styles.statusActions, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => confirmStatus("OPEN")}
              disabled={acting}
              style={[
                styles.reopenBtn,
                {
                  backgroundColor: "rgba(34,197,94,0.10)",
                  borderColor: "#22c55e",
                },
              ]}
            >
              {acting ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#22c55e" />
              ) : (
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#22c55e" }}
                >
                  {t("jobs.reopenJob")}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title ?? ""}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel ?? t("common.yes")}
        cancelLabel={t("common.no")}
        destructive={modal?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </Card>
  );
}

// ─── Main Screen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const STATUS_TABS = ["ALL", "OPEN", "FILLED", "CANCELLED"];

export default function JobsManagementScreen() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [jobs, setJobs] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("ALL");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(null);

  const load = useCallback(
    async (pg = page, flt = filter) => {
      try {
        const params = { page: pg, limit: 9 };
        if (flt !== "ALL") params.status = flt;
        const data = await getMyJobPosts(params);
        setJobs(data.jobPosts ?? []);
        setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
        setPages(data.pages ?? 1);
      } catch {
        toast.error(t("toast.networkError"));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [page, filter, t, toast],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, [filter, page]);

  const handleFilterChange = (f) => {
    setFilter(f);
    setPage(1);
  };

  const handleStatusChange = async (jobId, status) => {
    setActing(jobId);
    try {
      await updateJobStatus(jobId, status);
      setJobs((prev) =>
        prev.map((j) => (j.id === jobId ? { ...j, status } : j)),
      );
      toast.success(t("jobs.jobUpdated", { status: status.toLowerCase() }));
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setActing(null);
    }
  };

  // Summary counts
  const openCount = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "OPEN").length;
  const filledCount = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "FILLED").length;
  const cancelledCount = jobs.filter((j) => j.status === "CANCELLED").length;

  return (
    <AppScreen
      refreshControl={
        <RefreshControl
          refreshing={refreshing}
          onRefresh={() => {
            setRefreshing(true);
            load(1, filter);
          }}
          tintColor={c.orange}
        />
      }
      contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: 40 }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <View>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange, letterSpacing: 0.8 }}
          >
            {t("jobs.myJobs").toUpperCase()}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="display"
            weight="displayBlack"
            style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
          >
            {t("jobs.jobBoard")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppButton
          title={t("jobs.postNewJob")}
          fullWidth={false}
          onPress={() => navigation.navigate("PostJob")}
          style={{ paddingHorizontal: 14 }}
        />
      </View>

      {/* Summary pills */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={{ marginTop: 16 }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8, paddingRight: 8 }}
      >
        {[
          { label: t("jobs.open"), value: openCount, color: "#22c55e" },
          { label: t("jobs.filled"), value: filledCount, color: "#6366f1" },
          {
            label: t("jobs.cancelled"),
            value: cancelledCount,
            color: "#ef4444",
          },
          { label: t("jobs.total"), value: total, color: c.textMuted },
        ].map((p) => (
          <View
            key={p.label}
            style={[
              styles.summaryPill,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: p.color }}
            >
              {p.value}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
              {p.label}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ))}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Filter tabs */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={{ marginTop: 14 }}
        contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 8, paddingRight: 8 }}
      >
        {STATUS_TABS.map((s) => {
          const active = filter === s;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={s}
              onPress={() => handleFilterChange(s)}
              style={[
                styles.filterTab,
                {
                  backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgCard,
                  borderColor: active ? c.orange : c.border,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
              >
                {s === "ALL" ? t("jobs.allJobs") : t(`jobs.${s.toLowerCase()}`)}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Job list */}
      {loading ? (
        <View style={styles.loadingWrap}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      ) : jobs.length === 0 ? (
        <Card padded style={styles.emptyCard}>
          <Ionicons
            name="document-text-outline"
            size={36}
            color={c.textMuted}
          />
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            {filter === "ALL"
              ? t("jobs.noJobs")
              : t("jobs.noJobsFiltered", { status: filter.toLowerCase() })}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginTop: 6, textAlign: "center" }}
          >
            {filter === "ALL" ? t("jobs.postFirstJob") : ""}
          </AppText>
          {filter === "ALL" && (
            <AppButton
              title={t("jobs.postNewJob")}
              iconLeft="add"
              onPress={() => navigation.navigate("PostJob")}
              style={{ marginTop: 16 }}
            />
          )}
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <View style={{ marginTop: 16, gap: 12 }}>
          {jobs.map((job) => (
            <JobCard
              key={job.id}
              job={job}
              acting={acting === job.id}
              onStatusChange={handleStatusChange}
              c={c}
              t={t}
            />
          ))}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Pagination */}
      {pages > 1 && (
        <View style={[styles.pagination, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
          <Pressable
            disabled={page === 1}
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => p - 1)}
            style={[
              styles.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === 1 ? 0.4 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={16} color={c.text} />
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
            >
              Prev
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
            {page} / {pages}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            disabled={page === pages}
            onPress={() => setPage((p) => p + 1)}
            style={[
              styles.pageBtn,
              {
                backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
                borderColor: c.border,
                opacity: page === pages ? 0.4 : 1,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
            >
              Next
            </AppText>
            <Ionicons name="arrow-forward" size={16} color={c.text} />
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/MyPostsScreen.js
// Mirrors website "My Posts" page — inline create form + own post list.
// Endpoints: GET /posts/my, POST /posts, DELETE /posts/:id

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import * as ImagePicker from "expo-image-picker";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import ConfirmModal from "../../components/ConfirmModal";
import PostCard, { POST_TYPES } from "../../components/PostCard";
import { getMyPosts, createPost, deletePost } from "../../api/posts";

const POST_TYPE_LIST = [
  { type: "GENERAL", emoji: "💬" },
  { type: "ACHIEVEMENT", emoji: "🏆" },
  { type: "PORTFOLIO", emoji: "🎨" },
  { type: "HIRING", emoji: "📢" },
  { type: "JOB_UPDATE", emoji: "💼" },
  { type: "ANNOUNCEMENT", emoji: "📣" },
];

const LIMIT = 15;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Inline Create Post Form (mirrors the website's post composer)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function CreatePostForm({ user, c, onPosted }) {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [content, setContent] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState("GENERAL");
  const [isPublic, setIsPublic] = useState(true);
  const [images, setImages] = useState([]); // [{ uri, name, type }]
  const [posting, setPosting] = useState(false);

  const pickImages = async () => {
    const perm = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (!perm.granted) {
      toast.error("Camera roll permission required.");
      return;
    }
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      allowsMultipleSelection: true,
      quality: 0.8,
    });
    if (!result.canceled) {
      setImages(
        result.assets.map((a) => ({
          uri: a.uri,
          name: a.fileName ?? `photo_${Date.now()}.jpg`,
          type: a.type ?? "image/jpeg",
        })),
      );
    }
  };

  const handlePost = async () => {
    if (!content.trim()) {
      toast.error("Write something before posting.");
      return;
    }
    setPosting(true);
    try {
      const post = await createPost({ content, type, isPublic, images });
      setContent("");
      setImages([]);
      setType("GENERAL");
      onPosted?.(post);
      toast.success("Post published!");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message ?? "Failed to post.");
    } finally {
      setPosting(false);
    }
  };

  const name = user?.firstName
    ? `${user.firstName} ${user.lastName ?? ""}`.trim()
    : (user?.hirerProfile?.companyName ?? "You");

  return (
    <View
      style={[f.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* Author row + public toggle */}
      <View style={f.authorRow}>
        <View
          style={[
            f.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {user?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: user.avatar }} style={f.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {(user?.firstName?.[0] ?? "") + (user?.lastName?.[0] ?? "")}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
            {name}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => setIsPublic((v) => !v)}
            style={[f.publicBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>{isPublic ? "🌍" : "🔒"}</AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
            >
              {isPublic ? "Public" : "Private"}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginLeft: 4 }}>
              ⌃
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Content input */}
      <TextInput
        value={content}
        onChangeText={setContent}
        placeholder="What's on your mind? Share a job update, achievement, or anything work-related..."
        placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
        multiline
        style={[f.textInput, { color: c.text }]}
        maxLength={2000}
      />

      {/* Picked images preview */}
      {images.length > 0 && (
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          style={{ paddingHorizontal: 16, marginBottom: 10 }}
        >
          {images.map((img, i) => (
            <View key={i} style={f.previewWrap}>
              <Image source={{ uri: img.uri }} style={f.previewImg} />
              <Pressable
                onPress={() =>
                  setImages((prev) => prev.filter((_, j) => j !== i))
                }
                style={f.removeImg}
              >
                <AppText
                  style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 10, fontWeight: "700" }}
                >
                  ✕
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>
          ))}
        </ScrollView>
      )}

      {/* Type pills */}
      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={f.typeScroll}
        contentContainerStyle={f.typeContent}
      >
        {POST_TYPE_LIST.map(({ type: t, emoji }) => {
          const active = type === t;
          const meta = POST_TYPES[t];
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={t}
              onPress={() => setType(t)}
              style={[
                f.typePill,
                {
                  borderColor: active ? meta.color : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: active ? meta.bg : c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 15 }}>{emoji}</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: active ? meta.color : c.textMuted,
                  marginLeft: 5,
                }}
              >
                {meta.label}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Bottom row */}
      <View style={[f.bottomRow, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={pickImages}
          style={[f.photoBtn, { borderColor: c.border }]}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>📷</AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
            Photo
          </AppText>
        </Pressable>
        <Pressable
          onPress={handlePost}
          disabled={posting || !content.trim()}
          style={[
            f.postBtn,
            {
              backgroundColor: content.trim() ? c.orange : c.bgInput,
              opacity: content.trim() ? 1 : 0.5,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {posting ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
          ) : (
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
              Post
            </AppText>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function MyPostsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();
  const { user } = useAuthStore();

  const [posts, setPosts] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState(null);

  const fetchPosts = useCallback(async (pg = 1, replace = true) => {
    if (replace) setLoading(true);
    try {
      const data = await getMyPosts({ page: pg, limit: LIMIT });
      setPosts(replace ? data.posts : (prev) => [...prev, ...data.posts]);
      setTotalPages(data.pages ?? 1);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to load posts.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPosts(1, true);
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setPage(1);
    fetchPosts(1, true);
  };

  const handlePosted = (newPost) => {
    setPosts((prev) => [newPost, ...prev]);
  };

  const handleDelete = (postId) => {
    setModal({
      title: "Delete Post",
      message: "Delete this post permanently?",
      confirmLabel: "Delete",
      destructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await deletePost(postId);
          setPosts((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== postId));
          toast.success("Post deleted.");
        } catch {
          toast.error("Failed to delete post.");
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages) {
      const next = page + 1;
      setPage(next);
      fetchPosts(next, false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={posts}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Page header */}
            <View style={styles.pageHeader}>
              <AppText style={[styles.heroTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                My Posts
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ marginTop: 4, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                Share updates, achievements, and opportunities with the
                SkilledProz community.
              </AppText>
            </View>
            {/* Create form */}
            <CreatePostForm user={user} c={c} onPosted={handlePosted} />
            <View style={{ height: 16 }} />
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <PostCard
            post={item}
            userId={user?.id}
            c={c}
            showDelete
            onDelete={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 40, textAlign: "center" }}>
                📝
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                No posts yet
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                tone="dim"
                style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                Share your first update with the community above.
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />

      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!modal}
        title={modal?.title}
        message={modal?.message}
        confirmLabel={modal?.confirmLabel}
        destructive={modal?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          modal?.onConfirm?.();
          setModal(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            styles.skCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  screen: { flex: 1 },
  listContent: { padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 },
  pageHeader: { marginBottom: 16 },
  heroTitle: { fontSize: 32, fontWeight: "900", letterSpacing: -0.5 },
  empty: { alignItems: "center", paddingTop: 40, paddingHorizontal: 32 },
  skCard: {
    height: 140,
    borderRadius: 16,
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    opacity: 0.5,
  },
});

// Create form styles
const f = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderRadius: 16,
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    overflow: "hidden",
  },

//           PATCH /notifications/read-all  |  DELETE /notifications/clear-all
// Mirrors website: All/Unread tabs, mark-all-read, clear-all, detail modal.
// Full dark/light mode — text always clearly readable on both backgrounds.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";

  ActivityIndicator,

// ── Time ago ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function timeAgo(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  const diff = (Date.now() - new Date(d)) / 1000;
  if (diff < 60) return `${Math.floor(diff)}s ago`;
  if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}m ago`;
  if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)}d ago`;
}

// ── Notification type → emoji ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function typeEmoji(type) {
  const map = {
    BOOKING_ACCEPTED: "✅",
    BOOKING_CANCELLED: "❌",
    BOOKING_COMPLETED: "🎉",
    BOOKING_IN_PROGRESS: "🔨",
    PAYMENT_RECEIVED: "💳",
    PAYMENT_HELD: "🔒",
    DISPUTE_RAISED: "⚠️",
    DISPUTE_RESOLVED: "⚖️",
    POST_COMMENT: "💬",
    POST_REACTION: "👍",
    POST_REPOST: "🔄",
    NEW_LOGIN: "🔐",
    INSURANCE_PURCHASED: "🛡️",
    WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST: "💸",
    BANK_TRANSFER_PROOF: "🏦",
    CRYPTO_TX_SUBMITTED: "₿",
  };
  return map[type] ?? "🔔";
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Notification Detail Modal
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function DetailModal({ notification, onClose, c, t }) {
  if (!notification) return null;

  const data = notification.data ?? {};
  const hasIp = !!data.ip || !!data.ipAddress;
  const hasDevice = !!data.device || !!data.userAgent;
  const extraKeys = Object.keys(data).filter(
    (k) => !["ip", "ipAddress", "device", "userAgent"].includes(k),
  );

  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable style={d.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <Pressable
          style={[
            d.modal,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
          onPress={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <View style={d.header}>
            <View style={d.headerLeft}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>
                {typeEmoji(notification.type)}
              </AppText>
              <View style={{ marginLeft: 12, flex: 1 }}>
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text }}
                >
                  {notification.title}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                >
                  {timeAgo(notification.createdAt)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>
            <Pressable
              onPress={onClose}
              style={[
                d.closeBtn,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ color: c.text, fontSize: 16 }}>✕</AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>

          <View style={[d.divider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />

          {/* Body */}
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ color: c.text, lineHeight: 24, marginBottom: 16 }}
          >
            {notification.body}
          </AppText>

          {/* Details table — for login/security notifications */}
          {(hasIp || hasDevice || extraKeys.length > 0) && (
            <View
              style={[
                d.detailsBox,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{
                  color: c.textMuted,
                  letterSpacing: 1,
                  marginBottom: 10,
                }}
              >
                {t("notifications.details")}
              </AppText>
              {hasIp && (
                <View style={[d.detailRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, width: 72 }}
                  >
                    {t("notifications.ip")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, textAlign: "right" }}
                  >
                    {data.ip ?? data.ipAddress}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
              {hasDevice && (
                <View style={[d.detailRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, width: 72 }}
                  >
                    {t("notifications.device")}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, textAlign: "right" }}
                    numberOfLines={3}
                  >
                    {data.device ?? data.userAgent}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              )}
              {extraKeys.slice(0, 4).map((key) => (
                <View
                  key={key}
                  style={[d.detailRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    style={{ color: c.textMuted, width: 80 }}
                  >
                    {key}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight="semibold"
                    style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1, textAlign: "right" }}
                    numberOfLines={2}
                  >
                    {String(data[key])}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          )}
        </Pressable>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

function NotifRow({ notif, onPress, onDelete, c }) {
  const unread = !notif.isRead;

  return (
    <Pressable
      onPress={() => onPress(notif)}
      style={[
        n.row,
        {
          backgroundColor: c.bgCard,
          borderColor: unread ? c.orange : c.border,
          borderLeftColor: unread ? c.orange : c.border,
          borderLeftWidth: unread ? 3 : StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Unread dot */}
      {unread && <View style={[n.dot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]} />}

      {/* Icon */}
      <AppText style={n.emoji}>{typeEmoji(notif.type)}</AppText>

      {/* Content */}
      <View style={n.content}>
        <View style={n.titleRow}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.text, flex: 1 }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {notif.title}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 8 }}
          >
            {timeAgo(notif.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <AppText
          variant="small"
          style={{ color: c.textMuted, lineHeight: 18, marginTop: 2 }}
          numberOfLines={2}
        >
          {notif.body}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* Delete */}
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => onDelete(notif.id)}
        style={n.deleteBtn}
        hitSlop={10}
      >
        <AppText style={{ color: "#ef4444", fontSize: 14 }}>✕</AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 8 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            n.skRow,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function NotificationsScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  const [all, setAll] = useState([]);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("all"); // "all" | "unread"
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(null); // detail modal
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(null); // confirm modal

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getNotifications({ page: 1, limit: 50 });
      setAll(data.notifications ?? []);
      setUnreadCount(data.unreadCount ?? 0);
      setTotal(data.total ?? 0);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    load();
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load();
  };

  const handlePress = async (notif) => {
    setSelected(notif);
    if (!notif.isRead) {
      try {
        await markAsRead(notif.id);
        setAll((prev) =>
          prev.map((n) => (n.id === notif.id ? { ...n, isRead: true } : n)),
        );
        setUnreadCount((u) => Math.max(0, u - 1));
      } catch {}
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (id) => {
    setConfirm({
      title: t("notifications.deleteTitle"),
      message: t("notifications.deleteMessage"),
      confirmLabel: t("common.delete"),
      destructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await deleteNotification(id);
          setAll((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
          setTotal((t) => t - 1);
        } catch {
          toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleMarkAll = async () => {
    try {
      await markAllAsRead();
      setAll((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, isRead: true })));
      setUnreadCount(0);
      toast.success(t("notifications.markedAll"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    }
  };

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    setConfirm({
      title: t("notifications.clearTitle"),
      message: t("notifications.clearMessage"),
      confirmLabel: t("notifications.clearAll"),
      destructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await clearAllNotifications();
          setAll([]);
          setTotal(0);
          setUnreadCount(0);
          toast.success(t("notifications.cleared"));
        } catch {
          toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const visible = tab === "unread" ? all.filter((n) => !n.isRead) : all;

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={visible}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Page header */}
            <View style={styles.pageHeader}>
              <AppText style={[styles.pageTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                {t("notifications.title")}
              </AppText>
              {unreadCount > 0 && (
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}
                >
                  {t("notifications.unreadCount", { count: unreadCount })}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>

            {/* Action buttons */}
            <View style={styles.actionRow}>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleMarkAll}
                style={[
                  styles.actionBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>✓</AppText>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text, marginLeft: 6 }}
                >
                  {t("notifications.markAllRead")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
              <Pressable
                onPress={handleClearAll}
                style={[
                  styles.actionBtn,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 16 }}>🗑️</AppText>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#ef4444", marginLeft: 6 }}
                >
                  {t("notifications.clearAll")}
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Tabs: All | Unread */}
            <View style={[styles.tabRow, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
              {[
                { key: "all", label: t("notifications.all"), count: total },
                {
                  key: "unread",
                  label: t("notifications.unread"),
                  count: unreadCount,
                },
              ].map(({ key, label, count }) => {
                const active = tab === key;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={key}
                    onPress={() => setTab(key)}
                    style={[
                      styles.tabItem,
                      { borderBottomColor: active ? c.orange : "transparent" },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight={active ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                      style={{ color: active ? c.orange : c.textMuted }}
                    >
                      {label}
                    </AppText>
                    {count > 0 && (
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.badge,
                          { backgroundColor: active ? c.orange : c.bgInput },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <AppText
                          style={{
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: "700",
                            color: active ? "#fff" : c.textMuted,
                          }}
                        >
                          {count > 99 ? "99+" : count}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <NotifRow
            notif={item}
            onPress={handlePress}
            onDelete={handleDelete}
            c={c}
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 8 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>🔔</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                {t("notifications.empty")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                {t("notifications.emptySub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={<View style={{ height: 40 }} />}
      />

      {/* Detail modal */}
      <DetailModal
        notification={selected}
        onClose={() => setSelected(null)}
        c={c}
        t={t}
      />

      {/* Confirm modal */}
      <ConfirmModal
        visible={!!confirm}
        title={confirm?.title}
        message={confirm?.message}
        confirmLabel={confirm?.confirmLabel}
        destructive={confirm?.destructive}
        onConfirm={() => {
          confirm?.onConfirm?.();
          setConfirm(null);
        }}
        onCancel={() => setConfirm(null)}
      />
    </View>
  );
}
