  "#E91E8C",
  "#06D6A0",
];
const catColor = (name = "") =>
  CAT_PALETTE[(name.charCodeAt(0) || 0) % CAT_PALETTE.length];

// ─── Main Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function PostJobScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { currency } = useCurrency();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [step, setStep] = useState(1);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  // Step 1
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState(null);
  const [categoryName, setCategoryName] = useState("");
  const [catSearch, setCatSearch] = useState("");
  const [showCustom, setShowCustom] = useState(false);
  const [customCatName, setCustomCatName] = useState("");
  const [addingCustom, setAddingCustom] = useState(false);
  const [jobType, setJobType] = useState("FULL_TIME");
  const [locationType, setLocationType] = useState("REMOTE");
  const [locationAddress, setLocationAddress] = useState("");

  // Step 2
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [skillInput, setSkillInput] = useState("");
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState([]);
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState("");
  const [startDateObj, setStartDateObj] = useState(new Date());
  const [showDatePicker, setShowDatePicker] = useState(false);

  // Step 3
  const [paymentType, setPaymentType] = useState("FIXED");
  const [durationType, setDurationType] = useState("DAYS");
  const [durationValue, setDurationValue] = useState("");
  const [budgetAmount, setBudgetAmount] = useState("");
  const [additionalNotes, setAdditionalNotes] = useState("");

  // Categories
  const [categories, setCategories] = useState([]);
  const [catLoading, setCatLoading] = useState(true);

  // Progress animation
  const progressAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1 / TOTAL_STEPS)).current;
  useEffect(() => {
    Animated.spring(progressAnim, {
      toValue: step / TOTAL_STEPS,
      useNativeDriver: false,
      damping: 20,
    }).start();
  }, [step, progressAnim]);

  useEffect(() => {
    categoriesApi
      .getAll()
      .then(setCategories)
      .catch(() => toast.error(t("toast.networkError")))
      .finally(() => setCatLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const filteredCategories = useMemo(() => {
    if (!Array.isArray(categories)) return [];
    const q = catSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return categories;
    return categories.filter((cat) =>
      (cat?.name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q),
    );
  }, [categories, catSearch]);

  const selectCategory = (cat) => {
    const safeName = cat?.name ?? "";
    setCategoryId(cat?.id ?? null);
    setCategoryName(safeName);
    setTitle(safeName);
    setShowCustom(false);
    setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, category: null, title: null }));
  };

  const clearCategory = () => {
    setCategoryId(null);
    setCategoryName("");
    setTitle("");
  };

  const handleAddCustom = async () => {
    const name = customCatName.trim();
    if (!name) return;
    setAddingCustom(true);
    try {
      const newCat = await categoriesApi.suggest(name);
      setCategories((prev) => {
        const exists = prev.some(
          (c) => c.id === newCat.id || c.name === newCat.name,
        );
        return exists ? prev : [...prev, newCat];
      });
      selectCategory(newCat);
      toast.success(t("postJob.addedCategory", { name }));
    } finally {
      setCustomCatName("");
      setShowCustom(false);
      setAddingCustom(false);
    }
  };

  const addSkill = () => {
    const s = skillInput.trim();
    if (!s) return;
    if (skills.includes(s)) {
      setSkillInput("");
      return;
    }
    if (skills.length >= 10) {
      toast.info(t("postJob.maxSkills"));
      return;
    }
    setSkills((prev) => [...prev, s]);
    setSkillInput("");
  };
  const removeSkill = (s) => setSkills((prev) => prev.filter((x) => x !== s));

  const onDateChange = (event, selectedDate) => {
    if (Platform.OS === "android") setShowDatePicker(false);
    if (event.type === "dismissed") return;
    if (selectedDate) {
      setStartDateObj(selectedDate);
      const iso = selectedDate.toISOString().split("T")[0];
      setStartDate(iso);
      setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, startDate: null }));
    }
  };

  const formattedDate = startDate
    ? new Date(startDate + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
        weekday: "short",
        year: "numeric",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
      })
    : null;

  const validate = () => {
    const e = {};
    if (step === 1) {
      if (!title.trim()) e.title = t("postJob.titleRequired");
      if (!categoryId && !title.trim())
        e.category = t("postJob.categoryRequired");
      if (locationType !== "REMOTE" && !locationAddress.trim())
        e.locationAddress = t("postJob.locationRequired");
    }
    if (step === 2) {
      if (!description.trim() || description.trim().length < 50)
        e.description = t("postJob.descriptionTooShort");
      if (!startDate.trim()) e.startDate = t("postJob.startDateRequired");
    }
    if (step === 3) {
      const n = parseFloat(budgetAmount);
      if (!budgetAmount || isNaN(n) || n <= 0)
        e.budgetAmount = t("postJob.budgetRequired");
      if (
        durationType !== "CUSTOM" &&
        (!durationValue || isNaN(parseInt(durationValue, 10)))
      )
        e.durationValue = t("postJob.durationRequired", {
          unit: t(`postJob.durationType.${durationType}`).toLowerCase(),
        });
      if (durationType === "CUSTOM" && !durationValue.trim())
        e.durationValue = t("postJob.durationCustomRequired");
    }
    return e;
  };

  const handleNext = () => {
    const e = validate();
    if (Object.keys(e).length) {
      setErrors(e);
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    if (step < TOTAL_STEPS) {
      setStep((s) => s + 1);
      return;
    }
    handleSubmit();
  };

  const handleBack = () => {
    if (step > 1) setStep((s) => s - 1);
    else navigation.goBack();
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      let resolvedCategoryId = categoryId;
      if (!resolvedCategoryId && title.trim()) {
        try {
          const newCat = await categoriesApi.suggest(title.trim());
          resolvedCategoryId = newCat.id;
          setCategories((prev) => [...prev, newCat]);
          setCategoryId(newCat.id);
          setCategoryName(newCat.name);
        } catch {}
      }
      await hirerApi.createJobPost({
        title: title.trim(),
        categoryId: resolvedCategoryId,
        jobType,
        locationType,
        address: locationType !== "REMOTE" ? locationAddress.trim() : null,
        description: description.trim(),
        skills,
        scheduledAt: startDate.trim(),
        startDate: startDate.trim(),
        budgetType: paymentType,
        budget: parseFloat(budgetAmount),
        currency: currency?.code || "USD",
        durationType,
        durationValue: durationValue.trim(),
        ...(additionalNotes.trim() && { notes: additionalNotes.trim() }),
      });
      toast.success(t("postJob.successMessage"));
      navigation.navigate("MyPosts");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || t("toast.networkError"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const selectedCategoryObj = Array.isArray(categories)
    ? categories.find((cat) => cat.id === categoryId)
    : undefined;

  const selectedPayment = PAYMENT_TYPE_KEYS.find(
    (p) => p.value === paymentType,
  );

  // ── Budget label helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const budgetLabel = () => {
    switch (paymentType) {
      case "HOURLY":
        return t("postJob.hourlyRate");
      case "DAILY":
        return t("postJob.dailyRate");
      case "WEEKLY":
        return t("postJob.weeklyRate");
      case "MONTHLY":
        return t("postJob.monthlyRate");
      case "CUSTOM":
        return t("postJob.agreedAmount");
      default:
        return t("postJob.fixedPrice");
    }
  };

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <AppScreen>
      {/* ── Top bar ── */}
      <View style={styles.topBar}>
        <Pressable onPress={handleBack} style={styles.backBtn} hitSlop={8}>
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={c.text} />
        </Pressable>
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          weight="semibold"
          style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}
        >
          {t("postJob.screenTitle")}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {step}/{TOTAL_STEPS}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ── Progress bar ── */}
      <View style={[styles.progressTrack, { backgroundColor: c.border }]}>
        <Animated.View
          style={[
            styles.progressFill,
            {
              backgroundColor: c.orange,
              width: progressAnim.interpolate({
                inputRange: [0, 1],
                outputRange: ["0%", "100%"],
              }),
            },
          ]}
        />
      </View>

      {/* ── Step header ── */}
      <View style={styles.stepHeader}>
        <AppText variant="displaySm" weight="displayBlack">
          {t(`postJob.step${step}Title`)}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
          {t(`postJob.step${step}Sub`)}
        </AppText>
      </View>

      {/* ════════ STEP 1 ════════ */}
      {step === 1 && (
        <View style={styles.form}>
          {/* Category */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.category")}
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.searchRow,
                { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.inputBg },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name="search"
                size={16}
                color={c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
              />
              <TextInput
                value={catSearch}
                onChangeText={setCatSearch}
                placeholder={t("postJob.searchCategories")}
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                style={[styles.searchInput, { color: c.text }]}
                autoCapitalize="words"
              />
              {catSearch.length > 0 && (
                <Pressable onPress={() => setCatSearch("")} hitSlop={8}>
                  <Ionicons name="close-circle" size={16} color={c.textMuted} />
                </Pressable>
              )}
            </View>
            {errors.category && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {errors.category}
              </AppText>
            )}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.catListWrap,
                { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
              ]}
            >
              {catLoading ? (
                <View style={styles.catLoading}>
                  <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
                </View>
              ) : (
                <ScrollView
                  nestedScrollEnabled
                  showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
                  keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
                  style={{ maxHeight: 280 }}
                >
                  {filteredCategories.length === 0 && catSearch.trim() ? (
                    <View style={styles.catEmpty}>
                      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                        {t("postJob.noMatch", { query: catSearch })}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ) : (
                    filteredCategories.map((cat, idx) => {
                      const selected = categoryId === cat.id;
                      const bg = catColor(cat.name);
                      const initial = (cat.name || "?").charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                      const rowKey =
                        cat.id ?? cat.slug ?? cat.name ?? String(idx);
                      return (
                        <Pressable
                          key={rowKey}
                          onPress={() => selectCategory(cat)}
                          style={({ pressed }) => [
                            styles.catRow,
                            {
                              borderBottomColor: c.border,
                              borderBottomWidth:
                                idx < filteredCategories.length - 1
                                  ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth
                                  : 0,
                              backgroundColor: pressed
                                ? c.orangeDim
                                : selected
                                  ? c.orangeDim
                                  : "transparent",
                            },
                          ]}
                        >
                          <View
                            style={[styles.catCircle, { backgroundColor: bg }]}
                          >
                            <AppText
                              variant="small"
                              weight="semibold"
                              style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 13 }}
                            >
                              {initial}
                            </AppText>
                          </View>
                          <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
                            <AppText
                              variant="body"
                              weight={selected ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                              style={{ color: selected ? c.orange : c.text }}
                            >
                              {cat.name}
                            </AppText>
                          </View>
                          {selected && (
                            <View style={styles.catSelectedActions}>
                              <Ionicons
                                name="checkmark-circle"
                                size={20}
                                color={c.orange}
                              />
                              <Pressable
                                onPress={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  clearCategory();
                                }}
                                hitSlop={10}
                                style={[
                                  styles.catRemoveBtn,
                                  { backgroundColor: c.orange },
                                ]}
                              >
                                <Ionicons name="close" size={12} color="#fff" />
                              </Pressable>
                            </View>
                          )}
                        </Pressable>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                  {!showCustom && (
                    <Pressable
                      onPress={() => setShowCustom(true)}
                      style={[
                        styles.catRow,
                        {
                          borderTopColor: c.border,
                          borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.catCircle,
                          { backgroundColor: c.orange },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <Ionicons name="add" size={16} color="#fff" />
                      </View>
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ marginLeft: 12, color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {t("postJob.customOther")}
                      </AppText>
                    </Pressable>
                  )}
                </ScrollView>
              )}
            </View>
            {showCustom && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.customBox,
                  { borderColor: c.orange, backgroundColor: c.orangeDim },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ marginBottom: 8, color: c.orange }}
                >
                  {t("postJob.suggestCategory")}
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.skillInputRow,
                    { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
                  ]}
                >
                  <TextInput
                    value={customCatName}
                    onChangeText={setCustomCatName}
                    placeholder={t("postJob.categoryInputPlaceholder")}
                    placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                    style={[styles.skillTextInput, { color: c.text }]}
                    returnKeyType="done"
                    onSubmitEditing={handleAddCustom}
                    autoFocus
                  />
                  {addingCustom ? (
                    <ActivityIndicator
                      color={c.orange}
                      style={{ marginRight: 14 }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <Pressable
                      onPress={handleAddCustom}
                      style={[styles.addBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                    >
                      <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={18} color="#fff" />
                    </Pressable>
                  )}
                </View>
                <Pressable
                  onPress={() => {
                    setShowCustom(false);
                    setCustomCatName("");
                  }}
                  hitSlop={8}
                  style={{ marginTop: 10, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
                >
                  <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                    {t("common.cancel")}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Job Title */}
          <View>
            <AppInput
              label={t("postJob.jobTitle")}
              placeholder={t("postJob.jobTitlePlaceholder")}
              iconLeft="create-outline"
              value={title}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setTitle(v);
                if (categoryId && v !== categoryName) {
                  setCategoryId(null);
                  setCategoryName("");
                }
                setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, title: null, category: null }));
              }}
              error={errors.title}
              returnKeyType="next"
            />
            {!categoryId && title.trim().length > 0 && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {t("postJob.yourTitleNote")}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Job Type */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.jobType")}
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.twoColWrap}>
              {JOB_TYPE_KEYS.map((jt) => {
                const sel = jobType === jt.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={jt.value}
                    onPress={() => setJobType(jt.value)}
                    style={[
                      styles.twoColCell,
                      {
                        borderColor: sel ? c.orange : c.border,
                        backgroundColor: sel ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {sel && (
                      <View
                        style={[styles.selDot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                      />
                    )}
                    <Ionicons
                      name={jt.icon}
                      size={20}
                      color={sel ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                    />
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{
                        marginTop: 8,
                        color: sel ? c.orange : c.text,
                        textAlign: "center",
                      }}
                    >
                      {t(jt.labelKey)}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Location Type */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.locationType")}
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.threeColWrap}>
              {LOCATION_TYPE_KEYS.map((lt) => {
                const sel = locationType === lt.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={lt.value}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setLocationType(lt.value);
                      setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, locationAddress: null }));
                    }}
                    style={[
                      styles.threeColCell,
                      {
                        borderColor: sel ? c.orange : c.border,
                        backgroundColor: sel ? c.orangeDim : c.bgCard,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {sel && (
                      <View
                        style={[styles.selDot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                      />
                    )}
                    <Ionicons
                      name={lt.icon}
                      size={18}
                      color={sel ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
                    />
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{
                        marginTop: 6,
                        color: sel ? c.orange : c.text,
                        textAlign: "center",
                      }}
                    >
                      {t(lt.labelKey)}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          </View>

          {locationType !== "REMOTE" && (
            <AppInput
              label={t("postJob.locationAddress")}
              placeholder={t("postJob.locationAddressPlaceholder")}
              iconLeft="location-outline"
              value={locationAddress}
              onChangeText={(v) => {
                setLocationAddress(v);
                setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, locationAddress: null }));
              }}
              error={errors.locationAddress}
            />
          )}
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ════════ STEP 2 ════════ */}
      {step === 2 && (
        <View style={styles.form}>
          {/* Description */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.description")}
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.textArea,
                {
                  borderColor: errors.description ? c.red : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <TextInput
                multiline
                numberOfLines={7}
                textAlignVertical="top"
                placeholder={t("postJob.descriptionPlaceholder")}
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                value={description}
                onChangeText={(v) => {
                  setDescription(v);
                  setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, description: null }));
                }}
                style={[styles.textAreaInput, { color: c.text }]}
              />
            </View>
            <View style={styles.charRow}>
              {errors.description ? (
                <AppText variant="small" tone="danger">
                  {errors.description}
                </AppText>
              ) : (
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  {t("postJob.minChars", { count: 50 })}
                </AppText>
              )}
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                {description.length}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Skills */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.skills")}{" "}
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                ({t("postJob.optional")})
              </AppText>
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.skillInputRow,
                { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgInput },
              ]}
            >
              <TextInput
                value={skillInput}
                onChangeText={setSkillInput}
                onSubmitEditing={addSkill}
                placeholder={t("postJob.skillPlaceholder")}
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                style={[styles.skillTextInput, { color: c.text }]}
                returnKeyType="done"
                blurOnSubmit={false}
              />
              <Pressable
                onPress={addSkill}
                style={[styles.addBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
              >
                <Ionicons name="add" size={18} color="#fff" />
              </Pressable>
            </View>
            {skills.length > 0 && (
              <View style={styles.skillTags}>
                {skills.map((sk) => (
                  <View
                    key={sk}
                    style={[
                      styles.skillTag,
                      { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: c.orange }}
                    >
                      {sk}
                    </AppText>
                    <Pressable
                      onPress={() => removeSkill(sk)}
                      hitSlop={6}
                      style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
                    >
                      <Ionicons
                        name="close-circle"
                        size={16}
                        color={c.orange}
                      />
                    </Pressable>
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>
            )}
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              {t("postJob.skillsHint", { current: skills.length, max: 10 })}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Start Date */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.startDate")}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(true)}
              style={[
                styles.dateBtn,
                {
                  borderColor: errors.startDate ? c.red : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons name="calendar-outline" size={18} color={c.orange} />
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  marginLeft: 10,
                  color: formattedDate ? c.text : c.textMuted,
                }}
              >
                {formattedDate || t("postJob.tapToChooseDate")}
              </AppText>
              <Ionicons name="chevron-down" size={16} color={c.textMuted} />
            </Pressable>
            {errors.startDate && (
              <AppText variant="small" tone="danger" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {errors.startDate}
              </AppText>
            )}
            {showDatePicker && Platform.OS === "android" && (
              <DateTimePicker
                value={startDateObj}
                mode="date"
                display="default"
                minimumDate={new Date()}
                onChange={onDateChange}
              />
            )}
            {Platform.OS === "ios" && (
              <Modal
                visible={showDatePicker}
                transparent
                animationType="slide"
                onRequestClose={() => setShowDatePicker(false)}
              >
                <Pressable
                  style={styles.dateBackdrop}
                  onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(false)}
                />
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.dateSheet,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgPanel, borderTopColor: c.border },
                  ]}
                >
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.dateSheetHeader,
                      { borderBottomColor: c.border },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                      {t("postJob.selectStartDate")}
                    </AppText>
                    <Pressable
                      onPress={() => setShowDatePicker(false)}
                      hitSlop={10}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {t("postJob.done")}
                      </AppText>
                    </Pressable>
                  </View>
                  <DateTimePicker
                    value={startDateObj}
                    mode="date"
                    display="spinner"
                    minimumDate={new Date()}
                    onChange={onDateChange}
                    style={{ height: 200, width: "100%" }}
                    themeVariant="dark"
                  />
                </View>
              </Modal>
            )}
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* ════════ STEP 3 ════════ */}
      {step === 3 && (
        <View style={styles.form}>
          {/* Payment Type */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.budgetType")}
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.catListWrap,
                { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
              ]}
            >
              {PAYMENT_TYPE_KEYS.map((pt, idx) => {
                const sel = paymentType === pt.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={pt.value}
                    onPress={() => setPaymentType(pt.value)}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.catRow,
                      {
                        borderBottomColor: c.border,
                        borderBottomWidth:
                          idx < PAYMENT_TYPE_KEYS.length - 1
                            ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth
                            : 0,
                        backgroundColor: pressed
                          ? c.orangeDim
                          : sel
                            ? c.orangeDim
                            : "transparent",
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.catCircle,
                        { backgroundColor: sel ? c.orange : c.border },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Ionicons
                        name={pt.icon}
                        size={16}
                        color={sel ? "#fff" : c.textMuted}
                      />
                    </View>
                    <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 12 }}>
                      <AppText
                        variant="body"
                        weight={sel ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                        style={{ color: sel ? c.orange : c.text }}
                      >
                        {t(pt.labelKey)}
                      </AppText>
                      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                        {t(pt.subKey)}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                    {sel && (
                      <Ionicons
                        name="checkmark-circle"
                        size={20}
                        color={c.orange}
                      />
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Job Duration */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.jobDuration")}
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.catListWrap,
                { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
              ]}
            >
              {DURATION_TYPE_KEYS.map((dt, idx) => {
                const sel = durationType === dt.value;
                return (
                  <Pressable
                    key={dt.value}
                    onPress={() => {
                      setDurationType(dt.value);
                      setDurationValue("");
                      setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, durationValue: null }));
                    }}
                    style={({ pressed }) => [
                      styles.catRow,
                      {
                        borderBottomColor: c.border,
                        borderBottomWidth:
                          idx < DURATION_TYPE_KEYS.length - 1
                            ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth
                            : 0,
                        backgroundColor: pressed
                          ? c.orangeDim
                          : sel
                            ? c.orangeDim
                            : "transparent",
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.catCircle,
                        { backgroundColor: sel ? c.orange : c.border },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <Ionicons
                        name={dt.icon}
                        size={16}
                        color={sel ? "#fff" : c.textMuted}
                      />
                    </View>
                    <AppText
                      variant="body"
                      weight={sel ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                      style={{
                        flex: 1,
                        marginLeft: 12,
                        color: sel ? c.orange : c.text,
                      }}
                    >
                      {t(dt.labelKey)}
                    </AppText>
                    {sel && (
                      <Ionicons
                        name="checkmark-circle"
                        size={20}
                        color={c.orange}
                      />
                    )}
                  </Pressable>
                );
              })}
            </View>
            {durationType === "CUSTOM" ? (
              <AppInput
                label={t("postJob.describeDuration")}
                placeholder={t("postJob.describeDurationPlaceholder")}
                iconLeft="time-outline"
                value={durationValue}
                onChangeText={(v) => {
                  setDurationValue(v);
                  setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, durationValue: null }));
                }}
                error={errors.durationValue}
                style={{ marginTop: 10 }}
              />
            ) : (
              <AppInput
                label={t("postJob.howMany", {
                  unit: t(`postJob.durationType.${durationType}`).toLowerCase(),
                })}
                placeholder={
                  durationType === "HOURS"
                    ? "e.g. 4"
                    : durationType === "DAYS"
                      ? "e.g. 5"
                      : durationType === "WEEKS"
                        ? "e.g. 2"
                        : "e.g. 3"
                }
                iconLeft="hourglass-outline"
                value={durationValue}
                onChangeText={(v) => {
                  setDurationValue(v.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""));
                  setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, durationValue: null }));
                }}
                keyboardType="number-pad"
                error={errors.durationValue}
                style={{ marginTop: 10 }}
              />
            )}
          </View>

          {/* Currency */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.paymentCurrency")}
            </AppText>
            <CurrencyPicker label={t("postJob.payIn")} />
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              {t("postJob.cryptoNote")}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Budget Amount */}
          <AppInput
            label={budgetLabel()}
            placeholder="0.00"
            iconLeft="cash-outline"
            value={budgetAmount}
            onChangeText={(v) => {
              setBudgetAmount(v.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""));
              setErrors((e) => ({ ...e, budgetAmount: null }));
            }}
            keyboardType="decimal-pad"
            error={errors.budgetAmount}
          />

          {/* Additional Notes */}
          <View>
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
            >
              {t("postJob.additionalNotes")}{" "}
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                ({t("postJob.optional")})
              </AppText>
            </AppText>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.textArea,
                {
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.bgInput,
                  minHeight: 100,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <TextInput
                multiline
                numberOfLines={4}
                textAlignVertical="top"
                placeholder={t("postJob.notesPlaceholder")}
                placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
                value={additionalNotes}
                onChangeText={setAdditionalNotes}
                style={[styles.textAreaInput, { color: c.text }]}
              />
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Review Summary */}
          <View>
            <SectionHeader title={t("postJob.reviewTitle")} />
            <Card padded style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
              <RRow
                icon="create-outline"
                label={t("postJob.review.title")}
                value={title}
                c={c}
              />
              <RDiv c={c} />
              <RRow
                icon="grid-outline"
                label={t("postJob.review.category")}
                value={selectedCategoryObj?.name || "—"}
                c={c}
              />
              <RDiv c={c} />
              <RRow
                icon="briefcase-outline"
                label={t("postJob.review.jobType")}
                value={t(
                  JOB_TYPE_KEYS.find((j) => j.value === jobType)?.labelKey ||
                    "",
                )}
                c={c}
              />
              <RDiv c={c} />
              <RRow
                icon="location-outline"
                label={t("postJob.review.location")}
                value={t(
                  LOCATION_TYPE_KEYS.find((l) => l.value === locationType)
                    ?.labelKey || "",
                )}
                c={c}
              />
              {locationType !== "REMOTE" && locationAddress ? (
                <>
                  <RDiv c={c} />
                  <RRow
                    icon="map-outline"
                    label={t("postJob.review.address")}
                    value={locationAddress}
                    c={c}
                  />
                </>
              ) : null}
              <RDiv c={c} />
              <RRow
                icon="calendar-outline"
                label={t("postJob.review.startDate")}
                value={startDate}
                c={c}
              />
              <RDiv c={c} />
              <RRow
                icon="cash-outline"
                label={t("postJob.review.payment")}
                value={`${currency?.symbol || "$"}${budgetAmount || "0"} ${t(selectedPayment?.labelKey || "")}`}
                c={c}
              />
              <RDiv c={c} />
              <RRow
                icon="time-outline"
                label={t("postJob.review.duration")}
                value={
                  durationType === "CUSTOM"
                    ? durationValue
                    : `${durationValue} ${t(`postJob.durationType.${durationType}`).toLowerCase()}`
                }
                c={c}
              />
              {skills.length > 0 && (
                <>
                  <RDiv c={c} />
                  <RRow
                    icon="code-slash-outline"
                    label={t("postJob.review.skills")}
                    value={skills.join(", ")}
                    c={c}
                  />
                </>
              )}
              {additionalNotes.trim() && (
                <>
                  <RDiv c={c} />
                  <RRow
                    icon="document-text-outline"
                    label={t("postJob.review.notes")}
                    value={additionalNotes.trim()}
                    c={c}
                  />
                </>
              )}
            </Card>
          </View>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* CTAs */}
      <View style={styles.ctaWrap}>
        <AppButton
          title={
            submitting
              ? t("postJob.posting")
              : step < TOTAL_STEPS
                ? t("postJob.continue")
                : t("postJob.postJob")
          }
          iconLeft={
            submitting
              ? undefined
              : step < TOTAL_STEPS
                ? "arrow-forward"
                : "checkmark-circle-outline"
          }
          onPress={handleNext}
          loading={submitting}
        />
        <AppButton
          title={t("common.back")}
          variant="ghost"
          onPress={handleBack}
        />
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

function RRow({ icon, label, value, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.reviewRow}>
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={16}
        color={c.orange}
        style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
      />
      <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
          {label}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="medium" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>
          {value || "—"}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
function RDiv({ c }) {
  return <View style={[styles.divider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />;
}

// src/screens/main/ProfileScreen.js
// Mobile mirror of the website's UserProfile.jsx
// Endpoints: GET /users/:id  ·  GET /reviews/hirer/:id  ·  GET /reviews/worker/:id

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
  Linking,
  RefreshControl,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import { useNavigation, useRoute } from "@react-navigation/native";
import * as ImagePicker from "expo-image-picker";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import Card from "../../components/Card";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import {
  getUser,
  getHirerReviews,
  getWorkerReviews,
  updateAvatar,
} from "../../api/profile";

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function initials(u) {
  if (!u) return "??";
  return `${u.firstName?.[0] ?? ""}${u.lastName?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

function timeAgo(date, t) {
  if (!date) return t("profile.never");
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(date).getTime();
  const m = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (m < 1) return t("profile.justNow");
  if (m < 60) return t("profile.minutesAgo", { m });
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  if (h < 24) return t("profile.hoursAgo", { h });
  const d = Math.floor(h / 24);
  if (d < 30) return t("profile.daysAgo", { d });
  return new Date(date).toLocaleDateString();
}

// ─── Star row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Stars({ rating = 0, size = 13, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
      {Array.from({ length: 5 }, (_, i) => (
        <Ionicons
          key={i}
          name={i < Math.round(rating) ? "star" : "star-outline"}
          size={size}
          color={i < Math.round(rating) ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Info chip (location, phone, etc.) ───────────────────────────────────────
function InfoChip({ icon, label, onPress, c }) {
  const Inner = (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.chip,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={13}
        color={c.orange}
        style={{ marginRight: 5 }}
      />
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        numberOfLines={1}
        style={{ color: c.text, maxWidth: 160 }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
  return onPress ? <Pressable onPress={onPress}>{Inner}</Pressable> : Inner;
}

// ─── Stat cell ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatCell({ icon, value, label, c }) {
  return (
    <View style={[styles.statCell, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={16}
        color={c.orange}
        style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}
      />
      <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Badge pill ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Badge({ icon, label, color, bg }) {
  return (
    <View style={[styles.badgePill, { backgroundColor: bg }]}>
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={12}
        color={color}
        style={{ marginRight: 4 }}
      />
      <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={{ color }}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
}

// ─── Review card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewCard({ review, c }) {
  const gi = review.giver;
  const name = `${gi?.firstName ?? ""} ${gi?.lastName ?? ""}`.trim();
  const role = gi?.role === "HIRER" ? "Hirer" : "Worker";
  const date = new Date(review.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });

  return (
    <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
      <View style={styles.reviewTop}>
        {/* Avatar */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.reviewAvatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {gi?.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: gi.avatar }} style={styles.reviewAvatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              {gi?.firstName?.[0] ?? "?"}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        {/* Meta */}
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginHorizontal: 10 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
            {name}{" "}
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              · {role}
            </AppText>
          </AppText>
          {review.booking?.title && (
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
              {review.booking.category?.icon} {review.booking.title}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {date}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        {/* Stars + score */}
        <View style={{ alignItems: "flex-end", gap: 2 }}>
          <Stars rating={review.rating} size={12} c={c} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {review.rating}/5
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
      {review.comment ? (
        <View style={[styles.reviewQuote, { borderLeftColor: c.orange }]}>
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ fontStyle: "italic" }}>
            "{review.comment}"
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </Card>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// MAIN SCREEN
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function ProfileScreen() {
  const navigation = useNavigation();
  const route = useRoute();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { user: me, updateUser } = useAuthStore();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const c = th.colors;

  // userId from route params (viewing someone else) or own profile
  const routeUserId = route.params?.userId;
  const profileId = routeUserId || me?.id;
  const isOwn = !routeUserId || routeUserId === me?.id;

  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("about");
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [reviewsLoading, setReviewsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [reviewsTotal, setReviewsTotal] = useState(0);
  const [reviewsAvg, setReviewsAvg] = useState(0);

  // ── Fetch profile ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!profileId) return;
    try {
      const data = await getUser(profileId);
      setUser(data);
      setError("");
    } catch {
      setError(t("profile.userNotFound"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [profileId, t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchProfile();
  }, [fetchProfile]);

  // ── Fetch reviews when tab opens ──────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== "reviews" || !user) return;
    setReviewsLoading(true);
    const fetcher =
      user.role === "WORKER"
        ? getWorkerReviews(user.id, { limit: 20 })
        : getHirerReviews(user.id, { limit: 20 });
    fetcher
      .then((d) => {
        setReviews(d.reviews ?? []);
        setReviewsTotal(d.total ?? 0);
        setReviewsAvg(d.avgRating ?? 0);
      })
      .catch(() => setReviews([]))
      .finally(() => setReviewsLoading(false));
  }, [tab, user]);

  // ── Avatar upload ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleAvatarPress = async () => {
    if (!isOwn || uploading) return;
    const { status } = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (status !== "granted") {
      toast.error(t("settings.profile.permissionRequired"));
      return;
    }
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      allowsEditing: true,
      aspect: [1, 1],
      quality: 0.8,
    });
    if (result.canceled) return;
    const asset = result.assets[0];
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("avatar", {
      uri: asset.uri,
      type: asset.mimeType || "image/jpeg",
      name: "avatar.jpg",
    });
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const updated = await updateAvatar(formData);
      setUser((u) => ({ ...u, avatar: updated.avatar }));
      updateUser({ avatar: updated.avatar });
      toast.success(t("settings.profile.photoUpdated"));
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("settings.profile.photoFailed"));
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  // ─── Loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (loading)
    return (
      <AppScreen>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
            {t("profile.loadingProfile")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );

  // ─── Error ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (error || !user)
    return (
      <AppScreen>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={40} color={c.red} />
          <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
            {error || t("profile.userNotFound")}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
            style={[styles.backPill, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard }]}
          >
            <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={15} color={c.text} />
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}>
              {t("common.back")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );

  const wp = user.workerProfile;
  const hp = user.hirerProfile;
  const hs = user.hirerStats;
  const tabs =
    user.role === "WORKER"
      ? [
          { key: "about", label: t("profile.tabAbout") },
          { key: "reviews", label: t("profile.tabReviews") },
        ]
      : [
          { key: "about", label: t("profile.tabAbout") },
          { key: "reviews", label: t("profile.tabReviews") },
        ];

  // ─── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <AppScreen scrollable={false}>
      {/* Top nav */}
      <View style={[styles.topBar, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
        <Pressable
          onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
          style={styles.backBtn}
          hitSlop={8}
        >
          <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color={c.text} />
        </Pressable>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
          {isOwn && (
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              {t("profile.yourPublicProfile")}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        {isOwn && (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Settings")}
            style={[
              styles.settingsBtn,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name="settings-outline"
              size={16}
              color={c.text}
              style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
            />
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              {t("nav.settings")}
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        )}
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scroll}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={() => {
              setRefreshing(true);
              fetchProfile();
            }}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
      >
        {/* ── HERO CARD ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <Card style={styles.heroCard}>
          {/* Hero background strip */}
          <View style={[styles.heroBg, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]} />

          {/* Avatar */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleAvatarPress}
            disabled={!isOwn}
            style={styles.avatarWrap}
          >
            {user.avatar ? (
              <Image source={{ uri: user.avatar }} style={styles.avatar} />
            ) : (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.avatarFallback,
                  { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText
                  variant="display"
                  weight="displayBlack"
                  style={{ color: c.orange }}
                >
                  {initials(user)}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
            {isOwn && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.avatarOverlay,
                  { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)" },
                ]}
              >
                {uploading ? (
                  <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="#fff" />
                ) : (
                  <Ionicons name="camera" size={16} color="#fff" />
                )}
              </View>
            )}
            {!isOwn && (
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.onlineDot,
                  { backgroundColor: c.green, borderColor: c.bgPanel },
                ]}
              />
            )}
          </Pressable>

          {/* Name + badges */}
          <View style={styles.heroInfo}>
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: "row",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: 6,
                flexWrap: "wrap",
                justifyContent: "center",
              }}
            >
              <AppText variant="displaySm" weight="displayBlack">
                {user.firstName} {user.lastName}
              </AppText>
              {wp?.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED" && (
                <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark" size={18} color={c.green} />
              )}
            </View>

            {/* Role pill */}
            <View
              style={[
                styles.rolePill,
                { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.orange },
              ]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={
                  user.role === "WORKER"
                    ? "construct-outline"
                    : "briefcase-outline"
                }
                size={12}
                color={c.orange}
              />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}
              >
                {user.role === "WORKER"
                  ? t("profile.worker")
                  : t("profile.hirer")}
              </AppText>
            </View>

            {/* Worker title */}
            {wp?.title && (
              <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                {wp.title}
              </AppText>
            )}

            {/* Stars (worker) */}
            {user.role === "WORKER" && wp?.avgRating > 0 && (
              <View
                style={{
                  flexDirection: "row",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: 6,
                  marginTop: 6,
                }}
              >
                <Stars rating={wp.avgRating} c={c} />
                <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
                  {Number(wp.avgRating).toFixed(1)}
                </AppText>
                <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
                  ({wp.totalReviews ?? 0} {t("profile.reviews")})
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )}
          </View>
        </Card>

        {/* ── STATS ROW ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
          contentContainerStyle={{ gap: 0 }}
        >
          <View
            style={[
              styles.statsRow,
              { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
            ]}
          >
            {user.role === "HIRER" && hs && (
              <>
                <StatCell
                  icon="briefcase-outline"
                  value={String(hs.totalHires)}
                  label={t("profile.totalHires")}
                  c={c}
                />
                <StatCell
                  icon="cash-outline"
                  value={`${user.currency ?? "USD"} ${Number(hs.totalSpent).toLocaleString()}`}
                  label={t("profile.totalSpent")}
                  c={c}
                />
                {hs.avgRating > 0 && (
                  <StatCell
                    icon="star-outline"
                    value={`${Number(hs.avgRating).toFixed(1)} (${hs.totalReviews})`}
                    label={t("profile.rating")}
                    c={c}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
            {user.role === "WORKER" && wp && (
              <>
                <StatCell
                  icon="cash-outline"
                  value={`${wp.currency ?? user.currency ?? "USD"} ${Number(wp.hourlyRate ?? 0).toLocaleString()}`}
                  label={t("profile.perHour")}
                  c={c}
                />
                <StatCell
                  icon="checkmark-circle-outline"
                  value={String(wp.completedJobs ?? wp.totalJobs ?? 0)}
                  label={t("profile.jobsDone")}
                  c={c}
                />
                {wp.serviceRadius && (
                  <StatCell
                    icon="location-outline"
                    value={`${wp.serviceRadius}`}
                    label={t("profile.radius")}
                    c={c}
                  />
                )}
              </>
            )}
            <StatCell
              icon="time-outline"
              value={timeAgo(user.lastSeen, t)}
              label={t("profile.lastSeen")}
              c={c}
            />
            <StatCell
              icon="calendar-outline"
              value={new Date(user.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en", {
                month: "short",
                year: "numeric",
              })}
              label={t("profile.joined")}
              c={c}
            />
          </View>
        </ScrollView>

        {/* ── INFO CHIPS ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <Card style={{ marginBottom: 12, padding: 14 }}>
          <View style={styles.chipsWrap}>
            {hp?.companyName && (
              <InfoChip icon="business-outline" label={hp.companyName} c={c} />
            )}
            {hp?.companySize && (
              <InfoChip icon="people-outline" label={hp.companySize} c={c} />
            )}
            {(user.city || user.country) && (
              <InfoChip
                icon="location-outline"
                label={[user.city, user.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}
                c={c}
              />
            )}
            {user.phone && (
              <InfoChip
                icon="call-outline"
                label={user.phone}
                onPress={() => Linking.openURL(`tel:${user.phone}`)}
                c={c}
              />
            )}
            {user.email && isOwn && (
              <InfoChip
                icon="mail-outline"
                label={user.email}
                onPress={() => Linking.openURL(`mailto:${user.email}`)}
                c={c}
              />
            )}
            {user.currency && (
              <InfoChip icon="globe-outline" label={user.currency} c={c} />
            )}
            {hp?.website && (
              <InfoChip
                icon="link-outline"
                label={hp.website.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "")}
                onPress={() =>
                  Linking.openURL(
                    hp.website.startsWith("http")
                      ? hp.website
                      : `https://${hp.website}`,
                  )
                }
                c={c}
              />
            )}
          </View>
        </Card>

        {/* ── TAB BAR ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <View style={[styles.tabBar, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
          {tabs.map((t_) => (
            <Pressable
              key={t_.key}
              onPress={() => setTab(t_.key)}
              style={[
                styles.tabBtn,
                tab === t_.key && {
                  borderBottomColor: c.orange,
                  borderBottomWidth: 2,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight={tab === t_.key ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                style={{ color: tab === t_.key ? c.orange : c.textMuted }}
              >
                {t_.label}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          ))}
        </View>

        {/* ════════════ ABOUT TAB ════════════ */}
        {tab === "about" && (
          <View style={{ paddingTop: 14, gap: 12 }}>
            {/* Bio */}
            {user.bio ? (
              <Card padded>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  tone="dim"
                  style={styles.sectionLabel}
                >
                  {t("profile.tabAbout").toUpperCase()}
                </AppText>
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  style={{ marginTop: 8, lineHeight: 22 }}
                >
                  {user.bio}
                </AppText>
              </Card>
            ) : (
              <Card padded style={styles.emptyCard}>
                <AppText variant="body" tone="dim">
                  {t("profile.noBio")}
                </AppText>
                {isOwn && (
                  <Pressable
                    onPress={() => navigation.navigate("Settings")}
                    style={[
                      styles.emptyBtn,
                      { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <Ionicons
                      name="pencil-outline"
                      size={13}
                      color={c.orange}
                      style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
                    />
                    <AppText
                      variant="small"
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={{ color: c.orange }}
                    >
                      {t("profile.addBio")}
                    </AppText>
                  </Pressable>
                )}
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* Specialities (worker) */}
            {wp?.categories?.length > 0 && (
              <Card padded>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  tone="dim"
                  style={styles.sectionLabel}
                >
                  {t("profile.specialities").toUpperCase()}
                </AppText>
                <View style={styles.chipsWrap}>
                  {wp.categories.map((cat) => (
                    <View
                      key={cat.id}
                      style={[
                        styles.catPill,
                        { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        weight="semibold"
                        style={{ color: c.orange }}
                      >
                        {cat.category?.name ?? cat.name}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
              </Card>
            )}

            {/* Verification badges */}
            <Card padded>
              <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", flexWrap: "wrap", gap: 8 }}>
                <Badge
                  icon={
                    user.isEmailVerified ? "checkmark-circle" : "close-circle"
                  }
                  label={t("profile.emailVerified")}
                  color={user.isEmailVerified ? "#22c55e" : "#ef4444"}
                  bg={
                    user.isEmailVerified
                      ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.1)"
                      : "rgba(239,68,68,0.1)"
                  }
                />
                {wp?.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED" && (
                  <Badge
                    icon="shield-checkmark"
                    label={t("profile.idVerified")}
                    color="#f97316"
                    bg="rgba(249,115,22,0.12)"
                  />
                )}
                {wp?.backgroundCheck && (
                  <Badge
                    icon="ribbon"
                    label={t("profile.backgroundChecked")}
                    color="#3b82f6"
                    bg="rgba(59,130,246,0.1)"
                  />
                )}
              </View>
            </Card>
          </View>
        )}

        {/* ════════════ REVIEWS TAB ════════════ */}
        {tab === "reviews" && (
          <View style={{ paddingTop: 14 }}>
            {reviewsLoading ? (
              <View style={styles.center}>
                <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
              </View>
            ) : reviews.length === 0 ? (
              <Card padded style={styles.emptyCard}>
                <Ionicons name="star-outline" size={28} color={c.textMuted} />
                <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
                  {t("profile.noReviews")}
                </AppText>
              </Card>
            ) : (
              <>
                {/* Summary bar */}
                <Card padded style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
                  <View style={styles.reviewSummary}>
                    <AppText
                      variant="display"
                      weight="displayBlack"
                      style={{ color: c.orange, fontSize: 40 }}
                    >
                      {Number(
                        reviewsAvg ||
                          reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) /
                            reviews.length,
                      ).toFixed(1)}
                    </AppText>
                    <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
                      <Stars
                        rating={
                          reviewsAvg ||
                          reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) /
                            reviews.length
                        }
                        size={18}
                        c={c}
                      />
                      <AppText
                        variant="small"
                        tone="dim"
                        style={{ marginTop: 4 }}
                      >
                        {reviewsTotal}{" "}
                        {reviewsTotal === 1
                          ? t("profile.review")
                          : t("profile.reviews")}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                </Card>

                {reviews.map((r) => (
                  <ReviewCard key={r.id} review={r} c={c} />
                ))}
              </>
            )}
          </View>
        )}

        {/* Book button for non-owner viewing a worker */}
        {!isOwn && user.role === "WORKER" && (
          <Pressable
            onPress={() =>
              navigation.navigate("BookingDetail", { workerId: user.id })
            }
            style={[styles.bookBtn, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
          >
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
              {t("profile.book")} {user.firstName}
            </AppText>
            <Ionicons
              name="chevron-forward"
              size={18}
              color="#fff"
              style={{ marginLeft: 6 }}
            />
          </Pressable>
        )}

        <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
      </ScrollView>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}
