// src/screens/main/ReviewsGivenScreen.js
// Endpoint: GET /hirers/me/reviews/given
// Shows stats card + reviews given with "View Profile →" button.
// All strings via t(). Full dark/light mode support.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { getReviewsGiven } from "../../api/reviews";

function fmtDateTime(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

function StarRow({ rating, size = 16, color }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <AppText
          key={i}
          style={{ fontSize: size, color: i <= rating ? color : "#4b5563" }}
        >
          ★
        </AppText>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Stats card ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StatsCard({ totalReviews, avgRating, c, t }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        s.statsCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={s.statItem}>
        <AppText style={[s.statNum, { color: c.orange }]}>
          {totalReviews}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
          {t("reviews.submitted")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <View style={[s.statDivider, { backgroundColor: c.border }]} />
      <View style={s.statItem}>
        <AppText style={[s.statNum, { color: c.orange }]}>
          {Number(avgRating).toFixed(1)}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 4 }}>
          {t("reviews.avgGiven")}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Review card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewGivenCard({ review, c, t, onViewProfile }) {
  const receiver = review.receiver ?? review.giver ?? {};
  const booking = review.booking;
  const location = [receiver.city, receiver.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  return (
    <View
      style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* Author row */}
      <View style={s.authorRow}>
        <View
          style={[
            s.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {receiver.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: receiver.avatar }} style={s.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {initials(receiver.firstName, receiver.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={s.authorInfo}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {receiver.firstName} {receiver.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {receiver.role === "WORKER"
              ? t("reviews.worker")
              : t("reviews.hirer")}
          </AppText>
          {!!location && (
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
              {location}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {fmtDateTime(review.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <View style={s.ratingCol}>
          <StarRow rating={review.rating} size={15} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, textAlign: "right", marginTop: 2 }}
          >
            {review.rating}/5
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Comment */}
      {!!review.comment && (
        <View style={[s.quoteRow, { borderLeftColor: c.orange }]}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ color: c.text, fontStyle: "italic" }}
          >
            "{review.comment}"
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Booking chip + View Profile */}
      {booking && (
        <View
          style={[
            s.bookingChip,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={s.chipLeft}>
            {!!booking.category?.icon && (
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, marginRight: 6 }}>
                {booking.category.icon}
              </AppText>
            )}
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text }}
            >
              {booking.title}
            </AppText>
            {booking.category?.name && (
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 6 }}
              >
                {booking.category.name}
              </AppText>
            )}
          </View>
          {/* View Profile — only on Reviews Given */}
          <Pressable
            onPress={() => onViewProfile(receiver.id)}
            style={s.viewProfileBtn}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {t("reviews.viewProfile")} →
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            s.skCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function ReviewsGivenScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  const doFetch = useCallback(async (pg = 1, replace = true) => {
    try {
      const d = await getReviewsGiven({ page: pg, limit: 15 });
      setData(d);
      setReviews(
        replace ? (d.reviews ?? []) : (prev) => [...prev, ...(d.reviews ?? [])],
      );
      setTotalPages(d.pages ?? 1);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    doFetch(1, true);
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setPage(1);
    doFetch(1, true);
  };
  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages) {
      const next = page + 1;
      setPage(next);
      doFetch(next, false);
    }
  };

  // Derive stats from response
  const totalReviews = data?.total ?? reviews.length;
  const avgRating =
    data?.avgRating ??
    (reviews.length
      ? reviews.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length
      : 0);

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={reviews}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Hero */}
            <View style={styles.heroWrap}>
              <View style={[styles.eyebrow, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff", letterSpacing: 1.2 }}
                >
                  {t("reviews.feedbackEyebrow")}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <AppText style={[styles.heroTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                {t("reviews.givenTitle")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.givenSubtitle")}
              </AppText>
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => navigation.replace("ReviewsReceived")}
                style={[
                  styles.switchBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.text }}>
                  {t("reviews.seeReceived")} →
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Stats */}
            {!loading && (
              <StatsCard
                totalReviews={totalReviews}
                avgRating={avgRating}
                c={c}
                t={t}
              />
            )}
            <View style={{ height: 16 }} />
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <ReviewGivenCard
            review={item}
            c={c}
            t={t}
            onViewProfile={(userId) =>
              navigation.navigate("Profile", { userId })
            }
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>✍️</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noReviewsYet")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noGivenSub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  screen: { flex: 1 },
  content: { padding: 16, paddingBottom: 40 },
  heroWrap: { marginBottom: 20 },
  eyebrow: {
    alignSelf: "flex-start",
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    paddingVertical: 6,
    borderRadius: 20,
    marginBottom: 12,
  },
  heroTitle: {
    fontSize: 36,
    fontWeight: "900",
    lineHeight: 42,
    letterSpacing: -0.5,
  },
  switchBtn: {
    alignSelf: "flex-start",
    marginTop: 16,
    paddingHorizontal: 18,
    paddingVertical: 12,
    borderRadius: 12,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  empty: { alignItems: "center", paddingTop: 60, paddingHorizontal: 32 },
});

});

// src/screens/main/ReviewsReceivedScreen.js
// Endpoint: GET /hirers/me/reviews/received
// Shows avg rating, distribution bars, and review cards.
// All strings via t() for i18n. Full dark/light mode support.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { getReviewsReceived } from "../../api/reviews";

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmtDateTime(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

// ── Star row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function StarRow({ rating, size = 16, color }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 2 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <AppText
          key={i}
          style={{ fontSize: size, color: i <= rating ? color : "#4b5563" }}
        >
          ★
        </AppText>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Rating summary card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function RatingSummaryCard({ avgRating, totalReviews, distribution, c, t }) {
  const filledStars = Math.round(avgRating);
  const maxCount = Math.max(
    ...[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((s) => distribution[s] ?? 0),
    1,
  );

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        s.summaryCard,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Top row: big number + star row */}
      <View style={s.summaryTop}>
        <AppText style={[s.bigRating, { color: c.orange }]}>
          {Number(avgRating).toFixed(1)}
        </AppText>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>
          <StarRow rating={filledStars} size={22} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
            {totalReviews} {t("reviews.reviewsCount", { count: totalReviews })}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Distribution bars */}
      <View style={[s.distBlock, { borderTopColor: c.border }]}>
        {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((star) => {
          const count = distribution[star] ?? 0;
          const pct = maxCount > 0 ? count / maxCount : 0;
          return (
            <View key={star} style={s.distRow}>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.distLabel}>
                {star} ★
              </AppText>
              <View style={[s.barTrack, { backgroundColor: c.bgInput }]}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    s.barFill,
                    { backgroundColor: c.orange, width: `${pct * 100}%` },
                  ]}
                />
              </View>
              <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={s.distCount}>
                {count}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Review card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function ReviewCard({ review, c, t }) {
  const giver = review.giver ?? {};
  const booking = review.booking;
  const location = [giver.city, giver.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  return (
    <View
      style={[s.card, { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border }]}
    >
      {/* Author row */}
      <View style={s.authorRow}>
        <View
          style={[
            s.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {giver.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: giver.avatar }} style={s.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
              {initials(giver.firstName, giver.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={s.authorInfo}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {giver.firstName} {giver.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {giver.role === "WORKER" ? t("reviews.worker") : t("reviews.hirer")}
          </AppText>
          {!!location && (
            <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
              {location}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
            {fmtDateTime(review.createdAt)}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <View style={s.ratingCol}>
          <StarRow rating={review.rating} size={15} color={c.orange} />
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            style={{ color: c.textMuted, textAlign: "right", marginTop: 2 }}
          >
            {review.rating}/5
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Comment */}
      {!!review.comment && (
        <View style={[s.quoteRow, { borderLeftColor: c.orange }]}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            style={{ color: c.text, fontStyle: "italic" }}
          >
            "{review.comment}"
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* Booking chip */}
      {booking && (
        <View
          style={[
            s.bookingChip,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {!!booking.category?.icon && (
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14, marginRight: 6 }}>
              {booking.category.icon}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.text }}>
            {booking.title}
          </AppText>
          {booking.category?.name && (
            <AppText
              variant="small"
              style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginLeft: 6 }}
            >
              {booking.category.name}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Skeleton({ c }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ gap: 12 }}>
      {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
        <View
          key={i}
          style={[
            s.skCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Main Screen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function ReviewsReceivedScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  const fetch = useCallback(async (pg = 1, replace = true) => {
    try {
      const d = await getReviewsReceived({ page: pg, limit: 15 });
      setData(d);
      setReviews(replace ? d.reviews : (prev) => [...prev, ...d.reviews]);
      setTotalPages(d.pages ?? 1);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(1, true);
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    setPage(1);
    fetch(1, true);
  };

  const loadMore = () => {
    if (page < totalPages) {
      const next = page + 1;
      setPage(next);
      fetch(next, false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={reviews}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        onEndReached={loadMore}
        onEndReachedThreshold={0.4}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View>
            {/* Page hero */}
            <View style={[styles.heroWrap, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
              <View style={[styles.eyebrow, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}>
                <AppText
                  variant="small"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: "#fff", letterSpacing: 1.2 }}
                >
                  {t("reviews.reputationEyebrow")}
                </AppText>
              </View>
              <AppText style={[styles.heroTitle, { color: c.text }]}>
                {t("reviews.receivedTitle")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6, lineHeight: 22 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.receivedSubtitle")}
              </AppText>
              {/* See Reviews Given link */}
              <Pressable
                onPress={() => navigation.replace("ReviewsGiven")}
                style={[
                  styles.switchBtn,
                  { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="body" style={{ color: c.text }}>
                  {t("reviews.seeGiven")} →
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            </View>

            {/* Rating summary */}
            {data && (
              <RatingSummaryCard
                avgRating={data.avgRating ?? 0}
                totalReviews={data.totalReviews ?? 0}
                distribution={data.distribution ?? {}}
                c={c}
                t={t}
              />
            )}
            <View style={{ height: 16 }} />
          </View>
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => <ReviewCard review={item} c={c} t={t} />}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? (
            <Skeleton c={c} />
          ) : (
            <View style={styles.empty}>
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 44 }}>⭐</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 12 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noReviewsYet")}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 6 }}
              >
                {t("reviews.noReceivedSub")}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          )
        }
        ListFooterComponent={
          page < totalPages ? (
            <View style={{ alignItems: "center", padding: 20 }}>
              <ActivityIndicator color={c.orange} />
            </View>
          ) : (
            <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
          )
        }
      />
    </View>
  );
}

// ── Styles ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const styles = StyleSheet.create({

// src/screens/main/SavedWorkersScreen.js
// Endpoint: GET /hirers/me/saved-workers
// All user-facing strings go through t() so locales can be added
// without touching this file.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import { getSavedWorkers } from "../../api/hirer";

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

function fmtRating(rating) {
  if (!rating || rating === 0) return null;
  return Number(rating).toFixed(1);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Worker Card
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function WorkerCard({ worker, onViewProfile, c, t }) {
  const wp = worker.workerProfile ?? {};
  const rating = fmtRating(wp.avgRating);
  const isAvailable = wp.isAvailable ?? false;
  const location = [worker.city, worker.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
  const lastCat = worker.lastCategory?.name;

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.card,
        { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Top row — avatar + name + rating */}
      <View style={styles.cardTop}>
        <View
          style={[
            styles.avatar,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {worker.avatar ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: worker.avatar }} style={styles.avatarImg} />
          ) : (
            <AppText
              style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700", fontSize: 18 }}
            >
              {initials(worker.firstName, worker.lastName)}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>

        <View style={styles.nameBlock}>
          <AppText variant="title" weight="semibold">
            {worker.firstName} {worker.lastName}
          </AppText>
          {!!wp.title && (
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" numberOfLines={1}>
              {wp.title}
            </AppText>
          )}
        </View>

        {rating !== null && (
          <View style={styles.ratingBlock}>
            <AppText style={[styles.ratingStar, { color: c.orange }]}>
              ★
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}
            >
              {rating}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
      </View>

      {/* Location + availability row */}
      <View style={styles.metaRow}>
        {!!location && (
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ flex: 1 }}
            numberOfLines={1}
          >
            {location}
          </AppText>
        )}
        <View style={styles.availabilityChip}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.dot,
              { backgroundColor: isAvailable ? "#22c55e" : "#6b7280" },
            ]}
          />
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{
              color: isAvailable ? "#22c55e" : "#6b7280",
              marginLeft: 5,
            }}
          >
            {isAvailable
              ? t("savedWorkers.available")
              : t("savedWorkers.unavailable")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Last hired for */}
      {!!lastCat && (
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={styles.lastHiredText}>
          {t("savedWorkers.lastHiredFor", { category: lastCat })}
        </AppText>
      )}

      {/* Rate chip */}
      {!!wp.hourlyRate && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.rateChip,
            { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: c.orange }}
          >
            {wp.currency} {Number(wp.hourlyRate).toLocaleString()}
            {t("savedWorkers.perHour")}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      )}

      {/* View Profile button */}
      <Pressable
        style={[
          styles.viewBtn,
          { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
        ]}
        onPress={() => onViewProfile(worker.id)}
      >
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: c.orange }}>
          {t("savedWorkers.viewProfile")} →
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    </View>
  );
}

      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 52, textAlign: "center" }}>👷</AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="title"
        weight="semibold"

      <AppText

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function SavedWorkersScreen({ navigation }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const toast = useToast();

  const [workers, setWorkers] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const fetchWorkers = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await getSavedWorkers();
      setWorkers(data ?? []);
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchWorkers();
  }, []);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    fetchWorkers();
  };

  const handleViewProfile = (workerId) => {
    navigation.navigate("Profile", { userId: workerId });
  };

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <FlatList
        data={workers}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
        ListHeaderComponent={
          !loading && workers.length > 0 ? (
            <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={styles.subtitle}>
              {t("savedWorkers.subtitle")}
            </AppText>
          ) : null
        }
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <WorkerCard
            worker={item}
            onViewProfile={handleViewProfile}
            c={c}
            t={t}
          />
        )}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={{ height: 12 }} />}
        ListEmptyComponent={
          loading ? <Skeleton c={c} /> : <EmptyState c={c} t={t} />
        }
        ListFooterComponent={<View style={{ height: 40 }} />}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

// src/screens/main/SettingsScreen.js
//
// Full settings screen mirroring the SkilledProz website:
//   Profile · Company · Hiring Prefs · Currencies ·
//   Appearance · Notifications · Privacy · Security · Activity
//
// API: /api/settings/* (settingsApi)

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  Image,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  Switch,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from "react-native";
import { Ionicons } from "@expo/vector-icons";
import * as ImagePicker from "expo-image-picker";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

import AppScreen from "../../components/AppScreen";
import AppText from "../../components/AppText";
import AppButton from "../../components/AppButton";
import AppInput from "../../components/AppInput";
import Card from "../../components/Card";
import CurrencyPicker from "../../components/CurrencyPicker";
import { useTheme } from "../../contexts/ThemeContext";
import { useCurrency } from "../../contexts/CurrencyContext";
import { useToast } from "../../contexts/ToastContext";
import { useAuthStore } from "../../store/authStore";
import { settingsApi } from "../../api/settings";
import { changeLanguage } from "../../i18n"; // persists to AsyncStorage
import { CURRENCIES } from "../../constants/currencies";
import { LANGUAGES } from "../../constants/languages";

// ─── Tab definitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const TABS = [
  { id: "profile", labelKey: "settings.tabs.profile", icon: "person-outline" },
  {
    id: "company",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.company",
    icon: "business-outline",
  },
  {
    id: "hiring",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.hiringPrefs",
    icon: "clipboard-outline",
  },
  {
    id: "currencies",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.currencies",
    icon: "cash-outline",
  },
  {
    id: "appearance",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.appearance",
    icon: "color-palette-outline",
  },
  {
    id: "notifications",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.notifications",
    icon: "notifications-outline",
  },
  {
    id: "privacy",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.privacy",
    icon: "lock-closed-outline",
  },
  {
    id: "security",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.security",
    icon: "shield-outline",
  },
  {
    id: "activity",
    labelKey: "settings.tabs.activity",
    icon: "bar-chart-outline",
  },
];

const COMPANY_SIZES = [
  "1–10 employees",
  "11–50 employees",
  "51–200 employees",
  "201–500 employees",
  "500+ employees",
];

const EST_UNITS = ["Hours", "Days", "Weeks", "Months", "Custom"];

const THEMES = [
  { value: "light", label: "Light", emoji: "☀️" },
  { value: "dark", label: "Dark", emoji: "🌙" },
  { value: "system", label: "System", emoji: "💻" },
];

const GENDERS = ["Male", "Female", "Non-binary", "Prefer not to say"];

// ─── Main Screen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function SettingsScreen() {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { user, updateUser } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("profile");
  const [profileData, setProfileData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const tabScrollRef = useRef(null);

  const loadProfile = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const data = await settingsApi.getProfile();
      setProfileData(data);
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not load settings");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfile();
  }, [loadProfile]);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <AppScreen scroll={false}>
        <View style={styles.center}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      </AppScreen>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AppScreen>
      {/* ── Page header ── */}
      <AppText variant="display" weight="displayBlack">
        {t("settings.title")}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="body"
        tone="dim"
        style={{ marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 20 }}
      >
        {t("settings.subtitle")}
      </AppText>

      {/* ── Tab bar ── */}
      <ScrollView
        ref={tabScrollRef}
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        style={[
          styles.tabBar,
          { backgroundColor: c.card, borderColor: c.border },
        ]}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.tabBarInner}
      >
        {TABS.map((tab) => {
          const active = activeTab === tab.id;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={tab.id}
              onPress={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
              style={[styles.tab, active && { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
            >
              <Ionicons
                name={tab.icon}
                size={14}
                color={active ? "#fff" : c.textMuted}
                style={{ marginRight: 6 }}
              />
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: active ? "#fff" : c.text }}
              >
                {t(tab.labelKey)}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      {/* ── Section content ── */}
      <View style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
        {activeTab === "profile" && (
          <ProfileSection data={profileData} onReload={loadProfile} />
        )}
        {activeTab === "company" && (
          <CompanySection data={profileData} onReload={loadProfile} />
        )}
        {activeTab === "hiring" && (
          <HiringPrefsSection data={profileData} onReload={loadProfile} />
        )}
        {activeTab === "currencies" && (
          <CurrenciesSection data={profileData} onReload={loadProfile} />
        )}
        {activeTab === "appearance" && (
          <AppearanceSection data={profileData} onReload={loadProfile} />
        )}
        {activeTab === "notifications" && <NotificationsSection />}
        {activeTab === "privacy" && <PrivacySection />}
        {activeTab === "security" && <SecuritySection />}
        {activeTab === "activity" && <ActivitySection />}
      </View>
    </AppScreen>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  PROFILE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function ProfileSection({ data, onReload }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { updateUser } = useAuthStore();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState(data?.firstName || "");
  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState(data?.lastName || "");
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(data?.phone || "");
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(data?.bio || "");
  const [country, setCountry] = useState(data?.country || "");
  const [state, setState] = useState(data?.state || "");
  const [city, setCity] = useState(data?.city || "");
  const [address, setAddress] = useState(data?.address || "");
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState(data?.currency || "USD");
  const [gender, setGender] = useState(data?.gender || "");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [avatarUri, setAvatarUri] = useState(null);
  const [uploadingAvatar, setUploadingAvatar] = useState(false);

  const handlePickAvatar = async () => {
    const { status } = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
    if (status !== "granted") {
      toast.error("Camera roll permission required");
      return;
    }
    const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
      mediaTypes: ImagePicker.MediaTypeOptions.Images,
      allowsEditing: true,
      aspect: [1, 1],
      quality: 0.8,
    });
    if (!result.canceled && result.assets?.[0]?.uri) {
      const uri = result.assets[0].uri;
      setAvatarUri(uri);
      setUploadingAvatar(true);
      try {
        await settingsApi.updateAvatar(uri);
        toast.success("Photo updated");
        onReload();
      } catch {
        toast.error("Photo upload failed");
        setAvatarUri(null);
      } finally {
        setUploadingAvatar(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    // Optimistic update — apply immediately
    updateUser({
      firstName,
      lastName,
      phone,
      bio,
      country,
      state,
      city,
      address,
      currency,
      gender,
    });
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const updated = await settingsApi.updateProfile({
        firstName,
        lastName,
        phone,
        bio,
        country,
        state,
        city,
        address,
        currency,
        gender,
      });
      updateUser(updated);
      toast.success("Profile updated");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not save profile");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const avatarSrc = avatarUri || data?.avatar;

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon="👤"
      title="Profile Information"
      sub="Your personal details visible to others"
    >
      {/* Avatar */}
      <View style={styles.avatarRow}>
        <View style={[styles.avatarWrap, { borderColor: c.orange }]}>
          {avatarSrc ? (
            <Image source={{ uri: avatarSrc }} style={styles.avatar} />
          ) : (
            <Ionicons name="person" size={40} color={c.textMuted} />
          )}
          {uploadingAvatar && (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.avatarOverlay,
                { backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)" },
              ]}
            >
              <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" />
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 16 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
            {data?.firstName} {data?.lastName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="brand"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}
          >
            {data?.role}
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handlePickAvatar}
            style={[
              styles.changePhotoBtn,
              { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.card },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
              Change Photo
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
            JPG, PNG or WebP · max 5MB
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>

      <Divider c={c} />

      {/* Name row */}
      <View style={styles.twoCol}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="FIRST NAME" />
          <FieldInput
            value={firstName}
            onChange={setFirstName}
            placeholder="First name"
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="LAST NAME" />
          <FieldInput
            value={lastName}
            onChange={setLastName}
            placeholder="Last name"
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
      </View>

      <FieldLabel label="PHONE" />
      <FieldInput
        value={phone}
        onChange={setPhone}
        placeholder="+1 000 000 0000"
        keyboardType="phone-pad"
        c={c}
      />

      <FieldLabel label="BIO" />
      <MultilineInput
        value={bio}
        onChange={setBio}
        placeholder="Tell workers about yourself…"
        c={c}
      />

      <View style={styles.twoCol}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="COUNTRY" />
          <FieldInput
            value={country}
            onChange={setCountry}
            placeholder="Country"
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="STATE" />
          <FieldInput
            value={state}
            onChange={setState}
            placeholder="State"
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.twoCol}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="CITY" />
          <FieldInput
            value={city}
            onChange={setCity}
            placeholder="City"
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="ADDRESS" />
          <FieldInput
            value={address}
            onChange={setAddress}
            placeholder="Street address"
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.twoCol}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="CURRENCY" />
          <SelectInput
            value={currency}
            options={CURRENCIES.map((cu) => ({
              value: cu.code,
              label: `${cu.code} — ${cu.name}`,
            }))}
            onChange={setCurrency}
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
        <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <FieldLabel label="GENDER" />
          <SelectInput
            value={gender}
            options={GENDERS.map((g) => ({ value: g, label: g }))}
            onChange={setGender}
            c={c}
          />
        </View>
      </View>

      <AppButton
        title={saving ? "Saving…" : "Save Profile"}
        onPress={handleSave}
        loading={saving}
        style={{ marginTop: 8, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
        fullWidth={false}
      />
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  COMPANY
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function CompanySection({ data, onReload }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const hp = data?.hirerProfile;

  const [companyName, setCompanyName] = useState(hp?.companyName || "");
  const [companySize, setCompanySize] = useState(hp?.companySize || "");
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState(hp?.website || "");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.updateHirerProfile({
        companyName,
        companySize,
        website,
      });
      toast.success("Company profile updated");
      onReload();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not save company profile");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon="🏢"
      title="Company Profile"
      sub="Company information visible to workers you hire"
    >
      <FieldLabel label="COMPANY NAME" />
      <FieldInput
        value={companyName}
        onChange={setCompanyName}
        placeholder="Your company name"
        c={c}
      />

      <FieldLabel label="COMPANY SIZE" />
      <SelectInput
        value={companySize}
        options={COMPANY_SIZES.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: s }))}
        onChange={setCompanySize}
        c={c}
      />

      <FieldLabel label="WEBSITE" />
      <FieldInput
        value={website}
        onChange={setWebsite}
        placeholder="https://yourcompany.com"
        keyboardType="url"
        c={c}
      />

      <AppButton
        title={saving ? "Saving…" : "Save Company Profile"}
        onPress={handleSave}
        loading={saving}
        style={{ marginTop: 8, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
        fullWidth={false}
      />
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  HIRING PREFS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function HiringPrefsSection({ data, onReload }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [unit, setUnit] = useState(data?.defaultEstUnit || "Hours");
  const [value, setValue] = useState(data?.defaultEstValue || "");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.updateProfile({
        defaultEstUnit: unit,
        defaultEstValue: value,
      });
      toast.success("Hiring preferences saved");
      onReload();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not save preferences");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon="📋"
      title="Hiring Preferences"
      sub="Default settings when creating bookings"
    >
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
        Choose your default estimated duration format when creating new
        bookings.
      </AppText>

      <FieldLabel label="DEFAULT ESTIMATED DURATION UNIT" />
      <View style={styles.chipRow}>
        {EST_UNITS.map((u) => {
          const sel = unit === u;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={u}
              onPress={() => setUnit(u)}
              style={[
                styles.chip,
                {
                  borderColor: sel ? c.orange : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: sel ? c.orange : c.card,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ color: sel ? "#fff" : c.text }}
              >
                {u}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <FieldLabel label={`DEFAULT ESTIMATED VALUE (${unit.toUpperCase()})`} />
      <FieldInput
        value={value}
        onChange={setValue}
        placeholder="e.g. 3"
        keyboardType="number-pad"
        c={c}
      />

      <InfoBox
        text="These are defaults only — you can always change duration per booking when creating it."
        c={c}
      />

      <AppButton
        title={saving ? "Saving…" : "Save Hiring Preferences"}
        onPress={handleSave}
        loading={saving}
        style={{ marginTop: 8, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
        fullWidth={false}
      />
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  CURRENCIES
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function CurrenciesSection({ data, onReload }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { setCurrencyCode } = useCurrency();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [dashCurrency, setDashCurrency] = useState(
    data?.dashboardCurrency || "USD",
  );
  const [payCurrency, setPayCurrency] = useState(
    data?.paymentCurrency || "USD",
  );
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const dashInfo = CURRENCIES.find((cu) => cu.code === dashCurrency);
  const payInfo = CURRENCIES.find((cu) => cu.code === payCurrency);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    // Apply to CurrencyContext immediately — dashboard re-renders at once
    setCurrencyCode(dashCurrency);
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.updateProfile({
        dashboardCurrency: dashCurrency,
        paymentCurrency: payCurrency,
      });
      toast.success(t("settings.currencies.saved"));
      onReload();
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("settings.currencies.failed"));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <SectionCard
        icon="💱"
        title="Currency Settings"
        sub="Control how currencies appear across the platform"
      >
        <InfoBox
          text="SkilledProz supports multi-currency. Each setting serves a different purpose — set them independently for the best experience."
          c={c}
        />

        <FieldLabel label="🏦 DASHBOARD DISPLAY CURRENCY" />
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
          The currency your dashboard stats, earnings totals, and summaries are
          displayed in. Display preference only — does not change actual
          transaction amounts.
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.currencyRow}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <SelectInput
              value={dashCurrency}
              options={CURRENCIES.map((cu) => ({
                value: cu.code,
                label: `${cu.symbol} ${cu.code} — ${cu.name}`,
              }))}
              onChange={setDashCurrency}
              c={c}
            />
          </View>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.currencyBadge,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {dashInfo?.symbol} {dashInfo?.code}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              {dashInfo?.name}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        <Divider c={c} />

        <FieldLabel label="💳 PAYMENT CURRENCY" />
        <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
          The default currency you use to pay for bookings. You can change this
          per booking at checkout.
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.currencyRow}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <SelectInput
              value={payCurrency}
              options={CURRENCIES.map((cu) => ({
                value: cu.code,
                label: `${cu.symbol} ${cu.code} — ${cu.name}`,
              }))}
              onChange={setPayCurrency}
              c={c}
            />
          </View>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.currencyBadge,
              { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange }}
            >
              {payInfo?.symbol} {payInfo?.code}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              {payInfo?.name}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>

        <AppButton
          title={saving ? "Saving…" : "Save Currency Settings"}
          onPress={handleSave}
          loading={saving}
          style={{ marginTop: 16, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
          fullWidth={false}
        />
      </SectionCard>

      {/* Currency Summary */}
      <SectionCard
        icon="📋"
        title="Currency Summary"
        sub="How your currencies are configured"
      >
        <View style={styles.twoCol}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.summaryCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.card, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>🏦</AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              Dashboard shows stats in
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 2 }}
            >
              {dashInfo?.symbol} {dashInfo?.code}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Change anytime — display only
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.summaryCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.card, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>💳</AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              You pay in
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 2 }}
            >
              {payInfo?.symbol} {payInfo?.code}
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Used for actual transactions
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
      </SectionCard>
    </>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  APPEARANCE
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function AppearanceSection({ data, onReload }) {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { theme: th, mode, setMode } = useTheme();
  const { i18n } = useTranslation();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [selectedTheme, setSelectedTheme] = useState(
    mode || data?.theme || "system",
  );
  const [langSearch, setLangSearch] = useState("");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // Only show languages that have locale files
  // LANGUAGES constant only contains languages that have locale files
  const LANG_LIST = LANGUAGES.map((l) => ({
    code: l.code,
    flag: l.flag,
    label: l.code === "en" ? `${l.nativeName} (Default)` : l.nativeName,
  }));

  const activeLanguage =
    LANG_LIST.find((l) => l.code === i18n.language) || LANG_LIST[0];
  const filteredLangs = LANG_LIST.filter((l) =>
    l.label.toLowerCase().includes(langSearch.toLowerCase()),
  );

  const handleThemeSave = async () => {
    // Apply immediately — setMode persists to AsyncStorage and re-renders instantly
    setMode(selectedTheme);
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.updateProfile({ theme: selectedTheme });
      toast.success("Appearance saved");
      onReload();
    } catch {
      setMode(mode); // revert context on failure
      setSelectedTheme(mode);
      toast.error("Could not save appearance");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLangSelect = async (code) => {
    try {
      // changeLanguage() from i18n/index.js:
      //   1. calls i18n.changeLanguage(code)          → triggers the App.js
      //      languageChanged listener → langKey changes → RootNavigator remounts
      //      → EVERY screen re-renders in the new language instantly
      //   2. saves the code to AsyncStorage            → persists across app restarts
      await changeLanguage(code);
      toast.success("Language updated");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not change language");
    }
    // Save to user profile in background (non-blocking)
    settingsApi.updateProfile({ language: code }).catch(() => {});
  };

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon="🎨"
      title="Appearance"
      sub="Theme and language preferences"
    >
      {/* Theme */}
      <FieldLabel label="🌓 THEME" />
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        Choose how SkilledProz looks on your device.
      </AppText>
      <View style={styles.threeColGrid}>
        {THEMES.map((t) => {
          const sel = selectedTheme === t.value;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={t.value}
              onPress={() => setSelectedTheme(t.value)}
              style={[
                styles.themeCard,
                {
                  borderColor: sel ? c.orange : c.border,
                  backgroundColor: sel ? c.orangeDim : c.card,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {sel && (
                <AppText style={[styles.themeCheck, { color: c.orange }]}>
                  ✓
                </AppText>
              )}
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 28 }}>{t.emoji}</AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="small"
                weight="semibold"
                style={{ marginTop: 8, color: sel ? c.orange : c.text }}
              >
                {t.label}
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <AppButton
        title={saving ? "Saving…" : "Save Appearance"}
        onPress={handleThemeSave}
        loading={saving}
        style={{ marginTop: 12, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
        fullWidth={false}
      />

      <Divider c={c} />

      {/* Language */}
      <FieldLabel label="🌐 LANGUAGE" />
      <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}>
        Select your preferred language.
      </AppText>

      <View
        style={[
          styles.searchRow,
          { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.inputBg },
        ]}
      >
        <Ionicons
          name="search"
          size={16}
          color={c.textMuted}
          style={{ marginRight: 8 }}
        />
        <TextInput
          value={langSearch}
          onChangeText={setLangSearch}
          placeholder="Search language…"
          placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
          style={[styles.searchInput, { color: c.text }]}
        />
      </View>

      <View style={[styles.listBox, { borderColor: c.border }]}>
        {filteredLangs.map((lang, idx) => {
          const sel = i18n.language === lang.code;
          return (
            <Pressable
              key={lang.code}
              onPress={() => handleLangSelect(lang.code)}
              style={[
                styles.listRow,
                {
                  borderBottomColor: c.border,
                  borderBottomWidth:
                    idx < filteredLangs.length - 1
                      ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth
                      : 0,
                  backgroundColor: sel ? c.orangeDim : "transparent",
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20, marginRight: 12 }}>
                {lang.flag}
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                style={{ flex: 1, color: sel ? c.orange : c.text }}
              >
                {lang.label}
              </AppText>
              {sel && (
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={18} color={c.orange} />
              )}
            </Pressable>
          );
        })}
      </View>

      <View style={styles.activeLangRow}>
        <View style={styles.activeDot} />
        <AppText variant="small">
          Active:{" "}
          <AppText variant="small" weight="semibold">
            {activeLanguage.label}
          </AppText>
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  NOTIFICATIONS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function NotificationsSection() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [prefs, setPrefs] = useState(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    settingsApi
      .getNotificationPrefs()
      .then(setPrefs)
      .catch(() => toast.error("Could not load notification preferences"))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const toggle = async (key) => {
    const next = { ...prefs, [key]: !prefs[key] };
    setPrefs(next); // immediate UI update
    try {
      await settingsApi.updateNotificationPrefs({ [key]: next[key] });
    } catch {
      setPrefs(prefs); // revert on failure
      toast.error("Could not update preference");
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.updateNotificationPrefs(prefs);
      toast.success("Notification preferences saved");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Could not save preferences");
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading || !prefs) return <LoadingCard c={c} />;

  const NOTIF_ROWS = [
    {
      key: "notifBookings",
      emoji: "📋",
      label: "Booking updates",
      sub: "New bookings, status changes, confirmations",
    },
    {
      key: "notifMessages",
      emoji: "💬",
      label: "Messages",
      sub: "New messages from hirers or workers",
    },
    {
      key: "notifPayments",
      emoji: "💳",
      label: "Payment alerts",
      sub: "Escrow releases, payment confirmations",
    },
    {
      key: "notifReviews",
      emoji: "⭐",
      label: "Reviews",
      sub: "New reviews on your profile",
    },
    {
      key: "notifMarketing",
      emoji: "📢",
      label: "Product updates",
      sub: "New features and platform news",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon="🔔"
      title="Notifications"
      sub="Choose what you get notified about"
    >
      {NOTIF_ROWS.map((row, idx) => (
        <ToggleRow
          key={row.key}
          emoji={row.emoji}
          label={row.label}
          sub={row.sub}
          value={prefs[row.key]}
          onToggle={() => toggle(row.key)}
          showDivider={idx < NOTIF_ROWS.length - 1}
          c={c}
        />
      ))}
      <AppButton
        title={saving ? "Saving…" : "Save Notification Preferences"}
        onPress={handleSave}
        loading={saving}
        style={{ marginTop: 16, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
        fullWidth={false}
      />
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SECURITY
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function SecuritySection() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { logout } = useAuthStore();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;

  const [currentPw, setCurrentPw] = useState("");
  const [newPw, setNewPw] = useState("");
  const [confirmPw, setConfirmPw] = useState("");
  const [savingPw, setSavingPw] = useState(false);
  const [secInfo, setSecInfo] = useState(null);
  const [loadingSec, setLoadingSec] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    settingsApi
      .getSecurityInfo()
      .then(setSecInfo)
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setLoadingSec(false));
  }, []);

  const handlePasswordChange = async () => {
    if (newPw !== confirmPw) {
      toast.error("New passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    if (newPw.length < 8) {
      toast.error("Password must be at least 8 characters");
      return;
    }
    setSavingPw(true);
    try {
      await settingsApi.changePassword({
        currentPassword: currentPw,
        newPassword: newPw,
      });
      toast.success("Password changed successfully");
      setCurrentPw("");
      setNewPw("");
      setConfirmPw("");
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err?.response?.data?.message || "Could not change password");
    } finally {
      setSavingPw(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeactivate = () => {
    Alert.alert(
      "Deactivate Account",
      "Your profile will be hidden and you'll be logged out. Contact support to reactivate.",
      [
        { text: "Cancel", style: "cancel" },
        {
          text: "Deactivate",
          style: "destructive",
          onPress: async () => {
            try {
              await settingsApi.deleteAccount({
                password: currentPw || "confirm",
              });
              await logout();
            } catch {
              toast.error(
                "Could not deactivate account. Please enter your current password first.",
              );
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  };

  return (
    <>
      {/* Change Password */}
      <SectionCard
        icon="🔑"
        title="Change Password"
        sub="Keep your account secure"
      >
        <FieldLabel label="CURRENT PASSWORD" />
        <FieldInput
          value={currentPw}
          onChange={setCurrentPw}
          placeholder=""
          secureTextEntry
          c={c}
        />
        <FieldLabel label="NEW PASSWORD (MIN 8 CHARS)" />
        <FieldInput
          value={newPw}
          onChange={setNewPw}
          placeholder=""
          secureTextEntry
          c={c}
        />
        <FieldLabel label="CONFIRM NEW PASSWORD" />
        <FieldInput
          value={confirmPw}
          onChange={setConfirmPw}
          placeholder=""
          secureTextEntry
          c={c}
        />
        <AppButton
          title={savingPw ? "Updating…" : "Update Password"}
          onPress={handlePasswordChange}
          loading={savingPw}
          style={{ marginTop: 8, alignSelf: "flex-start" }}
          fullWidth={false}
        />
      </SectionCard>

      {/* Account Info */}
      {!loadingSec && secInfo && (
        <SectionCard
          icon="🛡️"
          title="Account Info"
          sub="Your verification and account status"
        >
          <InfoRow label="Email" value={secInfo.email} c={c} />
          <InfoRow
            label="Email Verified"
            value={secInfo.isEmailVerified ? "✅ Verified" : "❌ Not verified"}
            c={c}
          />
          <InfoRow
            label="Phone Verified"
            value={secInfo.isPhoneVerified ? "✅ Verified" : "❌ Not verified"}
            c={c}
          />
          <InfoRow
            label="2FA"
            value={
              secInfo.twoFactorEnabled
                ? "✅ Enabled"
                : "⚠️ Not enabled (coming soon)"
            }
            c={c}
          />
          <InfoRow
            label="Member Since"
            value={
              secInfo.accountCreated
                ? new Date(secInfo.accountCreated).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
                    day: "numeric",
                    month: "long",
                    year: "numeric",
                  })
                : "—"
            }
            c={c}
          />
          <InfoRow
            label="Last Seen"
            value={
              secInfo.lastSeen
                ? new Date(secInfo.lastSeen).toLocaleString()
                : "—"
            }
            c={c}
          />
        </SectionCard>
      )}

      {/* Danger Zone */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.dangerCard,
          { borderColor: "#ef4444", backgroundColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.08)" },
        ]}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            styles.sectionCardHeader,
            { borderBottomColor: "rgba(239,68,68,0.2)" },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>⚠️</AppText>
          <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              Danger Zone
            </AppText>
            <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
              Irreversible actions
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </View>
        <View style={{ padding: 16 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            weight="semibold"
            style={{ color: "#ef4444" }}
          >
            Deactivate Account
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginTop: 4, marginBottom: 12 }}
          >
            Your profile will be hidden and you'll be logged out. Contact
            support to reactivate.
          </AppText>
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleDeactivate}
            style={[styles.deactivateBtn, { backgroundColor: "#ef4444" }]}
          >
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" style={{ color: "#fff" }}>
              Deactivate
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
        </View>
      </View>
    </>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  ACTIVITY
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function ActivitySection() {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  const [data, setData] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    settingsApi
      .getActivitySummary()
      .then(setData)
      .catch(() => toast.error("Could not load activity"))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  if (loading || !data) return <LoadingCard c={c} />;

  const { summary, recentActivity } = data;

  return (
    <SectionCard
      icon="📊"
      title="Account Activity"
      sub="Your recent platform activity"
    >
      {/* Stat cards */}
      <View style={styles.statRow}>
        <StatMini
          emoji="🔔"
          value={summary?.unreadNotifications ?? 0}
          label="Unread notifications"
          c={c}
        />
        <StatMini
          emoji="📋"
          value={summary?.totalBookings ?? 0}
          label="Total bookings"
          c={c}
        />
        <StatMini
          emoji="⭐"
          value={summary?.totalReviews ?? 0}
          label="Reviews received"
          c={c}
        />
      </View>

      {/* Recent activity */}
      {recentActivity?.length > 0 && (
        <View style={{ marginTop: 20 }}>
          <AppText
            variant="small"
            weight="semibold"
            tone="dim"
            style={{ marginBottom: 12, letterSpacing: 0.5 }}
          >
            RECENT ACTIVITY
          </AppText>
          {recentActivity.map((item, idx) => (
            <View
              key={item.id}
              style={[
                styles.activityRow,
                {
                  borderColor: c.border,
                  backgroundColor: c.card,
                  marginBottom: idx < recentActivity.length - 1 ? 8 : 0,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <View style={styles.activityLeft}>
                <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20, marginRight: 10 }}>🔔</AppText>
                <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
                  <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold" numberOfLines={1}>
                    {item.title}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    tone="dim"
                    numberOfLines={2}
                    style={{ marginTop: 2 }}
                  >
                    {item.body}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="small" tone="dim" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>
                    {new Date(item.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
              {!item.isRead && (
                <View
                  style={[styles.unreadDot, { backgroundColor: c.orange }]}
                />
              )}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  SHARED SUB-COMPONENTS
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function SectionCard({ icon, title, sub, children }) {
  const { theme: th } = useTheme();
  const c = th.colors;
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.sectionCard,
        { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.card, marginBottom: 16 },
      ]}
    >
      <View style={[styles.sectionCardHeader, { borderBottomColor: c.border }]}>
        <AppText style={{ fontSize: 22 }}>{icon}</AppText>
        <View style={{ marginLeft: 12 }}>
          <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
            {title}
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {sub}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.sectionCardBody}>{children}</View>
    </View>
  );
}

function FieldLabel({ label }) {
  return (
    <AppText
      variant="small"
      weight="semibold"
      tone="dim"
      style={styles.fieldLabel}
    >
      {label}
    </AppText>
  );
}

function FieldInput({
  value,
  onChange,
  placeholder,
  keyboardType,
  secureTextEntry,
  c,
}) {
  return (
    <TextInput
      value={value}
      onChangeText={onChange}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
      keyboardType={keyboardType}
      secureTextEntry={secureTextEntry}
      style={[
        styles.fieldInput,
        { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.inputBg, color: c.text },
      ]}
    />
  );
}

function MultilineInput({ value, onChange, placeholder, c }) {
  return (
    <TextInput
      value={value}
      onChangeText={onChange}
      placeholder={placeholder}
      placeholderTextColor={c.textMuted}
      multiline
      numberOfLines={4}
      textAlignVertical="top"
      style={[
        styles.fieldInput,
        styles.multiline,
        { borderColor: c.border, backgroundColor: c.inputBg, color: c.text },
      ]}
    />
  );
}

function SelectInput({ value, options, onChange, c }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const current = options.find((o) => o.value === value);
  return (
    <View style={{ marginBottom: 10, zIndex: open ? 999 : 1 }}>
      <Pressable
        onPress={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        style={[
          styles.fieldInput,
          styles.selectTrigger,
          {
            borderColor: open ? c.orange : c.border,
            backgroundColor: c.inputBg,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          style={{ flex: 1, color: current ? c.text : c.textMuted }}
          numberOfLines={1}
        >
          {current?.label || "Select…"}
        </AppText>
        <Ionicons
          name={open ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down"}
          size={16}
          color={open ? c.orange : c.textMuted}
        />
      </Pressable>
      {open && (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.dropdown,
            {
              borderColor: c.orange,
              backgroundColor: c.card,
              position: "absolute",
              top: 52,
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              zIndex: 1000,
              elevation: 10,
              shadowColor: "#000",
              shadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 4 },
              shadowOpacity: 0.3,
              shadowRadius: 8,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <ScrollView
            nestedScrollEnabled
            style={{ maxHeight: 220 }}
            showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
            keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          >
            {options.map((opt, idx) => {
              const sel = opt.value === value;
              return (
                <Pressable
                  key={opt.value}
                  onPress={() => {
                    onChange(opt.value);
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                  style={[
                    styles.dropdownItem,
                    {
                      borderBottomColor: c.border,
                      borderBottomWidth:
                        idx < options.length - 1 ? StyleSheet.hairlineWidth : 0,
                      backgroundColor: sel ? c.orangeDim : "transparent",
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="small"
                    weight={sel ? "semibold" : "regular"}
                    style={{ flex: 1, color: sel ? c.orange : c.text }}
                    numberOfLines={1}
                  >
                    {opt.label}
                  </AppText>
                  {sel && (
                    <Ionicons
                      name="checkmark-circle"
                      size={16}
                      color={c.orange}
                    />
                  )}
                </Pressable>
              );
            })}
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

function ToggleRow({ emoji, label, sub, value, onToggle, showDivider, c }) {
  return (
    <>
      <View style={styles.toggleRow}>
        <View style={{ flex: 1, paddingRight: 12 }}>
          {emoji && (
            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 18, marginBottom: 2 }}>
              {emoji}{" "}
              <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
                {label}
              </AppText>
            </AppText>
          )}
          {!emoji && (
            <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
              {label}
            </AppText>
          )}
          <AppText variant="small" tone="dim">
            {sub}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <Switch
          value={!!value}
          onValueChange={onToggle}
          trackColor={{ false: c.border, true: c.orange }}
          thumbColor="#fff"
        />
      </View>
      {showDivider && <Divider c={c} />}
    </>
  );
}

function InfoRow({ label, value, c }) {
  return (
    <>
      <View style={styles.infoRow}>
        <AppText variant="body" tone="dim" style={{ flex: 1 }}>
          {label}
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" weight="semibold">
          {value}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <Divider c={c} />
    </>
  );
}

function StatMini({ emoji, value, label, c }) {
  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.statMini,
        { backgroundColor: c.bg, borderColor: c.border },
      ]}
    >
      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 26 }}>{emoji}</AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="display"
        weight="displayBlack"
        style={{ color: c.orange, marginTop: 4 }}
      >
        {value}
      </AppText>
      <AppText
        variant="small"
        tone="dim"
        style={{ textAlign: "center", marginTop: 4 }}
      >
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </View>
  );
