const DAYS = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"];

function initials(first, last) {
  return `${first?.[0] ?? ""}${last?.[0] ?? ""}`.toUpperCase();
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function fmtFullDate(d) {
  if (!d) return "";
  return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

// ── Star row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function Stars({ rating, size = 16, color }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row" }}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((i) => (
        <AppText
          key={i}
          style={{ fontSize: size, color: i <= rating ? color : "#4b5563" }}
        >
          ★
        </AppText>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function Lightbox({ item, onClose }) {
  if (!item) return null;
  return (
    <Modal visible transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={onClose}>
      <Pressable style={lb.backdrop} onPress={onClose}>
        <View style={lb.container}>
          <Pressable style={lb.closeBtn} onPress={onClose}>
            <AppText style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 18 }}>✕</AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Image
            source={{ uri: item.imageUrl }}
            style={lb.image}
            resizeMode="contain"
          />
          {(item.title || item.description) && (
            <View style={lb.caption}>
              {item.title && (
                <AppText
                  style={{ color: "#fff", fontWeight: "700", fontSize: 16 }}
                >
                  {item.title}
                </AppText>
              )}
              {item.description && (
                <AppText
                  style={{ color: "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)", marginTop: 4 }}
                >
                  {item.description}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
          )}
        </View>
      </Pressable>
    </Modal>
  );
}

              YEARS EXPERIENCE
            </AppText>

              variant="body"
              weight="semibold"
              style={{ color: c.text, marginTop: 2 }}

              {wp.yearsExperience} yrs
            </AppText>
          </View>
        )}
        {!!wp.serviceRadius && (
          <View
            style={[
              tab.statCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },

            <AppText style={{ fontSize: 20 }}>📡</AppText>

              variant="body"

function ReviewsSection({ reviews, avgRating, total, c }) {

        return (

            style={[
              tab.reviewCard,
              { backgroundColor: c.bgInput, borderColor: c.border },
            ]}
          >
            <View style={tab.reviewAuthorRow}>
              <View
                style={[tab.reviewAvatar, { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim }]}
              >
                {g.avatar ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: g.avatar }}
                    style={tab.reviewAvatarImg}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <AppText style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700" }}>
                    {initials(g.firstName, g.lastName)}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
              <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 10 }}>
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  weight="semibold"
                  style={{ color: c.text }}
                >
                  {g.firstName} {g.lastName}
                </AppText>
                {r.booking?.title && (
                  <AppText variant="small" style={{ color: c.textMuted }}>
                    {r.booking.title}
                  </AppText>

              </View>
              <Stars rating={r.rating} size={14} color={c.orange} />

            >
              {fmtFullDate(r.createdAt)}

          </View>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Main Screen
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const PROFILE_TABS = [
  "about",
  "portfolio",
  "certifications",
  "availability",
  "reviews",
];

export default function WorkerPublicProfileScreen({ navigation, route }) {
  const userId = route?.params?.userId;
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { theme: c } = useTheme();
  const toast = useToast();

  const [worker, setWorker] = useState(null);
  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState([]);
  const [reviewMeta, setReviewMeta] = useState({ avgRating: 0, total: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("about");

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const [w, rev] = await Promise.all([
        getWorkerPublicProfile(userId),
        getWorkerPublicReviews(userId, { limit: 20 }).catch(() => ({
          reviews: [],
          avgRating: 0,
          total: 0,
        })),
      ]);
      setWorker(w);
      setReviews(rev.reviews ?? []);
      setReviewMeta({ avgRating: rev.avgRating ?? 0, total: rev.total ?? 0 });
    } catch {
      toast.error(t("toast.unknownError"));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [userId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId) load();
  }, [userId]);

  const onRefresh = () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    load();
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
        <TopBar navigation={navigation} title="" />
        <View style={styles.loadWrap}>
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={c.orange} />
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!worker) return null;

  const u = worker.user ?? {};
  const wp = worker;
  const isVerified = wp.verificationStatus === "VERIFIED";
  const isAvailable = wp.isAvailable;
  const categories = wp.categories ?? [];
  const portfolio = wp.portfolio ?? [];
  const certs = wp.certifications ?? [];
  const availability = wp.availability ?? [];
  const location = [u.city, u.country].filter(Boolean).join(", ");

  // Rate chips
  const rateChips = [
    wp.dailyRate && {
      label: `${wp.currency} ${Number(wp.dailyRate).toLocaleString()}`,
      suffix: "/day",
    },
    wp.weeklyRate && {
      label: `${wp.currency} ${Number(wp.weeklyRate).toLocaleString()}`,
      suffix: "/wk",
    },
    wp.monthlyRate && {
      label: `${wp.currency} ${Number(wp.monthlyRate).toLocaleString()}`,
      suffix: "/mo",
    },
    wp.customRate &&
      wp.pricingNote && {
        label: `${wp.currency} ${Number(wp.customRate).toLocaleString()}`,
        suffix: `/${wp.pricingNote}`,
      },
  ].filter(Boolean);

  return (
    <View style={[styles.screen, { backgroundColor: c.bg }]}>
      <TopBar navigation={navigation} title="" />

      <ScrollView
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={onRefresh}
            tintColor={c.orange}
          />
        }
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* ── Profile hero card ── */}
        <View
          style={[
            styles.heroCard,
            { backgroundColor: c.bgCard, borderColor: c.border },
          ]}
        >
          {/* Avatar + name + availability */}
          <View style={styles.heroTop}>
            <View style={styles.heroAvatarWrap}>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.heroAvatar,
                  { backgroundColor: c.orangeDim, borderColor: c.orange },
                ]}
              >
                {u.avatar ? (
                  <Image
                    source={{ uri: u.avatar }}
                    style={styles.heroAvatarImg}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <AppText
                    style={{ color: c.orange, fontWeight: "700", fontSize: 28 }}
                  >
                    {initials(u.firstName, u.lastName)}
                  </AppText>
                )}
              </View>
              <View
                style={[
                  styles.heroAvailDot,
                  { backgroundColor: isAvailable ? "#22c55e" : "#6b7280" },
                ]}
              />
              {isVerified && (
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.heroVerifiedBadge,
                    { backgroundColor: c.bgCard },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppText style={{ fontSize: 14 }}>🛡️</AppText>
                </View>
              )}
            </View>

            <View style={{ flex: 1, marginLeft: 14 }}>
              <View
                style={{ flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", gap: 10 }}
              >
                <AppText style={[styles.heroName, { color: c.text }]}>
                  {u.firstName} {u.lastName}
                </AppText>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.availPill,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: isAvailable
                        ? "rgba(34,197,94,0.12)"
                        : "rgba(107,114,128,0.12)",
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.availDot,
                      { backgroundColor: isAvailable ? "#22c55e" : "#6b7280" },
                    ]}
                  />
                  <AppText
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 11,
                      fontWeight: "700",
                      color: isAvailable ? "#22c55e" : "#6b7280",
                    }}
                  >
                    {isAvailable
                      ? t("workerProfile.available")
                      : t("workerProfile.unavailable")}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
              {!!wp.title && (
                <AppText
                  variant="body"
                  style={{ color: c.textMuted, marginTop: 2 }}
                >
                  {wp.title}
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Category chips */}
          {categories.length > 0 && (
            <View style={styles.catsWrap}>
              {categories.map((wc, i) => {

                    key={wc.id ?? i}

                      styles.catChip,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: col.bg,
                        borderColor: col.border,
                      },

                      <AppText style={{ fontSize: 13, marginRight: 4 }}>
                        {wc.category.icon}
                      </AppText>
                    )}
                    <AppText
                      style={{
                        color: col.text,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: "600",
                      }}

                      {wc.category?.name ?? wc.name}

            </View>

            <AppText style={{ color: c.orange }}>★</AppText>

              variant="body"

              style={{ color: c.orange, marginLeft: 4 }}

              {wp.avgRating > 0 ? Number(wp.avgRating).toFixed(1) : "New"}

              {" "}
              {wp.totalReviews ?? 0} reviews |

              variant="body"

          />

        <View style={{ height: 40 }} />
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

// src/store/authStore.js
// Mirror of the website's `useAuthStore` adapted for React Native:
//   - tokens live in SecureStore (via tokenStore)
//   - user lives in AsyncStorage so we can rehydrate quickly on app open

import { create } from "zustand";
import AsyncStorage from "@react-native-async-storage/async-storage";
import api, { tokenStore, getErrorMessage } from "../api/client";

const USER_KEY = "@skilledproz:user";

export const useAuthStore = create((set, get) => ({
  user: null,
  isLoading: false,
  isHydrated: false,

  // Rehydrate user + decide auth state on app launch
  hydrate: async () => {
    try {
      const [rawUser, access] = await Promise.all([
        AsyncStorage.getItem(USER_KEY),
        tokenStore.getAccess(),
      ]);
      const cachedUser = rawUser ? JSON.parse(rawUser) : null;
      // Show cached user immediately for snappy UX
      set({ user: cachedUser });

      if (access) {
        // Validate by fetching /auth/me - this also picks up server-side updates
        try {
          const { data } = await api.get("/auth/me");
          set({ user: data.data });
          await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.data));
        } catch {
          // Token invalid or refresh failed - clear
          await get().clearAuth();
        }
      }
    } finally {
      set({ isHydrated: true });
    }
  },

  setAuth: async (user, accessToken, refreshToken) => {
    await tokenStore.setTokens(accessToken, refreshToken);
    await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
    set({ user });
  },

  updateUser: async (patch) => {
    const next = { ...(get().user || {}), ...patch };
    set({ user: next });
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
    } catch {}
  },

  clearAuth: async () => {
    await tokenStore.clear();
    await AsyncStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
    set({ user: null });
  },

  fetchMe: async () => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.get("/auth/me");
      set({ user: data.data });
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(data.data));
      return data.data;
    } catch {
      await get().clearAuth();
      return null;
    }
  },

  login: async (email, password) => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/login", { email, password });
      const { user, accessToken, refreshToken } = data.data;
      await get().setAuth(user, accessToken, refreshToken);
      return user;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Login failed"));
    } finally {
      set({ isLoading: false });
    }
  },

  register: async (payload) => {
    set({ isLoading: true });
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/register", payload);
      const { user, accessToken, refreshToken } = data.data;
      await get().setAuth(user, accessToken, refreshToken);
      return user;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Registration failed"));
    } finally {
      set({ isLoading: false });
    }
  },

  logout: async () => {
    try {
      await api.post("/auth/logout");
    } catch {}
    await get().clearAuth();
  },

  forgotPassword: async (email) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/forgot-password", { email });
      return data;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Could not send reset link"));
    }
  },

  resetPassword: async (token, password) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/reset-password", {
        token,
        password,
      });
      return data;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Could not reset password"));
    }
  },

  resendVerification: async (email) => {
    try {
      const { data } = await api.post("/auth/resend-verification", { email });
      return data;
    } catch (err) {
      throw new Error(getErrorMessage(err, "Could not resend verification"));
    }
  },
}));

# ── end of src/store/authStore.js ────────────────────────────────────────────

// src/utils/validators.js
export const isEmail = (v = "") =>
  /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(v).trim());

export const isStrongEnoughPassword = (v = "") => String(v).length >= 8;

export const isNonEmpty = (v) => v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim().length > 0;

# Assets

Drop your `icon.png` (1024x1024), `splash.png`, and `adaptive-icon.png` here.

Then reference them in `app.json` under `expo.icon`, `expo.splash.image`, and `expo.android.adaptiveIcon.foregroundImage`.

Until then, Expo uses its default Expo icon — totally fine for development.
